chapters.title: Chapter 1601: Three Deadly Attacks
paragraphs: As the tribulation churned, Kent remained calm, his hand moving toward his mouth as he tossed one grape after another into it.

He knew the danger coming was not one he could joke around with. However, considering how disappointing his first battle after becoming a True Immortal had been, a part of him felt like this would be a good one.
The tribulation was invoked because of his Dragon Intent. He had only just awakened it, and even at Tier 1, it had invoked a tribulation.
However, while the allure of finally tasting what Dragon Intent sounded like the best thing, Kent understood that the gains would only manifest when he passed the tribulation.
There is also another gain.
Awakening Dragon Intent while also awakening his third element, the lightning element, sounded like something he would be happy about. Not forgetting he would be able to temper his body even more.
[The Master should be ready]
Kent nodded and tossed the last grape into his mouth before sitting down in a lotus posture. The next second, he rose from the ground and flew 40 meters into the air while still in a lotus posture.
Just then, a dark bolt of lightning formed and transformed into a razor-sharp spear. It locked its piercing tip onto Kent.
Kent felt the danger, but he remained calm, his body relaxed as he waited for the spear to lunge at him.
Per the rules, he had to tank three deadly bolts of lightning using his body. He could not use any external defensive abilities.
So summoning his [Chaos Scale Shield] was not allowed. However, the rules said nothing about him taking on the appearance of a demi-dragon.
If he wanted, he could transform into his dragon form, and everything would take care of itself. However, what was a little challenge if it meant becoming stronger?
"What is he trying to do? Do not tell me he plans on taking on the tribulation with nothing but his body," Morveth asked, his eyes widening.

Yggzrael smirked, but deep within those eyes, one could tell he was also scared for Kent, and he had to play it cool. "As expected of my Young Lord. Not even the Heavenly Tribulation can deter him from raising any defense."
Morveth, Baelgor, and Kryzoth looked at him but said nothing. They knew Yggzrael was merely trying to hype himself up to appear nonchalant.
But while they read into his intention, the mere fact that Kent had already shown no sign of using any defense made them even more stunned.
Looking at him just sitting there, doing nothing, made them wonder if Kent had gone mad.
Kent remained seated, his expression calm, as if he were not in any danger as the tribulation churned.
Gazing up at the spear ready to shoot at him, a smile formed on his face.

Just then, the bolt descended in the form of a spear hurled straight at Kent’s chest. Kent’s body released waves of chaos qi as he reinforced his scales, considering he was now in his demi-dragon form.
He made sure they were only sturdier and more refined.
*BOOM*
When the spear landed on his chest, a powerful explosion of lightning erupted, sending dust flying all over. Kent remained seated in the same place.
However, the 13 rope tendrils of fabric attached to his armor like a cloak billowed in the air.
"Tingles."
Kent smiled, reading the message that had appeared before him.
[Your understanding of Chaos Lightning has improved greatly.]
"That is a start." Turning his head up, Kent gazed at the tribulation cloud forming the second attack.
In no time, a large finger formed, crackling with overwhelming lightning. The feeling of dread could be felt from it.
"They are getting serious." Sensing this, Kent tapped further into his chaos qi and circulated it, allowing its potent nature to shield his scales, making them even more powerful.
Just then, the finger moved, and the ground trembled, sending tremors in all directions. Kent felt his brain vibrate as the terrifying pressure from the Lightning Finger closed in on him.
’Damn.’
Kent sensed a foreign intent just a second before the attack landed on his body. This time, he was pushed back. However, he only flew back a meter before his body stabilized.
At once, he felt his connection to the Dragon Intent slowly forming. Aside from that, he could sense his Chaos Lightning awakening deep within him.
Because of his understanding of Ice and Fire, he sensed it. Now, even without the last tribulation attack, he would be able to gradually awaken it over time.
"Ouch, the second attack was a bit painful." Kent looked up, a smile playing on his lips as he gazed at the third tribulation attack forming.
[Your understanding of Chaos Lightning has improved significantly.]
Without any hesitation, he transformed into his dragon form and rose into the air, his giant metallic wings spread open.
He felt the pain after the second attack landed on him, so he was not about to take the last attack for granted.
Naturally, when a giant claw formed, he knew turning into his dragon form was the best decision he had made.
That was because the moment the claw formed, it attacked, and Kent could only watch as it slammed into his back, sending him crashing to the ground.
His body slammed into the ground, five large wounds inflicted by the five claws appearing on his back.
Kent forced his body to stand, a wave of dizziness seeping deep within him. The lightning from the third attack managed to touch even his soul.

However, as he stood there, now back in his demi-dragon form, he could not help but smile. The wounds on his back had already closed and healed. Of course, he still felt the pain, but that would be gone soon.
[Your understanding of Chaos Lightning has improved tremendously.]
Kent skipped this message and focused on the second one while waves of energy burst out from his body, spreading far and wide.
[You have awakened Dragon Intent. Gold Grade: Tier 1.]
[You can now use Dragon Intent however you want, provided you have Chaos Qi and Blood Qi.]
[Because you have awakened Dragon Intent, an innate ability has been unlocked: Intimidate.]
[Intimidate]
[Rank: Innate]
[Ranking: 4 stars]

[Description: As a Monarch, your mere presence is enough to shake the hearts of all lower existences. Intimidate them to do as you wish. Whenever you use Intimidate, they lose 30% of their total combat power.]

Kent just smiled, already happy to have awakened Dragon Intent. The added ability, since it was innate, could also work as a passive, so he knew even if he had enough power, allowing his enemies to cower before him would be fun, at least.
In the end, he had not awakened the Chaos Lightning. However, he had formed a foundation, so he could easily awaken the lightning later.
Kent, however, was not yet interested in that innate skill. His focus, however, is on something else.
"This power..."
He made a small fist, feeling an overwhelming strength course through his body. "This is crazy."
"I feel like with just a pinch of my finger, I can crush even a god." Call it arrogance, but the kind of power Kent was feeling now was not something to scoff at.

In fact, he could tell just by this power that his physical strength surpassed that of even an Early God. The Dragon Intent had awakened, and with it, several terrifying beings locked their sights on him, some even Kent would shiver and run away from.
He had 66 days to stay out of trouble per the instructions Princess Pandora gave him. However, on the fifth day, he had become the center of attention.

chapters.title: Chapter 1602: Four vs One (1)
paragraphs: Already, just inside the Tormented Layer, if Kent becomes complacent, he might find himself in hot soup. It is true that he has become extremely powerful.

However, that doesn’t mean he alone can take on all the beasts inside the Tormented Layer. Even now, if over 30 Immortal Lords were to gang up on him, the chances of him getting hurt and even being pushed to a corner are possible.
If that number were upgraded to 30 demigods, which, as it stands, there are indeed over a hundred demigod beasts in the Tormented Layer alone, he cannot underestimate anyone at all.
However, if he were to get the attention of the Chaos Layer, which he already has, there is a chance the next 66 days would be too long for him.
As it stands right now, he isn’t strong enough to contend against gods, much less powerful demigods who are monarchs like him.
So, keeping a low profile until Lady Pandora awakens would be the right thing to do.
However, his [Dragon Intent] awakening has shattered that calm, and now, every beast in the Tormented Layer and even some inside the Chaos Layer have noticed his presence.
But Kent wasn’t about to cower in fear.
Already, he has discovered another way to grow even stronger, and that involves forming a contract with beasts. The more contracts he forms, the stronger he becomes.
So while dangers of all forms and shapes hang over his head, he isn’t scared because if he manages to bring even five more demigods under his command, his soul would reach a new kind of danger.
Now he can tell that Yggzrael has completed the mission he was given.
Looking at the three demigods standing beside Yggzrael, the smile on his face bloomed.
"Welcome, guys. I believe you have already been briefed on the reason why I asked for your presence today." Witnessing his astonishing feat during the tribulation, they all nodded.
Even now, as they stand before him, they can feel an overwhelming aura that none of them can fathom oozing out from Kent’s body.

Kent had no idea he had such a presence. However, he can feel his power has risen far beyond what someone at his level should have. Not even Chaos had this kind of strength when he was a True Immortal.
Watching them nod, Kent smiled...
"But before we form the contract, how about we duel fight."
Yggzrael turned and looked at the other three demigods. They both became stunned, a part of them wishing Kent had never requested a duel. They were already fine with becoming his contracted beasts.
"Of course, we will only fight in our demi-human forms, no domains, and it will be me against all four of you at the same time.
If you are worried about how heavy my attacks would be, we can sign the contract first, which would guarantee your safety even if I sever your heads from your shoulders."
One of the abilities Tower has awakened after her upgrade allows everything connected to Kent, and, by extension, they cannot die when they fight each other, both inside and outside the tower.
First, that power was confined to the Legion Tower. But it has now spread to the other towers and even beyond them.
Hearing his words, the three demigods, who had yet to form a contract with Kent, nodded. "We have already recognised your strength, so we will form the contract first."
Morveth smiled and added, "Better to be safe than sorry."
Kent laughed.
He expected to come across mindless beasts in this place. However, from what he has seen so far, all four of them are intelligent beasts.
This, however, makes them super dangerous. So, forming a contract with them while in plain sight works in favor of the three demigods; he also benefits from it.
He produced three [Grim Contracts] and activated them.
The runes flew and merged with them. A minute later, the contracts were formed, and all four of them felt their bodies grow stronger, Kent especially.
[Morveth has become your Contracted Beast]
[Kryzoth has become your Contracted Beast]
[Baelgor has become your Contracted Beast]
However, their shock soon turned grim when a powerful aura suddenly exploded out of Kryzoth’s body, frost spreading all over the domain already made of ice.
Kent and the others jumped up and flew into the air, watching as Kryzoth’s strength rose from Early Demigod to Mid and soon reached High.
Just when it was stabilizing, another wave exploded out of his body, taking him to the Peak Demigod stage.
"This..." Yggzrael and the others were left stunned.
"I knew this bastard had been hiding something from us all this while, but I never expected it to be a second core."
Baelgor saw through Kryzoth’s disguise. In fact, it was quite obvious, considering he had a blue and red icy aura around him.
"It appears Kryzoth has formed two elemental cores alongside his chaos core." Kent smiled, his bones aching to have a proper battle with the sleek-looking demigod with wolf ears and deadly claws.
"This feeling..." Kryzoth examined his body, a smile appearing on his face.
"I can sense that it wouldn’t be long now before I become a Divine Beast." He turned and looked at Kent, then at his buddies, who smiled at him.
"Congratulations, Kryzoth. After we leave this place, I will transfer a technique to you that would aid you in taking advantage of both cores." Kent said, and Kryzoth nodded.
Kent was happy to have found such remarkable subordinates. With the upgrades that have happened to Tower, he can’t wait to utilize them to build his strength.
"For now, let’s fight."
Morveth and Baelgor had also become stronger than before. However, they are still Mid Demigods, two ranks below Kryzoth and Yggzrael.
Kent watched as they got ready.

Yggzrael summoned a staff-like spear. One end is made of a staff head with a glowing blue orb inside, and the other side ends in a razor-sharp piercer. A pair of dragon horns protruded from his forehead, and both his hands and legs ended in deadly claws.
Baelgor summoned a giant hammer, his body transforming into a demi-mammoth. His snout and tusks extended from his face as his arms and legs grew bigger and more muscular.
Kryzoth summoned a sword forged from ice, its deadly blades glimmering with deadly intent.
Finally, Morveth summoned a scythe.
The moment Kent’s eyes landed on the scythe, a feeling of dread enveloped him. ’Hmm, looks like that is a Living Weapon that has yet to awaken.’
Being the owner of two Living Weapons, Kent felt the need not to underestimate Morveth’s weapon.
He smiled and extended his hand, summoning his claws.
When the four demigods saw this, they turned and looked at each other. In their minds, they expected Kent to summon a weapon. However, it appeared he planned on fighting them using just his claws.
"Be careful, guys, I have yet to test my claws in combat."

The moment he said that, Kent became a blur and shot toward Morveth, his claws ready for an attack. However, just when he struck with his hand, Morveth’s body turned into thousands of crows and flew away.
In his place, a giant hammer came striking at Kent’s chest.
Kent reacted quickly, spinning his body to barely evade the terrifying force of the strike. Kent landed on his right leg and spun around, striking with his left foot.
Yggzrael, who wanted to take advantage of the moment by sneaking up on Kent, found his face moving toward a foot.
However, instead of evading, a smile formed on his face, causing Kent to sense something ominous.
The next second, his leg was stopped right in front of Yggzrael’s face; roots made of crystallized ice burst out of the ground and latched onto him.

chapters.title: Chapter 1603: Four vs One (2)
paragraphs: Kent was taken aback by how insidious Yggzrael played his spell.
He silently cast the spell ahead of time and waited for him to fall into the opening he had prepared for him. Kent sensed that, but he still walked in thinking he could overpower him.
Unbeknownst to Kent, while defeating Yggzrael would be easy, now that he is faced against four demigods, Yggzrael grew confident in his abilities to make Kent feel his power.
Also, he wants to prove himself to his new master, which, judging by the angle he had Kent, he had proven all he needed to prove.
But that doesn’t mean he won.
Just when the root tendrils latched onto Kent’s leg, the scales on his armor reformed and turned into razor-sharp blades, cutting through them at once.
His leg was freed, but Yggzrael had long retreated, making way for Baelgor.
"Mammoths Bang,"
His hammer crackled with lightning as it came down hard, falling toward Kent.
Kent raised his left hand to block the hammer, the force behind the stack forcing his legs to buckle, the ground cracking and spiderwebbing everywhere.
’Damn, what a monstrous strength,’
Kent recognized Baelgor’s strength and knew he could not mess around, else he would lose. Pushing the hammer back, his right hand moved, and his claws took a swing at Baelgor’s chest.

He moved back, trying to evade. However, three claw arcs flashed out, landing on his chest. Three cuts appeared, drawing blood as his Baelgor was lunched back, landing several meters on the frigid surface of the icy battlefield.
Kent turns into a blur and appears beside Kryzoth, hoping to test his strength as well. However, he was forced to push back when a crow flew past his side.
Under normal circumstances, he should have ignored that; however, just when the crow flew past him, Morveth appeared, or more like the deadly blades of his scythe appeared before him.
"Frozen Claw" Ice coated Kent’s claws as he grabbed hold of the scythe that was mere inches from his face. The sound of metal scraping against metal spread out.
He was forced back, but Kent smiled and stomped on the ground, forcing out three deadly Ice spears that shot out and landed on Morveth’s chest.
He was sent crashing into a boulder 3km away.
Kent pressed his advantage.
He stomps on the ground again, this time summoning a blizzard. He may not have formed an ice core yet, but he has more than enough ice Qi to power his techniques.
Suddenly, the entire battlefield was filled with a blizzard, forcing Baelgor and Yggzrael to move back.
"Blood Ascension Ice Strike,"

While the two demigods moved back, Kryzoth advanced, and before Kent could find the next target and test more of his skills on them, a terrifying red arc made of ice flashed out, locking onto Kent in an instant.
’Damn...’
Kent felt his back break into a cold sweat as the arc arrived before him. However, rather than panicking, he smiled and tapped into his [Dragon Intent] and channeled some of his Chaos Qi.
Then, like he was courting death, he extended his right hand and caught the red arc, causing shockwaves to spread far and wide.
"WHAT..."
Kryzoth stood frozen, his expression filled with shock.
Even Baelgor, who had turned his head into that of a mammoth, temporarily took on his humanoid face to show his shocked expression.

They all felt the deadly nature of the red arc, so when Kent caught it, they became shocked. However, instead of taking a step back. Kent held the arc for a few seconds before clenching his fist, shattering it into pieces.
"Is that all you got?" Kent taunted Kryzoth, causing the demigod, who was stunned and frozen, to snap back to his senses.
He moved a step back and was about to attack again when the sky crackled with lightning, "Allow me,"
Baelgor came down, his hammer raised for a deadly attack. Looking closely, one could tell the hammerhead had transformed, taking on the look of a tusk.
Kent narrowed his eyes at this and instantly sensed danger.

Reaching into his first Blood gate, he channeled Blood qi and Chaos Qi, causing his claws to gleam wth power. But he didn’t stop there; he also maintained his Dragon Intent and tapped a little bit into his Evil Qi.
Just then, the attack arrived...
"Heavenbreaker Tusks"
Kent raised his right hand, meeting the hammer in a powerful collision of metals.
*BOOOM*
Kent was pushed back, the ground beneath his feet caving in. His hands trembled, numb pain spreading up his shoulder and finally traveling through his body.
Kent stood there a moment before he spat a mouthful of blood.
"That was heavy, Baelgor." Kent smiled and clenched his fist, "But can you handle a fist of mine?"

Kent moves, and Baelgor’s armor transforms, covering his body in bonelike armor. At once, his defense tripled. However, when Kent’s fist connected with his chest, his body shot back, flying several km back.
Yggzrael and the other two demigods pale, seeing Baelgor, the one with the most robust defense, sent flying away like a ragdoll.
However, they didn’t back down, not when they are still not defeated. Kent jumps back, evading a deadly scythe, only for a spear to land on his back, sending him flying toward a sword arc.
Kent flicks his hand and summons a chaos scale shield to block the attack. However, before he could celebrate, a blur appeared on his side.
’Fast...’
He narrowed his eyes, activating all his flame veins. At once, he felt the world slow down, and that was when he saw Morveth coming from his left.
If he had been a second too late to use the flame veins, he would have found himself at the mercy of a deadly scythe.
However, just before Morveth could attack, Kent teleported and appeared before him, grabbing the scythe with one hand and the other landing a punch on Morveth’s chest.

He, too, was sent flying back, perhaps a bit further back than Kent had expected. However, realizing he wouldn’t die even if he wanted to, he turned just in time to evade a root tendril from Yggzrael.
"Frozen Moon Fang,"
Another sword attack came from Kryzoth. But Kent used the [Chaos Scale Shield] to block it. This gave him a wide opening to attack Yggzrael, who wanted to first trap Kent before attacking.
While the battle isn’t being fought at their full strength, considering they aren’t in their Beast forms or even using their domains, every attack unleashed carries great power.
Kent could feel the power behind their attacks.
None of them uses Divine Qi in their attacks, but that alone is enough to kill even Immortal Lords in a single attack.
In fact, Kryzoth’s sword attacks are strong enough to kill an immortal Lord at full strength.
So he wasn’t about to be arrogant and think he had everything under control.
Evading the root tendrils, Kent made his move.
Kent closes in on Yggzrael and grabs him by the shoulder.
"Nice try, buddy," he yanked him forward, but before he could attack, the temperature in the surroundings suddenly dropped, and Kent felt his body slow down.
Turning back, he saw an Ice Yeti suddenly appear out of nowhere, a large pillar made from a metallic substance falling down on him.
For a moment, Kent’s expression turned pale, his spine tingling as a terrible pressure crashed down on him.
However, he snapped out of it and made his move.
He pushes Yggzrael out of the way and summons the Chaos Scales, forming them in a pentagon-shaped shield. They shield his body just in time for the metallic pillar to fall down on him.
*BOOM"
Kent was swallowed by an ice mist, the shockwave pushing Yggzrael and the other demigods back.

chapters.title: Chapter 1604: The White Cataclysm
paragraphs: Being struck by a metallic pillar clearly wasn’t something Kent was prepared for or expected this early into his dreadful mission.
However, he managed to tank the blow, the ground beneath his feet shattering, chunks of ice flying back. The shockwave produced from that blow was enough to send Yggzrael and the others flying back.
Kent pushed the pillar back and, using the [Soul Map], he teleported away.
Because he was hoping to have a good battle with Yggzrael and the others, he chose not to use the Soul Map. Using it would have made him untouchable, unless his opponent had used their domain.
So, to avoid that, he turned it off.
If he hadn’t, perhaps he would have seen this attack coming from a mile away.
Appearing 2 km away, he regarded the monstrosity that had attacked him, and for a moment, his body trembled, not out of fear, but from the thrill of the battle ahead of him.

The attacker was a colossal Ice Yeti standing over forty feet tall, its body packed with pure muscle and crystallized ice. Its body was covered in white fur mixed with jagged black-blue crystalline ice that constantly emitted freezing mist.
’Damn, that is one large motherfucker.’ For a moment, Kent drooled, the craziness in his eyes intensifying. As a chaos beast, this kind of battle is one he has always dreamed of.
’Wait for me, my sweet Elina, big daddy Chaos will be there soon,’ he smiled.
Massive horns curved backward from its skull like frozen mountain peaks, while chains made from glacier steel wrapped around its arms and torso.
One chain was large enough to wrap around a bus and still have enough left to pull it.
Looking deep into its eyes, Kent could see them glow with chaotic blue light that could freeze souls upon contact.

Every step it took caused the ground to crack and freeze for miles. Behind it, a phantom blizzard manifested, howling with an eerie sound, almost as if there were thousands of tormented souls hidden within it.
What took Kent aback were the two metallic pillars shaped like clubs held in both hands. They looked deadly, and the numbing pain in Kent’s hands made it clear he could not underestimate this yeti.
’Finally, a worthy opponent.’
Kent lifted his head and looked back at the colossal yeti. "Who are you, and where did you come from?"
The yeti didn’t reply. Instead, it raised one of the pillars and channeled energy into it. At once, the space around it froze, and ice started spreading toward Kent.
When the ice reached him, his body started to freeze, turning solid all of a sudden. Kent had to channel his chaos qi and flame qi to keep himself from turning into a block of ice.
However, even with the flame and chaos qi empowering him, Kent knew that wouldn’t do.
’Tower, is that [Extreme Ice]?’
[Yes, Master. This yeti has mastered Extreme Ice, so you should be careful.]
Kent turned and looked at his four demigods, who appeared behind him. "Relax, guys, I will take care of this giant."
"Be careful, Master, he is one of the Forbidden ones."
Kent raised his brow, but before he could ask who a Forbidden was, the pillar fell down. Pulling himself back, he activated the [Chaos Scale Shield] and blocked the attack.
Then, with a stamp on the ground, his body was launched up, his fist clenched.
"Take this,"
Blood Qi gathered around Kent’s fist as he struck forward.
"Blood Calamity Fist,"
A large fist, fashioned from blood qi, with the appearance and texture of metal, exploded out, a terrifying force sending it flying toward the yeti.
It crossed the other pillar in front of him just when the Blood Calamity Fist closed in on him.
*BOOM*
The impact pushed him back one step. However, instead of backing down, the yeti stabbed the other pillar toward Kent, hoping to break every bone in his body.
Kent smirked and teleported, appearing on the pillar. Then, with a glide, he closed in on the yeti, his fist poised for another [Blood Calamity Fist] strike.
However, Kent pulled his fist back and rolled, his body sliding across the pillar just when a razor-sharp ice spear stabbed at his shoulder.
Kent was fast enough but a bit slow to evade, so the spear grazed his shoulder, drawing blood.
’That was close,’ Kent managed to lift his body back up and turn to his left, seeing three more spears close in on him.
Using the momentum from his turn, a powerful claw attack flashed out, shattering the first two spears while the third was deflected.
Kent borrowed the shockwave from the explosion to move back, realization dawning on him.
’I cannot fight him up close like this.’ With this discovery, he realized that perhaps he had underestimated the yeti.
Suddenly, a bone-chilling ice spread across the battlefield, and like Kent hadn’t reinforced his body with Flame and Chaos Qi, his legs started to freeze.
[You are under the effect of the White Cataclysm. All your attributes have lost 50% of their power]
Kent felt his body slow down, his strength halved in an instant.
For the first time, Kent felt that danger. The kind of danger that translates to certain death. However, rather than retreating, the will to fight intensified.
He looked at the White Yeti, and a smirk formed on his face. "Using a domain against me won’t give you the win you desire."
[He isn’t using his domain, Master. The White Cataclysm is merely an Immortal Grade technique.]
Before Kent could let the shock appear on his face, two powerful blows closed in on him, one coming from his left and the other from his right.
The Chaos Scale Shield appeared on both sides, blocking the blows. Kent slid through the cracks and flew into the air, his body oozing so much Chaos aura.
Suddenly, his claws turned dark gold, and his eyes flared, a reddish aura seeping out of them. ’Let’s see how powerful you really are.’
*BUZZ*
Dragon wings burst out of Kent’s back, and all 350,000 flame veins activated. But Kent didn’t stop there; he went ahead and activated all 250,000 blood runes.
Suddenly, the debuff’s weakness became insignificant as a new form of power surged through his body. Kent grinned and vanished, turning into a blur.
He moved with so much speed that before the yeti could sense him, over a hundred claw marks were left on it, blood coating its wounds.
Kent was like a tempest of flame, his afterimages manifesting blood silhouettes. Naturally, had it not been for the debuff, the yeti would have struggled to even sense him.
Morveth, who prided himself on his speed, smiled weakly, standing 30 km away with Baelgor, Kryzoth, and Yggzrael. "Now, that is what you call speed."
"Indeed. Even I can’t see him until after he had long passed," Yggzrael replied, his focus rooted on the yeti that kept turning to catch a glimpse of Kent.
Brute-wise, Kent might have struggled in his demihuman form.
However, speed-wise, he is on another level, and this is only after he had formed two flame cores and hadn’t even awakened Lightning Element or even wind yet.
"Do you guys think Master can defeat that monster in the central region?" Baelgor asked, his right leg resting on his hammer head.

"Is that even a question? If the master can dominate a Forbidden, then that bastard is as good as dead. In fact, the question should be whether the master can handle the Four Abominations hidden in the dungeon.
They are the real threat here, not that demon."
As if to prove what Yggzrael said, Kent finally slowed down, causing the mist of ice and fire to subside. When it finally did, a bloody yeti was revealed.
For a moment, it stood on its feet. However, he soon dropped to his knees and used his weapons to support its body.

chapters.title: Chapter 1605: Yeti Unleashed
paragraphs: Kent slowed down and eventually came to a halt. The mist created from running around at increasingly high speeds died down.
His claws were coated in blood, a clear sign that he had indeed done a number on the yeti. However, while the giant beast was forced to drop to its knees, Kent knew it was far from defeated.
Even so, it was at the point where he could have a conversation with it, or so he thought.
Before Kent could say anything, the temperature dropped sharply, instantly freezing everything within a 40 km radius.
Yggzrael and the others had to retreat further back just to evade the bone-biting cold that had filled the space.
Kent, who was at the center of this coldness, exhaled, his breath turning solid in an instant. He felt it, even his soul was being affected by the Extreme Ice.
ROAR
A thunderous roar came from the yeti, causing Kent to feel his soul tremble.
’Soul Attack,’

While his soul immunity stepped in, Kent felt the power behind the attack, and that told him that, had it not been for his immunity to soul attacks, he would have sustained severe injuries from that one roar.
Even with soul immunity, he realized his soul was shaken.
But that put a smile on his face. "Looks like you are a special one, yeti. I wonder how you would wiggle your way out of this one."
Kent grinned, and then his body started to emit faint evil qi. Suddenly, the coldness in the space intensified. He unleashed Evil Qi to counter Yeti’s Extreme Ice.

A bone-chilling ice came from the yeti, but the one coming from Kent was evil ice, the kind that is cultivated from great slaughter. Killing intent itself is made of ice qi, so the evil qi was basically killing intent in its purest yet darkest form.
"Show me what you got, yeti. If I make my move, you would not have the chance to turn things around."
Another roar came from the yeti, but Kent felt nothing this time. The next moment, however, Kent’s right leg slid on the ice, and his body was suddenly pulled forward.
Looking ahead, he saw the yeti’s maw wide open, a terrible sucking force pulling his body forward. Kent narrowed his eyes and tried to resist. However, he soon realized he couldn’t.
’Damn, just what kind of devouring ability is that?’
[It has an abyss-like pocket dimension inside its stomach, Master. If you are devoured, that would be the end.]
Kent narrowed his eyes and assessed his abilities. Suddenly, his dragon tail appeared and transformed, turning into a whip formed from arranged and stacked scales and ending in a razor-sharp piercer.
It moved and stabbed into the ground, instantly locking Kent in place. The yeti tried to pull with all its might, but a few seconds later, it realized it was futile.
Seeing this, it changed tactics, and Kent finally heard it speak.
"World Ending Glacier Fall."
Kent sensed that Yeti had channeled over 40% of its energy into the attack, something that shocked him greatly. To be able to use that much energy, one must possess a very powerful body.
The air on the battlefield died down, causing Kent to turn and look around him. Suddenly, a terrifying pressure fell from the clouds, sending Kent to his knees.
"What in the hell,"
The sky tore open as a gigantic glacier descended from the heavens like a world-ending mountain. Kent instantly felt restricted, his body locking in place by an invisible force.
However, with the circulation of his [Dragon Intent], he broke free.
It was as if that invisible force wasn’t even there. The pressure also lessened. However, Kent could tell the descending glacier would soon add to it. The closer it got, the higher the pressure.
He had to destroy that glacier, or else he risked sustaining critical injuries or retreating. He most certainly would never retreat, so destroying the glacier was the move he needed to make.
However, before he could make a move, a quest appeared.
[You have received a side quest: Fist Master.]
[Quest Level: SSS]
– Objective: [Destroy the World Ending Glacier Fall with your fist.]
– Reward: [10 Abominable Contracts and 10 Forbidden Contracts.]
’Damn,’
Kent felt his back break into sweat. However, he smiled and looked at his right fist.
Up in the air, a 50-meter-wide glacier was falling down at him, and he was expected to destroy it with his mere fist. Naturally, that is impossible, but not to Kent.

He first channeled 10% Flame Qi to coat his arm, making sure all Flame veins assembled around his fist and arm. While he had been using the flame veins to boost his speed, they can also be used for strength and defense.
He then channeled his ice qi to further enhance the flame qi. However, because he had no ice core, there were no runes to harness.
But that is okay, since Kent tapped into his Chaos Qi and channeled just 2% of it. If he tries channeling me, he risks shattering his own hand.
To use more of his Chaos Qi, he first needed to temper his body further. By possessing a robust body, he can use more of his Chaos Qi.
Once the Chaos Qi took effect, Kent felt like he could use just this. However, a part of him wished to go further, else he risked missing an opportunity.

Feeling this, he tapped into his Evil Qi and channeled 5% to further augment his fist. Just when that happened, Kent sensed his unawakened darkness element stir, and shadows on the battlefield moved, augmenting his fist.
’Oh, it seems the darkness and evil qi are meant to be used together.’
The next energy he channeled was Blood Qi. The moment that was channeled, all 250,000 blood runes merged with his fist.
*BUZZ*

His fist vibrated, waves of power oozing from it. For a moment, Kent felt like he could shatter the very heavens with his fist. However, that thought vanished when 5 Blood Life Seals and 5 Blood Death Seals merged with his fist.
If it was shattering the heavens at first, now, he felt like he could shatter the universe.
Kent rose into the air, and his body surged with power. He looked at the yeti and smirked... "Watch how I shatter your glacier,"
With powerful speed, Kent rose into the air, his fist clenched. As he drew closer to the glacier, the pressure from it threatened to push him back down.
However, Kent was determined, and with terrifying speed, he closed in, his fist shooting forward. As it moved, sonic booms were created, showing how devastating the punch was.
Just before his fist struck the glacier, Chaos Scales appeared around it, doubling its terrible power.
*BOOOOOOM*

His fist landed on the glacier, and at once, it exploded, turning into chunks of ice. A powerful shockwave erupted from the explosion, sending Kent falling back down while Morveth and the others were blown away.
Yeti, however, coughed a mouthful of blood and fell back. It did not pass out, but it became weakened, severely weakened.
The chunks of ice fell, some crashing hard and creating craters, while others merely slid across the ground.
One chunk fell toward the yeti; however, Kent blasted it away, making sure the poor brute wasn’t accidentally killed.
Kent landed back on the ground and rolled to break his fall.
When he regained his stance, streaks of blood could be seen on his right arm, a clear sign that he hadn’t walked away unscathed.
[You have completed your side quest: Fist Master. Rewards have been distributed]
[Congratulations, you have created a new skill: Universe Breaking Fist]
[Universe Breaking Fist]
[Rank: God]
[Description: A fist forged from the union of several energies. One punch is enough to shatter the heavens and break the universe.]
Additional Buff: Fist EX
↠ Fist EX: When activated, your fist becomes 10 times stronger and more sturdy. You can regulate this buff.
"Well, I will be damned."

chapters.title: Chapter 1606: Divine Beast Tamer - New Aspect
paragraphs: Kent made a fist, feeling an overwhelming force move through his arm. For a moment, he let himself be lost in the power coursing through his veins.
’This power, is there anyone below the god grade that can take a punch from me?’
[Of course, there are plenty. However, if we factor in five things about you, then I don’t even know what would become of you.]
Tower responded, causing Kent to furrow his brow.
Yeti is down, its energy severely drained after using the glacier attack.
While he isn’t at the point where he cannot continue the battle, for some reason, when Kent destroyed his glacier, he was struck with a terrible backlash that knocked him down.
Seeing he wouldn’t be rising back up anytime soon, Kent decided to engage Tower for now.
"What are those five things, Tower?"
[First, you are only a True Immortal. That means your strength is still being limited by your cultivation base. What do you think would happen if you reach the Demigod stage?
Second, the idea is to merge several energies together using your fist as the medium. Now, you only have access to Chaos Qi, Evil Qi, Blood Qi, and Flame Qi.

While you managed to use Dark Qi and Ice Qi, I think we both know they did little to nothing in the grand scheme of the skill. However, what happens when you awaken those two and other elements later?

Third, there is your Primal Blood Platform. Right now, you have two blood gates, which means you can form two cores of each element or energy. What happens if you awaken all nine Blood Gates? Nine cores for each element.

Fourth, the blood seals currently come from two blood cores. But as I said, you are destined to awaken nine blood gates, which means you will form nine blood cores. What happens when you can harness the power of over a million blood seals?

Fifth, from what I have observed, your Blood Life and Blood Death Seals also seem to have contributed greatly. At the moment, you have only 25 of each. But we both know it is only a matter of time before you form more.
In fact, there are even your Chaos Scales, Dragon Intent, Sword Intent, and several other energies you can channel or have an affinity for.
If I am not mistaken, the [Universe Breaking Fist] has the capability to evolve to the Supreme and maybe even the Celestial stage.

If that is not enough reason to consider the current monstrous nature of your skill, then I don’t know what is. I dont want to blow my own horn, but as a true primordial, what happens when you manage to make a Primordial grade technique?]
Kent only held a smile on his face as he finally assessed the kind of power he currently possesses. The kind of power he alone commands is enough to put him at the top of every ranking.
He may have appeared on three Dao tablets and even seemed to have drawn the attention of powerful people. However, that exposure is nothing compared to the kind of power he now holds.
"If people learn of my current capabilities, they are going to claw their eyes out,"
Kent threw his head back and unleashed a heartwarming yet thunderous laugh, the kind that made his four demigod beast companions wonder what had gotten into their master.
Even Yeti, who was supposed to be in a half-conscious state, seemed to have snapped back to life.
"Damn, this time around, I will show the Void Beasts the kind of monster they have offended,"
Somewhere at the heart of the universe, a smile formed on Lady Universe’s face for a brief moment.
Kent lowered his gaze and looked at Yeti, who looked back at him.
Just then, a quest popped up before his vision again.
"Looks like after your upgrade, more quests started flooding in, Tower," Kent muttered before accepting the mission.
[You have received a side quest: First Forbidden Beast Companion.]
[Quest Level: SS]
– Objective: [Make Yeti your first Forbidden beast companion]
– Reward: [The Secret Manual, Ten Divine Eye Secret Art & The Undead Pagoda]
Kent smiled, reading the quest. It seemed simple enough, yet the rewards made it seem as though it could not be cleared easily.
Looking down, he saw Yeti had already started gathering energy. It appeared it hadn’t had enough of the beating Kent had given it.
Kent pondered what to do. If they fought again, he would simply use the [Claw Art], which he could not guarantee would end well for Yeti.
So he wanted a calmer way to ensure that he and Yeti reached a good agreement, not a forced one.
He could tell that the irrational being he expected might be the Yeti before him now. From the moment they clashed, Kent sensed the primal feeling all monsters shared.
Yeti doesn’t have the calm and humane feeling he sensed from Yggzrael and the others.
There was more to learn, but that could wait.
Suddenly, an idea popped into his mind. "Tower, use one of these orbs that appeared under the Bloodline Skill Tree. You said they are related to Beast Taming right? Use one please."
A few seconds later, a message flared before Kent’s vision.
[You have awakened a new Divine Beast Tamer Aspect: Tamer]
[Tamer]
[Rank: Innate]
[Rating: 4 Star]
[Description: Beasts and monsters that share destiny with you find your presence comforting. You are likely to sense some kinship between you and the beast or monster.]
On the ground, Yeti suddenly felt a connection with Kent, one that made it pause and stop channeling its energy.
Kent felt the same thing. He and Yeti shared a destiny.
"Looks like we have to take a step back and have a nice conversation," Yeti growled, a wave of ice energy oozing out of its body as it looked menacingly at Kent.
"Fighting me would not end well for you. I have already defeated you twice, so it would be in your best interest to at least take a step back. You can already sense that I mean you no harm.
If you want me to prove myself, I will. However, know this, when it comes to life or death, killing you would be very simple."
Kent thought for a moment and then decided to prove himself.

"If you don’t believe me, why don’t you look up?" As he said that, he pointed upward, and from the clouds, ten meteors bathed in flames broke through the thick black sky, the ground trembling as they descended.

Yeti growled again, its body trembling. The force from the ten meteors pressed down on it. Kent made sure all ten meteors locked onto it directly, meaning all ten would strike it no matter where it moved.
It was one of the abilities he had awakened after his soul universe expanded upon becoming an Immortal.
Thankfully, another ability called [Soul Recall] had awakened, so just when the pressure became more severe on Yeti, Kent snapped his finger, and the ten meteors vanished into thin air.
Yeti dropped to one knee, its eyes locked on Kent. Now, a sense of fear was evident in them.
Kent smiled and said, "Like I said, it would be good if we can have a nice conversation like two adults who share a common goal."
"And that is?" Yeti spoke, waves of ice mist spreading from its body, freezing the already frozen ground.
"For starters, we can address the fact that you have yet to awaken your innate body."
"I am a Forbidden. Innate bodies aren’t something my kind can awaken."
"Naturally, not. However, with the right pill, you can become a monster unlike any you ever dreamed of."

chapters.title: Chapter 1607: Forbidden & Abominations
paragraphs: "You are kidding, right?" Instead of Yeti asking the question, it came from Yggzrael, who landed softly on the ground, with Baelgor, Kryzoth, and Morveth following swiftly.
Kent turned to them and answered, "I don’t joke about stuff like this. There are indeed pills that can give a Forbidden an innate body."
"But... but that is impossible," Morveth intervened, causing Kent to raise his brow.
"Why is it impossible?"

"Pills, from what I know, can only be found in the world outside this place." Morveth paused and took a deep breath before asking, "If you know that and even claim you can help this Forbidden, does it mean you are from the world outside?"
Kent smirked, "Yes and no."
He didn’t expect them to actually have this assumption. In his mind, he expected them to say pills don’t work on Forbidden Beasts, that their tainted blood cannot assimilate well with innate bodies.
However, hearing them question whether he is from the world outside was new.

"Yes, I am from the outside world; however, that is not where I live. I came to that world on a mission, and part of the mission brought me here. That said, I can indeed turn a forbidden into a True Forbidden using a pill."
The four demigods and Yeti could only look at Kent in disbelief.
Finally, it all made sense to them. His ridiculous strength, coupled with the fact that he is a Monarch but isn’t from the Abyss or Chaos, now makes sense.

"By the way, why are you a forbidden? The last I checked, only tainted beasts become forbidden. Someone with Chaos Qi running through your body shouldn’t be tainted, no matter how powerful the poison was."
During the era of Lord Genesis, Jest encountered a few forbidden beings on his many missions, some wielding powers he even ran from.
He had no idea what they were made of or what made them that way, but he knew they were tainted by something.
He fought and killed many; however, even before he fell, there were a few forbidden beings that even he had never dreamt of facing in battle.

What Kent didn’t know was that billions of years after Jest died, a beast tamer rose, and for the first time, the terrifying forbidden beasts were finally brought under one command, turning them into his strength.
Yeti remained quiet, a part of him at a loss for what to even say. It had just occurred to him that he had no idea how he had become forbidden.
Thankfully, Yggzrael knew something, so he revealed it.
"If what I know is correct, then I think the forbidden and abominations came about due to an experiment conducted by a deranged Celestial several hundred thousand years ago."
"Hold on for a moment... what is an Abomination?"
Kent’s expression changed, a part of him wondering just why this simple visit to the tormented Chaos Abyss seemed to reveal so many things.
First forbidden, now abominations.
Yggzrael smiled, "The Forbidden beasts were a more sane outcome of that experiment. Their blood was tainted and twisted to make them powerful, yet, in a way, monsters.
The abominations, however, are monsters that nobody wished to face.
To explain, Forbidden are chaos beasts that had been brainwashed and augmented using dark arts and some twisted ancient wisdom. They are sane, but insanely powerful and a bit uncontrollable.

Abominations, however, are insane beasts with power so dangerous that not even you can hold your own against them. Even if all demigods in the four regions were to gather, I doubt we could handle just one abomination.
I learned that at first there were over a hundred of them. However, they fought and killed one another, devouring their kills until only four remained.

Perhaps, seeing his experiment succeed or fail, the man who created them sealed them in dungeons. I honestly don’t know to what extent their power went, but the strongest demigod ruling the Central region wouldn’t dare face them in battle."
Yggzrael sighed, "In the past, some of the monarchs from the Chaos Region tried to kill the four abominations but were slaughtered instead."
Even Yeti was taken aback by the abominations’ power.
Just then, a message appeared before Kent.
[You have received a side quest: Master of Abominations.]
[Quest Level: SSS]
– Objective: [Kill all Four Abominations and revive them using the abomination contract to become your Abominable subordinates.]
– Reward: [The Revenge of the 14 Sirens, Volume I]
Kent looked at Yeti and smiled. Then he waved his hand, and a Tier 17 innate talent awakening pill appeared. On his other palm, a forbidden contract appeared.

"Become my first forbidden Beast companion, and not only would I make you a True Forbidden, something your creator never could, but I would also make you a monarch and one of the strongest Beasts this world had ever seen.
I plan to start with awakening your Innate body."
The light in Yeti’s eyes widened. In the end, however, he nodded and allowed Kent to initiate the contract. Soon, runes came from the contract and merged with Yeti and Kent.

At the same time the contract was initiated, somewhere outside the Tormented Chaos Abyss, a man seated behind a dark grimoire suddenly snapped his head to his left, a furious look appearing in his eyes.
"Who dares mess with my creation?"

This man, someone who, during the Dark Era, had faced the Evil King in combat but lost, growled, his furious tone causing thousands of powerful Celestials to appear in the air around the bone castle he was inside.

His name is Grand Dark Lich Barnabas, one of the seven Grand Rulers of the Star Realm. Under him are exactly 1,200 Celestials, and millions of others, supremes, gods, demigods, and immortals, each a force to be reckoned with.
"My lord, what has happened?" a Celestial with three red eyes on the right side of his face and three green on the left asked.
"Someone touched a minion of mine and has taken them off my network of forbidden beings."
"WHAT?" the Celestials exclaimed, their aura flaring.
"Who dares steal from the Grand Dark Lich?"
"My lord, where is this vile crime committed? I would like to go there and eradicate this filth."
Grand Dark Lich Barnabas shook his head.

"You can’t. After that bastard sealed the Three Heavens, descending to the lower heavens became difficult. To go down there, I suspect it would take you 30 years and a lot of energy. By then, this person would have long left."
"Then are we going to let them walk away?"
Grand Dark Lich Barnabas smirked, "That would be an insult to my reputation." An evil look appeared in his eyes, causing the gathered Celestials to smile.
This smile only appeared when their leader had done something vile and evil.
"I have already issued an order to all forbidden beings in that place to hunt this person down. Aside from them, I have activated my first, second, and third perfect creations."
"As expected of the Grand Dark Lich Barnabas," the Celestials laughed, some of them already seeing the person who dared steal a forbidden from their leader dead and dismantled.
What none of them expected, however, was that in no time, their Grand Dark Lich would shed tears of blood.

What they didn’t know was that, while Kent hadn’t planned to go wild, after he made Yeti his forbidden beast companion, one of the rewards of that quest would reveal something that would make Kent’s blood boil.
Due to this, his suppressed anger would erupt, and with it, the Tormented Chaos Abyss would feel his fury.

sentences.text: "You are kidding, right?" Instead of Yeti asking the question, it came from Yggzrael, who landed softly on the ground, with Baelgor, Kryzoth, and Morveth following swiftly.
Kent turned to them and answered, "I don’t joke about stuff like this.
There are indeed pills that can give a Forbidden an innate body."
"But... but that is impossible," Morveth intervened, causing Kent to raise his brow.
"Why is it impossible?"

"Pills, from what I know, can only be found in the world outside this place." Morveth paused and took a deep breath before asking, "If you know that and even claim you can help this Forbidden, does it mean you are from the world outside?"
Kent smirked, "Yes and no."
He didn’t expect them to actually have this assumption.
In his mind, he expected them to say pills don’t work on Forbidden Beasts, that their tainted blood cannot assimilate well with innate bodies.
However, hearing them question whether he is from the world outside was new.
"Yes, I am from the outside world; however, that is not where I live.
I came to that world on a mission, and part of the mission brought me here.
That said, I can indeed turn a forbidden into a True Forbidden using a pill."
The four demigods and Yeti could only look at Kent in disbelief.
Finally, it all made sense to them.
His ridiculous strength, coupled with the fact that he is a Monarch but isn’t from the Abyss or Chaos, now makes sense.
"By the way, why are you a forbidden?
The last I checked, only tainted beasts become forbidden.
Someone with Chaos Qi running through your body shouldn’t be tainted, no matter how powerful the poison was."
During the era of Lord Genesis, Jest encountered a few forbidden beings on his many missions, some wielding powers he even ran from.
He had no idea what they were made of or what made them that way, but he knew they were tainted by something.
He fought and killed many; however, even before he fell, there were a few forbidden beings that even he had never dreamt of facing in battle.

What Kent didn’t know was that billions of years after Jest died, a beast tamer rose, and for the first time, the terrifying forbidden beasts were finally brought under one command, turning them into his strength.
Yeti remained quiet, a part of him at a loss for what to even say.
It had just occurred to him that he had no idea how he had become forbidden.
Thankfully, Yggzrael knew something, so he revealed it.
"If what I know is correct, then I think the forbidden and abominations came about due to an experiment conducted by a deranged Celestial several hundred thousand years ago."
"Hold on for a moment... what is an Abomination?"
Kent’s expression changed, a part of him wondering just why this simple visit to the tormented Chaos Abyss seemed to reveal so many things.
First forbidden, now abominations.
Yggzrael smiled, "The Forbidden beasts were a more sane outcome of that experiment.
Their blood was tainted and twisted to make them powerful, yet, in a way, monsters.
The abominations, however, are monsters that nobody wished to face.
To explain, Forbidden are chaos beasts that had been brainwashed and augmented using dark arts and some twisted ancient wisdom.
They are sane, but insanely powerful and a bit uncontrollable.
Abominations, however, are insane beasts with power so dangerous that not even you can hold your own against them.
Even if all demigods in the four regions were to gather, I doubt we could handle just one abomination.
I learned that at first there were over a hundred of them.
However, they fought and killed one another, devouring their kills until only four remained.
Perhaps, seeing his experiment succeed or fail, the man who created them sealed them in dungeons.
I honestly don’t know to what extent their power went, but the strongest demigod ruling the Central region wouldn’t dare face them in battle."
Yggzrael sighed, "In the past, some of the monarchs from the Chaos Region tried to kill the four abominations but were slaughtered instead."
Even Yeti was taken aback by the abominations’ power.
Just then, a message appeared before Kent.
[You have received a side quest: Master of Abominations.]
[Quest Level: SSS]
– Objective: [Kill all Four Abominations and revive them using the abomination contract to become your Abominable subordinates.]
– Reward: [The Revenge of the 14 Sirens, Volume I]
Kent looked at Yeti and smiled.
Then he waved his hand, and a Tier 17 innate talent awakening pill appeared.
On his other palm, a forbidden contract appeared.

"Become my first forbidden Beast companion, and not only would I make you a True Forbidden, something your creator never could, but I would also make you a monarch and one of the strongest Beasts this world had ever seen.
I plan to start with awakening your Innate body."
The light in Yeti’s eyes widened.
In the end, however, he nodded and allowed Kent to initiate the contract.
Soon, runes came from the contract and merged with Yeti and Kent.

At the same time the contract was initiated, somewhere outside the Tormented Chaos Abyss, a man seated behind a dark grimoire suddenly snapped his head to his left, a furious look appearing in his eyes.
"Who dares mess with my creation?"

This man, someone who, during the Dark Era, had faced the Evil King in combat but lost, growled, his furious tone causing thousands of powerful Celestials to appear in the air around the bone castle he was inside.
His name is Grand Dark Lich Barnabas, one of the seven Grand Rulers of the Star Realm.
Under him are exactly 1,200 Celestials, and millions of others, supremes, gods, demigods, and immortals, each a force to be reckoned with.
"My lord, what has happened?" a Celestial with three red eyes on the right side of his face and three green on the left asked.
"Someone touched a minion of mine and has taken them off my network of forbidden beings."
"WHAT?" the Celestials exclaimed, their aura flaring.
"Who dares steal from the Grand Dark Lich?"
"My lord, where is this vile crime committed?
I would like to go there and eradicate this filth."
Grand Dark Lich Barnabas shook his head.
"You can’t.
After that bastard sealed the Three Heavens, descending to the lower heavens became difficult.
To go down there, I suspect it would take you 30 years and a lot of energy.
By then, this person would have long left."
"Then are we going to let them walk away?"

This smile only appeared when their leader had done something vile and evil.

Aside from them, I have activated my first, second, and third perfect creations."
"As expected of the Grand Dark Lich Barnabas," the Celestials laughed, some of them already seeing the person who dared steal a forbidden from their leader dead and dismantled.
What none of them expected, however, was that in no time, their Grand Dark Lich would shed tears of blood.

What they didn’t know was that, while Kent hadn’t planned to go wild, after he made Yeti his forbidden beast companion, one of the rewards of that quest would reveal something that would make Kent’s blood boil.
Due to this, his suppressed anger would erupt, and with it, the Tormented Chaos Abyss would feel his fury.

chapters.title: Chapter 1608: The Secret Manual
paragraphs: [The forbidden contract had been successfully signed.]
[Assimilation: 30%]
[The more you assimilate with your beast companion, the more benefits you both share.]
[You must name your forbidden beast companion to unlock their evolution path]
Kent sensed a much deeper connection with Yeti. This connection, in some ways, even felt much stronger than the ones he had formed with Yggzrael and the others.

It is clear to him that perhaps forbidden contracts are much more powerful compared to grim contracts, or maybe this was due to Yeti being stronger than the Chaos Beasts he formed the Grim Contract with.
However, he could tell that naming Yeti would further strengthen the connection.

’Calling a Yeti a Yeti sounds like terrible naming. I’d better find a good name for him,’ Kent began to think, but as if there had been a name prepared already, a rather good name popped up in his head.
He had no idea where the name came from, but he felt it would suit Yeti like how Kaizo’s name suited him.
"From today onwards, your name shall be Kharvok,"
Just as Kent said that, he felt Kharvok’s connection to him fully form, and that was when his soul grew much stronger and denser.
’Damn,’
[Congratulations, your forbidden beast named Kharvok has unlocked his evolution potentials.]
[Evolution Potential]
↠ Bloodline: Supreme Frost Chaos Devourer (Incomplete)
↠ True Forbidden (Incomplete)
↠ Innate Body (Incomplete)
↠ Bloodline Monarch: 30%
[Complete this evolution potential to unlock the next evolution potential]
Kent nodded at this.
The potentials that Kharvok is destined to reach aren’t static. If, after he becomes a True Forbidden with a supreme-grade bloodline, there is another evolution potential he must tackle.
That alone is enough to show the kind of monster Kent now has under his belt.
"Here, take this and swallow it. Having you as a 40-foot-tall Yeti is cool, but I want a much more human appearance to make things easier."
Kent tossed the pill to Kharvok with a smile on his face.
The reason he always made it a must to ensure his beasts had humanoid bodies was the benefits that come with humanoid forms.

While the true beast body is always the strongest, a human body makes it easier to adapt to society. Inside the tower, he may have it easy with the people there, since they know none of the beasts would devour them.
But what about outside? How would people treat a forbidden as large as Kharvok walking among them?
Kharvok swallowed the pill, and Kent nodded in satisfaction.
He turned to the other four. "Once Kharvok is done awakening his innate body, we will head over to the Western Region and have a talk with the demigods there."
They nodded, and Kent walked to the side and sat down. Then, reaching into his storage, he pulled out a manual with a black, tattered cover.
On the black cover, barely visible, a text read, "Secret accounts recovered and preserved by the unknown writer."
’Unknown writer, who is that,’
He didn’t think much about that and simply flipped to the first page and started to read...

"This is the account of what happened after my one and true Evil King left the Star Realm to fight the unknown horrors of the universe. My name is irrelevant; however, whoever reads this manual should know that the peace built by the Evil King had fractured and would deteriorate over time.

"When the Evil King created the Three Heavens, finally bringing peace to the Star Realm, everyone expected those with large egos to continue to abide by his rules. Of course, for a moment they did, but then the spark that signified the eternal life of the Evil King dimmed, and with that, they grew horns and wings.

"Seven Grand Rulers were selected, but only three remained loyal. They remember the benevolence of the Evil King and, to date, follow his rules. The other four had declared their stance and, over the years, had committed all kinds of crimes to maintain their rule.
"Here is an account of the one who calls himself Grand Dark Lich Banabas, a mad scientist and the leader of a chimeric race.

"Grand Dark Lich Banabas believed that only by creating the perfect race could there ever be true peace in the universe. He never believed the star race was at its peak potential, so he sought to correct that.

"This led him to create the Forbidden Qi, an unknown power whose origin nobody knew. His intelligence is commendable; however, he channeled it into something darker and more unethical, resulting in the birth of the first forbidden.

Their arrival made him happy and more ambitious, so he went further, making sure the forbidden became better and more deadly. From his point of view, only by possessing no weakness can one truly be perfect.

Eventually, he succeeded in creating the first True Forbidden, one capable of wielding great power. His success birthed the first True Forbiddens, who would later aid in his conquest across many banished realms.
Later, after his forbidden grew increasingly powerful, he created the Abominations as his ultimate force. They were beings created for battle and nothing else.
Unfortunately for him, the abominations weren’t as accepting as the forbidden. So they rebelled, and he was forced to seal them.

However, by sealing them, he had inadvertently locked a ticking time bomb that would one day swallow the Star Realm whole. Rumor has it he is working toward reclaiming them one day after they have undergone the evolutions many call the Corruption.
If a forbidden can become a True Forbidden, then an Abomination has the potential to become a Corrupted.
Others tried to stop him, but they failed. However, one thing is certain: until all abominations and forbidden beasts are dealt with, the realm will know no peace.
Lord Evil King had worked to bring us peace, but in his absence, we shattered that peace, and now we are back to where we were before he came, just that this time, we have mad men running the show.

If you are reading this and believe you can contribute to eradicating all the forbidden and abominations, visit the Banished Realms and try your luck. I wish you all success in your endeavor, and may the darkness of the Evil King shine on you all."

Kent closed the manual, closed his eyes, and took a deep breath. When he opened them again, waves of killing intent flashed across them, causing his four demigod beast companions to turn and look at him with puzzled expressions.
Inwardly, Kent seethes with anger.

’That bastard, I knew he was up to something when I smacked his face in the last time,’ Images of when the Ruthless Bandit fought seven Celestials at the same time, when he was merely a Supreme, and defeated them all flashed through his mind.

’To think he was responsible for all these things,’ a smile formed on Kent’s face, one filled with evil intentions. ’Good. This is good. I will make sure this time around, he feels the greatest kind of pain his soul would abandon him even during reincarnation.’
Seated in his bone tower, Grand Dark Lich Banabas trembled, sweat forming on his forehead.
Kent sighed and was about to check the second reward [Ten Divine Eye Secret Art] when a quest appeared before his eyes again.
Kent clearly didn’t expect the quests to come this often.
What he didn’t know was that, back in his universe, his legion, currently on the 16th floor of the Planet Killer Dungeon, had already received over 10 side quests, each with amazing rewards.
That unofficial upgrade Tower went through clearly wasn’t as simple as he thought.
[You have received a quest: Master of the Forbiddens.]
[Quest Level: SSS]
– Objective: [There are 24 forbidden beasts you have kinship with in this layer. Find all and make them your subordinates. Kill the others and absorb their blood essence]
– Reward: [First Evil Key]
Kent’s eyes widened.

chapters.title: Chapter 1609: An Opportunity
paragraphs: Reading the reward for the quest again, Kent could still not believe his eyes.
Clearly, he must be seeing it wrong.

One of the overpowered changes that occurred within his soul sea after he broke through to the Immortal stage was the 24 coffins said to hold the bodies of the 24 Grand Shamans of the Unknown Universe.
According to what Kent already knew, thanks to recovering the Ruthless Bandit’s memories, when the Unknown Universe formed, it brought forth 24 Grand Shamans, beings of unknown measure.
The Queen of Evil knew little about them. But according to her, these beings had already reached the rank of Ancient Evil, two ranks above her.
Kent is only at the first rank, which is the True Evil rank. However, after this rank, there is the Great Evil, Cursed Evil, Unholy Evil, Tyrant Evil, Supreme Evil, and finally Ancient Evil.

"These 24 Elders were the ones who carved the foundation of my race and protected us for billions of years before that ambitious Evil King colluded with the creatures of the beyond, sealed them, and banished them.
If one day you come across just a fragment of their legacy, thank your lucky stars. I cannot even begin to tell you what I, a Tyrant Evil, am capable of, much less an Ancient Evil."

Those were the words the Queen of Evil said to the Ruthless Bandit when he asked about the Grand Shamans. Now, Kent not only has the coffins of all 24 of them, but in a couple of weeks, he might just end up awakening one of them.
’I don’t even know how to feel right now,’ Kent said inwardly, a part of him feeling very impatient.
He had just read that the hierarchy he created before leaving the Star Realm had shattered. Initially, he believed the Evil King’s influence still remained in all Three Heavens.

However, it became clear to him when he discovered that only the Skull Race, now an evil race, still had him in their hearts. The rest in all seven gateways had abandoned him. Even in the first heavens, only one race still held him in their heart.
This meant the second and third heavens had long since abandoned him and his rule.
A part of him wanted to let them be. However, after he rationalized and started thinking straight, he knew that leaving them to do as they pleased would be bad for the outside universe.

The star beasts aren’t dead. Even now, the Infinity Universe is being invaded from time to time as the seals that bind them in the star gateway weaken. If that is allowed to continue, in a few years’ time, the Infinity Universe would be invaded again, and the entire universe would plunge into chaos.
He doesn’t want that to happen, not when the Dark Queen, perhaps now an Empress, and her fiends, among other horrors, remain at large.
So his soul warriors are making sure all-star beasts in the Lower Heaven are dealt with and converted into beings he would have absolute control over.
The only problem was that once they conquered the Lower Heaven, moving to the High Heaven and the Supreme Heaven would be difficult.
He doesn’t have the power to face gods, Supremes, and Celestials at the moment. There is a chance he may even encounter Pseudo-Primordials.
He and his subordinates cannot handle those kinds of odds.
However, everything changes if he were to awaken a Grand Shaman and put him or her in charge of conquering the Star Realm and other banished realms like the Tormented Chaos Abyss.
’The possibilities are endless.’
Kent made a fist and smiled. He looked at the quest again.

’24 forbidden beasts, huh. I already have Kharvok, meaning there are 23 more to go. As for the others, I would surely be happy to commit a massacre. After all, I need blood Essence.’ Kent formed some plans in his head, and a roadmap was drawn.
’Tower, purchase Bloodline Tempering Pills and Foundation Strengthening Pills for four people.’ Kent planned on making his four Grim-contracted beasts strong enough to carry out a mission for him.
Plans had changed, and so he must adapt.
[This might be the best time to tell the master that he owes me billions in Tower Points.]
’What? When did I use my 97 billion Tower Points?’ Kent’s eyes widened. Before leaving for the mission, he checked his Tower Points, and he had close to a hundred billion.
So far, he had used less than a million. So where did the rest go?

[Goddess Vexthra and the other legion members made some purchases that involved borrowing from me. Since what they required was important, I allowed them to owe me. Now, I believe the master owes me 112 billion Tower Points.
However, since the master needs these pills, I will add them to his tab, and when the master is out of here, we will make arrangements on how to pay me back.]

Kent could only remain seated there, his expression a bit dark. He wasn’t angry, just worried that something major might have happened, and his wives had no choice but to spend that much on a treasure.
’I need to hurry,’
Taking a deep breath, he told Tower to purchase the pills. Afterward, he handed them over to the four demigods with whom he had signed the Grim Contract.
"Eat these pills. When you’re done, I have missions for you."
They nodded and started to cultivate the pills.

Since it had come down to this, Kent knew he had to assign one of the quests to these Grim-contracted beasts. Since he must handle both the forbidden and abominations, he knew he had to assign the rest of the demigods to his other contracted beasts.
At the end of the day, it was either they submit or they die. Kent didn’t want them to die, but he also trusted and believed that even if they died, they would still be his.
His Necromancy class had been dormant for a while now.
It wasn’t because he couldn’t create more undead; it was just that he had no reason to do so. The Planet Killer Dungeon wasn’t difficult enough to pose a threat to his legion, so he lets them be.
Now, however, Kent sensed something bad was about to happen, and so he was being pushed to amass an army.
Before coming to the Star Realm, he believed he was here to fight his way to Elina. While that was true, he now realized there was a much bigger threat he had to handle first.
’I don’t know what is coming, but I pray that when it arrives, I will have the strength and army to handle it.’
Kent turned toward Kharvok and saw he was already halfway through his innate body awakening. Once he is done, his strength would double.
Kent planned to go with him to hunt down the other forbidden and make them his contracted beasts. Once that is handled, he will proceed to the Central Region and deal with the demon there.

Becoming a Sword Divine requires him to attain Absolute Heavenly Sword Energy and kill the Crimson Blood Demon General. Attaining the Absolute Heavenly Sword Energy is possible and quite easy, really.
He had witnessed someone use it before during his life as the Ruthless Bandit. So he would be learning it before meeting that demon.
Once he defeats it and becomes a Sword Divine, the four abominations would be next. Since they are a terror, per what Yggzrael said, then he must prepare well to meet them.
Kent moved away from his beast, currently cultivating, and retrieved a small black pagoda. It was very small; however, Kent knew it had to be awakened first before it would function.
’Tower...’
[The master is required to add a drop of his blood essence to awaken the Undead Pagoda.]
