This made him think of Grand Dark Lich Barnabas. ’I will thank him first, then take everything from him before killing him,’ Kent laughed inwardly.
The new [Omniscent Jade Eye] can see 2 seconds into the future.
While many may see 2 seconds as short, in a high-speed battle, 2 seconds might as well be 2 minutes.
A lot can happen in two seconds, and so Kent knew that with how vast his soul sea was, he would abuse this power, especially against powerful opponents.
Seeing how many sword attacks would happen in the next 2 seconds, and creating a counter for them would come in handy for sure.
He spent some more time examining the Omniscient Jade Eye.
When he had had enough, he stopped and focused on learning the [Absolute Sword Energy].
With his comprehension speed, learning wasn’t too hard.
It took less than 30 minutes to fully comprehend it.
The moment he unlocked [Absolute Sword Energy], his sword intent and Sword Aura had become much stronger, bringing a smile to his face.
He felt a bit safe knowing he was walking into the battle with his swordsmanship at a level he could not move beyond unless he defeated his opponent.
Two and a half days later, Kent and Kharvok arrived in the Central Region.
The moment they crossed the border and entered the Central Region, Kent felt some of his power sealed.
He could sense most of his trump cards, such as [Finger of Destruction], [Claw Art], his dragon abilities, and most of the Soul Universe abilities, being restricted.
He retained his sword skills and techniques, along with abilities like Chaos Scale Shield, Soul Map, and others, which he believed did not violate the rules of swordsmanship.
Feeling himself made to wield only his swordsmanship skills made him smile slyly, but he said nothing.
He was already aware of this before coming, so he had prepared.
It would be a battle between a Sword Immortal and a Sword Emperor.
While Kent had yet to reach the Sword Divine and Sword Legend stages, he had reasons to believe he wasn’t limited at all.
The only downside was using a sword realm against a sword domain.
He had faced such odds in the past and knew just how frustrating it was.
However, if he managed to take advantage of his opponent’s domain, they would be able to have a good battle.
Kent and Kharvok started making their way through the Central Region, heading toward the core.
They met no beasts, a sign that told them this region was only populated by one person, and that was the demon Kent came to kill.
A few hours after arriving in the Central Region, Kent and Kharvok came to a stop, their focus locked on a lone figure standing atop a small hill 2 km away.
"Looks like he found us, Kharvok," Kent said, a calm smile playing on his lips.
For a moment, he took his time to have a good look at the mountain of a demon he was meant to kill using nothing but his sword.
The Crimson Blood Demon General possessed a towering demonic stature, standing over 3 meters tall.
Kent couldn’t determine exactly how tall he stood, but he knew no normal being should be that tall.
Even in his dragon form, Kent only became a few inches taller than in his humanoid form.
This demon was already a few feet taller than a normal demon.
His skin was dark crimson, covered in black, glowing demonic veins that pulsed like molten lava beneath his flesh.
Two massive twisted black horns curved backwards from his skull, while chains forged from cursed bloodsteel hung from his shoulders and waist.
His glowing scarlet eyes burned like dying suns, radiating terrifying killing intent as he locked eyes with Kent.
The Chaos Dragon felt like this gaze alone was enough to kill him.
’Killing this demon would be very difficult.’ Kent wasn’t mistaken; he could indeed tell this might be that one opponent every swordsman dreaded ever meeting.

What made him wonder whether this battle was arranged to see if he could grow past Lord Genesis talent as a swordsman was the large, torn wings made of condensed blood energy that spread behind the demon, constantly dripping crimson particles into the air.
It would be both a land and aerial battle, one that would determine many aspects of combat.
’Winning will surely give me the confidence to challenge powerful foes later,’ Kent resolved himself, knowing the time had come.
"Kharvok, buddy, this battle is between me and this demon.
I brought you so you can stand guard against any unknown intruders that may try to sneak up on us.
You have my permission to use every means necessary to kill them."
Kharvok nodded.
"Good luck, Young Lord."
"I indeed need luck, don’t I?" Kent jested and took flight, his wings unfurling behind him.
He had no reason to keep standing there.
The Crimson Blood Demon General saw him move, and he also took flight.
A few seconds later, they stood in the air 200 meters apart.
"So you were the one who took what doesn’t belong to you." The Crimson Blood Demon General’s eyes snapped toward Kharvok, who had moved 10 km away, before turning back to Kent.
"Do you know the kind of person you have offended?"
Kent smiled and responded, "I know, and as it stands, I don’t really care.
However, I have a question.
Are you one of his little experiments?"
Kent used the Omniscient Jade Eye on him, and all he saw was danger and terror.
However, that didn’t change the fact that he sensed some form of foreign presence in the Crimson Blood Demon General.
It felt like someone had taken hold of his being and could command him.
"It seems your arrogance will be your downfall, dragon.
Though I wonder, how did someone like you manage to tame a beast under my Dark Lord’s control?
Even a failed one like him should have been impossible."
"I can tell you and even free you if you just go down on your knees and bow to me."
Kent saw the Crimson Blood Demon General move, and a large red greatsword appeared in his hand, a wide horizontal swing aimed for his neck.
He blinked, and the next second, the Crimson Blood Demon General moved, a large red greatsword appearing in his hand.
Just as Kent had foreseen, the attack came for his neck.
Gaap appeared in his grip, and the next moment, a powerful mixture of sword aura exploded out, shredding the trees around them.

chapters.title: Chapter 1619: Crimson Blood Demon General (2)
paragraphs: Kent was pushed back 200 meters, while the Crimson Blood Demon General moved back 50 meters. That was a clear sign of who the true monster in strength was.
The initial clash always determines that. However, Kent didn’t panic at that.

He hadn’t used his full strength in their first clash, and he knew the Crimson Blood Demon General also hadn’t used his full strength. However, being pushed back showed he could not underestimate his opponent.
So he moved again, and the danger followed like a tide. His movement was extremely fast, to the point that he was before the Crimson Blood Demon General before he knew it.
However, his opponent’s reaction was even faster.
The swords met, and the sly bastard curved his blade to slice toward the hilt of Kent’s sword, aiming to take off his fingers. However, Kent was also a step ahead.
He moved his body back and unsummoned his sword, then resummoned it, causing the Crimson Blood Demon General to miss his mark entirely.

"You like to play dirty, huh?" Kent took aim at his leg, and just when the Crimson Blood Demon General was about to meet his attack head-on, Kent somersaulted, his right leg whipping out and landing an overhead blow on the side of the demon’s face.
This blow threw his head back, and, taking advantage, Kent stomped on his chest, sending him flying.
"Rapid Slash."
He followed through with a powerful slash, manifesting 450 sword arcs, each imbued with the power of Absolute Sword Energy.
While he still only had access to Heavenly Sword Energy, unlocking an absolute form of it made the [Rapid Slash] even more deadly.
The sword arcs closed in on the Crimson Blood Demon General. However, with a casual swing of his sword, he destroyed all 450 and charged forward again.
Kent tapped into the [Soul Map] and vanished, appearing 1 km away.
"Let’s try that again."
He unleashed the [Rapid Slash] again, and this time, he imbued a small amount of Blood Qi into it. When the 450 sword arcs closed in on the Crimson Blood Demon General, his brow finally furrowed.

His defence this time was stronger, sensing that the sword arcs weren’t as simple as the first few he received. However, he still managed to defend against the sword arcs and paused, his eyes narrowing at Kent.
Seeing this, Kent smiled. "It would be in your best interest not to underestimate this young monarch."
Kent unleashed his [Chaos Monarch Sovereignty] aura, causing the expression on the Crimson Blood Demon General’s face to darken further.
They both are monarchs, or at least Kent is a True monarch, and he had merely brushed the surface.
’He is not simple,’ he thought as his greatsword trembled, a wave of overwhelming blood energy surging out.
Kent saw a terrifying sword arc come at him, and the next second, it happened. The Crimson Blood Demon General tapped into a sword technique and unleashed a wide arc.
"Crimson Moon Execution."
The sky reddened, and a moon appeared within it, shining with a red glow as a large sword arc flashed out, aiming for Kent’s life.
Kent didn’t underestimate the attack. He summoned the [Chaos Scale Shield] and used it to block the attack while his own sword moved, unleashing another strike.
"Void Cleave."
The distance between them wasn’t much, but considering the experience Kent had under his belt, the Void Cleave was as deadly as if he had unleashed it from 2 km away.
The two deadly attacks illuminated the air, one with a red glow and the other with a golden glow.

When the sword arc landed on the shield, Kent finally sensed the power behind it. While he managed to defend against it, he felt that if a much stronger version of this attack came, just one layer of the [Chaos Scale Shield] would not be enough.
He sensed that, and so he decided to probe further and see if he could discover everything about the demon general.
He had yet to use his sword domain or even his Immortal Sword Intent, so Kent wasn’t about to put all his cards on the table.
’Let’s see if you can keep hiding from me, demon.’

Kent knew that if he did nothing, he would never find out what the demon was made of. So he unleashed all his flame veins, and at once, his dragon wings lit up in flames, one turning green while the other turned red.
But Kent didn’t stop there. Knowing what he was after, he summoned the [Jade Void Wings], and at once, his speed exploded.
The Crimson Blood Demon General clearly saw him move, but before he could make sense of anything, a slash landed on his neck.
He pushed his head back, letting the sword only graze his neck. However, his arms, legs, and waist were soon attacked, forcing him to move back.
But as if that would save him, Kent used his speed advantage and pressed his attack, his sword landing on both flesh and metal.
With the Jade Void Wings combined with the flame veins and Kent’s own dragon wings, the Crimson Blood Demon General saw him as a blur.

However, Kent didn’t press his attack much longer. After all, through the chaos, he saw that in 2 seconds, the Crimson Blood Demon General would unleash a powerful technique, and if he were closer, it would end terribly for him.
So he used the Soul Map to vanish from range just when the Crimson Blood Demon General unleashed a rather sinister skill, one that had the potential to kill someone like Kent.
"Crimson Chains Obliteration."

Chains forged from blood and hell metal lashed out, their dangling swords filling the battlefield. Kent, thinking he was out of range, stopped and was about to unleash his own technique when a chain burst out of the ground and latched onto his legs.
He felt his energy drain so fast that by the time he severed the chains, he felt a bit sluggish.
"What was that?" His confused words didn’t even finish registering when two more chains came at him. This time, he didn’t let them touch him.
He flapped his wings and vanished into a blur of motion. However, as he moved away, Kent saw something alarming. No matter how fast he moved, the chains followed.
It felt like he wasn’t running from them; they were chasing him at his own pace.
A terrible danger surrounded Kent, and in that instant, he saw two possible futures.
One was the chains exploding, sending him flying away, or the Crimson Blood Demon General using a movement technique to appear before him and sever his head from his body.
The second happened, and it was so fast that when the Crimson Blood Demon General appeared before him, Kent didn’t even know how it happened.
His sword moved as the future he saw appeared before him in the form of a red sword arc, aimed at his neck.
"Die, you lizard!"
The Crimson Blood Demon General shouted, and Kent frowned. The next second, his body moved up and turned just right to offer something other than his head.
His left hand was severed cleanly off his shoulder, sending a wave of terrifying pain down his body. This sent chills down his spine.
BANG
The Crimson Blood Demon General never saw it at all. He came for Kent’s head, and he got a hand. However, he underestimated Kent’s resolve.
Just when his severed hand flew up into the air, his right leg moved and landed on the Crimson Blood Demon General’s groin, shattering the left ball.
"AAAHHHHHHH!" His scream sent shockwaves far and wide.
Kent used the time to grab his severed hand and teleport away.

chapters.title: Chapter 1620: Crimson Blood Demon General (3)
paragraphs: Call it shamelessness, but in a battle to the death, one ought to use every means necessary to emerge as the one alive.
Kent knew that, and so he went for the only play in the book that has no counter: the Ball Buster.

Seeing his death two seconds into the future and making sure it never came to pass was a wake-up call to tell Kent that the Crimson Blood Demon General wasn’t an opponent he could defeat using normal means.

Luckily, this mission wasn’t to test who was the better swordsman. The quest wanted him to kill the poor bastard, and so he would just do that. Bursting his balls was basically his way of paying back the demon for cutting his arm off.

Also, he made this decision simply to invoke the wrath of the Crimson Blood Demon General. This way, he would unleash his true power, something that Kent needed to see so he could create a good killing move.
Distancing himself further, Kent pressed his severed arm to the joint, and it healed instantly. Almost as if it had never been severed, Kent stretched his arms, making sure it had healed correctly.
Of course, even if his hand was shredded, with his healing speed now, regenerating a new arm was as simple as breathing.
"DIE!"
The Crimson Blood Demon General roared furiously, and with a sudden stomp on the ground, the 10 km radius shifted, and the world of blood and slaughter appeared.
Kent found himself standing on a scorched battlefield where broken swords, spears, bones, and all kinds of horrific things lay scattered.
Large bones and skulls littered the space, with even some massive skeletons chained to pillars, dripping with blood.
[You are under the effect of the Eternal Crimson Judgment Sword Domain. Your sword realm and sword intent have been sealed.]
"WHAT?!"
Kent sensed danger, but it was already too late. The Crimson Blood Demon General appeared before him, and before he could dodge, a sword slashed through his head, cutting him in half vertically.
The next second, Kent moved to his left just in time for a sword to land on the ground where he had stood a moment ago.
Sweat broke out on his forehead as he used the soul map to move back, hoping to distance himself from the Crimson Blood Demon General.
However, everything came crashing down when, just as he moved 3 km away, the Crimson Blood Demon General appeared overhead and unleashed a deadly sword attack.
’Looks like I cannot run from him while inside his sword domain.’
Kent dodged to the left and parried a follow-up attack. Then, before he could block a third attack, a chain came from nowhere and slammed into his back, sending him flying forward.
"Six Path Blood Execution!"
Kent clearly saw it, but he had no way of evading it. Up ahead, six identical copies of the Crimson Blood Demon General appeared, each oozing a terrifying blood aura.
"First Execution: Blood Severing Slash!"
The first clone moved and unleashed a deadly attack, one that sent a powerful sword arc at Kent. He felt his body tense when the sword arc came.
With his sword intent and sword realm sealed, he had only the sword aura to rely on. Even so, he had no idea why he sensed danger.
’Maybe this has something to do with his domain.’
He brushed away the fear and summoned Chaos Scale Shield, blocking the attack. He moved to retaliate when a surge of sensation appeared behind him.
"Second Execution!" The second clone stabbed its sword into the ground instead of attacking outright. "Blood Spikes Eruption!"
Spikes shot out, stabbing toward Kent, who had to defend against some and use the Chaos Scale Shield to block the rest.
’Damn, this is an eye-opener,’ Kent said inwardly as he moved to the left, escaping the attack of the third clone.
’I have been complacent all this while. My life has been too peaceful. After this mission, I would start challenging myself again.’ A sword grazed across his body, drawing blood.
However, instead of retreating, Kent closed his eyes for a moment and recalled some painful moments of his life as Lord Genesis.

He remembered the kind of danger he had to go through just to raise his strength and improve his sword mastery. He let a pale smile form on his face, and when he opened his eyes, his demeanour changed.
His speed surged, and while his sword realm and intent remained sealed, something about him changed.
"Sword Clone Bodies," ten copies of himself appeared, and before the Crimson Blood Demon General could make sense of what had happened, he was before his main body, his sword going through his chest.

He moved back, allowing only the sword to pierce a few inches into his flesh. However, Kent didn’t mind that and tapped into a skill he learned from Inaya when they reunited after he left the Whispering Wind Sword Sect billions of years ago.
"Repeated Echo,"
The mere inches that stabbed into the Crimson Blood Demon General’s flesh echoed, and before the demon could sense a threat, a sword stabbed through his body.
This technique used the concept of time to operate. An attack could echo five times, landing on the target five times.
So, by letting a small inch of the sword pierce his body, the sword attacked five times, turning the 2 inches into ten inches.
Blood gushed out, but the Crimson Blood Demon General managed to retreat. Even so, Kent had already achieved his goal.
[I have planted the seed of resentment, Master. It would need ten minutes to bloom into a fine, resentful sword seed.]
’Good one, Gaap. While defeating this demon seems impossible, killing him is quite simple.’
The Crimson Blood Demon General sensed some form of danger, but he failed to realise that the danger wasn’t external but rather internal.
"You have proven to be a formidable opponent, Dragon. However, here is where we end things."
Kent saw thousands of swords rain down from the heavens, falling like blood meteors.
His expression was pale, and the next second, the Chaos Scale Shield activated as the sky turned even redder, waves of killing intent crashing down on him.
"Be grateful, Dragon. I have only ever used this technique once, and that was against a True God, who died, by the way. Now, die, you lizard."
"Blood Rain Thousand Pierces!"
RUMBLE
Thunder and lightning rocked the heavens as thousands of giant swords rained down, every last one aimed at Kent. The Chaos Scale Shield trembled as dozens of swords started raining down on it.
"Don’t waste your time, bug. No defense can withstand my Blood Rain Thousand Pierces." As if to prove what he was talking about, cracks started to appear inside the shield.
Seeing this, Kent smiled weakly. "Indeed, this bastard has the power to back his claim."
Too bad he had met Kent this time around. "You know what? I also want to test the true power of my defence, so why don’t we see who breaks first—your sword or my shield?"
His blood qi surged and poured into the shield, sealing the cracks in an instant. "I have always taken pride in my defense, so try to break it, and let’s see."

More swords rained down, causing the air to tremble under the weight of the attack. Kent knew that in less than 9 minutes, all of this would be over. So he stood his ground, and for 4 minutes, his shield held firmly.
But then waves of killing intent fell down on him, and all hell broke loose.
"Blood Star Annihilation."

However, Kent didn’t mind that and tapped into a skill he learned from Inaya when they reunited after he left the Whispering Wind Sword Sect billions of years ago.
"Repeated Echo,"
The mere inches that stabbed into the Crimson Blood Demon General’s flesh echoed, and before the demon could sense a threat, a sword stabbed through his body.
This technique used the concept of time to operate.
An attack could echo five times, landing on the target five times.
So, by letting a small inch of the sword pierce his body, the sword attacked five times, turning the 2 inches into ten inches.
Blood gushed out, but the Crimson Blood Demon General managed to retreat.
Even so, Kent had already achieved his goal.
[I have planted the seed of resentment, Master.
It would need ten minutes to bloom into a fine, resentful sword seed.]
’Good one, Gaap.
While defeating this demon seems impossible, killing him is quite simple.’
The Crimson Blood Demon General sensed some form of danger, but he failed to realise that the danger wasn’t external but rather internal.
"You have proven to be a formidable opponent, Dragon.
However, here is where we end things."
Kent saw thousands of swords rain down from the heavens, falling like blood meteors.
His expression was pale, and the next second, the Chaos Scale Shield activated as the sky turned even redder, waves of killing intent crashing down on him.
"Be grateful, Dragon.
I have only ever used this technique once, and that was against a True God, who died, by the way.
Now, die, you lizard."
"Blood Rain Thousand Pierces!"
RUMBLE
Thunder and lightning rocked the heavens as thousands of giant swords rained down, every last one aimed at Kent.
The Chaos Scale Shield trembled as dozens of swords started raining down on it.
"Don’t waste your time, bug.
No defense can withstand my Blood Rain Thousand Pierces." As if to prove what he was talking about, cracks started to appear inside the shield.
Seeing this, Kent smiled weakly.
"Indeed, this bastard has the power to back his claim."
Too bad he had met Kent this time around.
"You know what?
I also want to test the true power of my defence, so why don’t we see who breaks first—your sword or my shield?"
His blood qi surged and poured into the shield, sealing the cracks in an instant.
"I have always taken pride in my defense, so try to break it, and let’s see."
More swords rained down, causing the air to tremble under the weight of the attack.
Kent knew that in less than 9 minutes, all of this would be over.
So he stood his ground, and for 4 minutes, his shield held firmly.
But then waves of killing intent fell down on him, and all hell broke loose.
"Blood Star Annihilation."

chapters.title: Chapter 1621: Crimson Blood Demon General (4)
paragraphs: It is well known that a warrior who can use two or more skills simultaneously can be considered a genius beyond reason. It takes a lot of control to keep one skill active while activating another.
That was what the Crimson Blood Demon General had done.
While the [Blood Rain Thousand Pierces] was actively raining down swords on Kent, a new technique was unleashed, and Kent could sense the danger.
He channelled more blood qi into his shields just as the void tore open, and a broken star appeared, blood raining down from it. It was as if this demon had dipped every technique in a pool of blood.
Kent felt his body shake as the broken star’s power fell toward him, bringing with it a terrible pressure. For a moment, Kent wondered just where this technique came from.
There was something hidden within it that he just couldn’t put his finger on.
However, before the star could even reach him, another skill was activated, and all hell broke loose.
"HellFall Blood Devastation,"
The space around Kent warped, and before he knew how it happened, everything exploded, and his body was reduced to nothing. Two seconds from now, he would die.
"Blood Runes,"

Kent summoned all 250,000 Blood Seals and made them all merge with his body. Then, as if he had gone mad, he unsummoned the [Chaos Scale Shield], allowing nothing between himself and the raining swords, and manifested it as a protective layer of dragon scales, coating his armour.
BOOM BOOM BOOM

He unleashed his blood qi, chaos qi, and flame qi at once, his body surging with so much energy as he moved, weaving his way out of thousands of swords despite the danger of the broken star still hanging over his head.
Kent saw his death, and now that he had moved, he knew what would happen next.
BOOOOOOM
The greatsword in the Crimson Blood Demon General’s hand was stabbed into the ground, and the entire domain exploded. The eruption point was where he had stood a moment ago.

However, the fact that he managed to move didn’t mean he walked away unscathed. The shockwave from the explosion pushed him away, a giant sword stabbing through his thighs as he slammed into a mountain 5 km away.
COUGH
Kent coughed up blood, his expression showing the pain he was in. Even with the [Omniscient Jade Eye], he never saw that attack coming. But at least he didn’t die.
"My turn,"
His wounds healed at an alarming rate, causing him to rise to his feet in no time. Possessing the healing ability of a demon god rendered the injury no insignificant.
"Void Cleave,"
Slash Slash Slash
With 4 km between them, the Void Cleaves came with so much power, forcing the Crimson Blood Demon General to muster a powerful defence to block all three.
However, Kent didn’t wait for him to defend against all of them without a backup plan in motion.
Just as the third Void Cleave attack was blocked, the sky turned purple and gold as Kent slashed down with devastating force.
"Chaos Starfall,"
RUMBLE RUMBLE
The sky shook, and the ground trembled as thousands of Chaos stars imbued with sword aura rained down on the Crimson Blood Demon General.
He was forced to raise more defences. However, Kent wasn’t having any of that.
"You may be more powerful than me in terms of strength and sword energy. However, I was the Father of All Swordsmen, bitch."
"Void Cleave."
One swing, yet five Void Cleaves flashed out, crashing into the Crimson Blood Demon General’s defence as he was hurled back, a Chaos star falling on him.
"I was killing Sword Immortals long before I became one. So do you really think killing you would be any different?" Kent stomped on the ground, and cracks formed.

From within, potent evil qi gushed out, plunging the entire domain into a bone-creeping coldness, one that made the Crimson Blood Demon General suck in a cold breath, his mind wondering just how any of this was possible.
He had unleashed his domain, which blocked Kent’s own sword realm and sword intent. That was enough to render him useless inside his domain.
However, that wasn’t the case at all. It appeared that sword intent or no sword intent, Kent had absolutely nothing to worry about.
What was even more alarming was Kent’s uncanny ability to always slip away just when he thought he had gained an advantage.
"Allow me to enlighten you, demon,"
Kent flew into the air, and when he was high enough, a powerful chaos energy exploded from his body as his sword was raised high.
"Abyss Dragon Rend,"
SLASH
He slashed his sword downward, and all hell broke loose.

A colossal dragon formed from Chaos Qi and Sword Qi appeared and lunged at the Crimson Blood Demon General, who had little to no time to defend since he was still under the devastation of the Chaos Starfalls.
What was even more heartbreaking was the fact that just when the Abyss Dragon Rend was mere meters away, Kent unleashed three more Void Cleaves.
The three Void Cleaves caused the ground to literally tremble and erupt, tearing sand and stone as they closed in on the Crimson Blood Demon General almost instantly.
BOOOM
The explosion rocked the Crimson Blood Demon General, sending him flying back like a rag doll.
"I wasn’t known as the greatest swordsman to ever walk the face of this universe if I were mediocrity at best,"
"Infinite Dragon Echo,"
Thousands of Kents appeared, and before the Crimson Blood Demon General could even land on the ground, thousands of sword arcs slammed into him.
"I may have forgotten the kind of person I was since it has been a very long time. However, now that we are here, allow me to claim your life, you demon."
"Infinity Heavens Art," His sword burned with both Blood Qi and Chaos Qi, causing a pillar of red and gold light to shoot up into the sky when he raised his sword.
BOOM BOOM BOOOM
Kent’s entire form exploded with so much power that the moment the sword was slashed down vertically, the Crimson Blood Demon General knew his advantage had ended here and now.
"Domain Severing,"
The crimson domain that had trapped Kent for the past 5 minutes was cut in half, rays of sun penetrating the dome that had covered them.
[Your sword realm and sword intent have been unsealed.]
"Now allow me to show you what real sword potential looks like," Kent stomped on the ground as he unleashed his sword realm.
"Genesis Sword Realm,"
The crimson domain, slowly coming apart, trembled and shattered when a vast sea, spanning several kilometres, erupted, rising into the air and casting a deep darkness behind Kent.
"You may have been genetically modified, buddy, but you aren’t a true Forbidden Yet. Now, taste the power of greatness."
As the Genesis Sword Realm fell down on the Crimson Blood Demon General, all he saw were billions of swords packed together so closely that they looked like water.
’This is more than anything I have ever seen,’
The Crimson Blood Demon General could only watch as his body was consumed by the devastation of the [Genesis Sword Realm].
He wouldn’t die, but Kent wasn’t looking to kill him that way. His sword realm wasn’t strong enough to kill a Sword Immortal. However, the required effect he had in mind was reached.

’Many didn’t know this, but I actually had some form of sword will when I reached the Sword Emperor stage. It allowed me to fight those far beyond my level. That sword will always works in my favor, leaving my opponents unsure of themselves after I unleash it.’
Kent sighed, but then he froze when a sword came out of nowhere and stabbed into his back. The next second, a message appeared.
[Your soul has been invaded.]
Kent paused for a moment, then he turned slightly and saw a lady clad in green armour move toward him. Instead of evading, Kent allowed the sword to stab him.
’Kenzie, time to see what you are capable of.’

chapters.title: Chapter 1622: Four In One
paragraphs: [5 Minutes before Kent Severed the Domain]
Kharvok remained on high alert, keeping a close eye on his surroundings as Kent had told him to. He had become very powerful, so Kent knew he would do a good job.
As he watched the battle, he recognised that Kent wasn’t using any other skills aside from his sword skills, which, to him, was the most reckless thing Kent could have ever done.
After all, his opponent wasn’t someone to mess around with.
Kharvok saw that after his awakening and mutation, he alone could take on the Crimson Blood Demon General and walk out alive.

Due to that, he saw the true nature of the demon and knew that using just sword skills wouldn’t cut it. However, even though his young lord found himself in danger, he always seemed to slip away just fast enough for the danger to pass.
He knew deep down that all those miracles shouldn’t have been easy, not when the attacker was a monster in his own right.

However, Kent kept escaping until the domain opened, and he was blinded. A true sword domain is way different from a sword realm. It basically rewrites the laws of the immediate surroundings, giving the owner a supreme advantage.

Just when the sword domain formed, Kharvok saw two individuals appear 30 km from where he stood, each a monster in their own right. He even saw that both of them might be stronger than the Crimson Blood Demon General.
However, he wasn’t about to fear them, not when he himself had become a monster too.
So he approached them, and when the new arrivals saw him, they attacked without question. In their minds, killing Kharvok was as simple as a single swing of their weapons.
However, after the first exchange, it became clear just who they had messed with.
Unfortunately for them, Kharvok managed to trap them in his domain, preventing them from leaving. He wouldn’t allow them to evade the crimson domain and endanger his young lord.
However, just when the domain opened, and Kent was revealed, Kharvok saw a figure move, and before he could even shout, the lady stabbed her sword at Kent’s back.
"Relax, Kharvok," Kent transmitted to him just when the sword appeared behind him. After all, he had seen it come 2 seconds earlier, and so he knew what the lady aimed for.
Just when the sword stabbed him, the lady slipped into his soul, hoping to kill him from the astral plane.
But, well, she clearly underestimated Kent greatly.
When she arrived inside Kent’s Soul Sea, she came face to face with the [Underworld Soul River] opening. Her entire body shuddered, waves of sweat forming on her forehead.
"Since you are here, why don’t you stay,"

A voice came from 20 million km away, yet it sounded as if it were spoken right behind her. Turning sharply, she saw a wingless dragon staring down at her, oozing the power of a God Ascension stage beast.
Her body, on the outside, dropped to her knees, and she passed out.
Meanwhile, Kent had already activated the Resentful Sword Seed he had planted inside the Crimson Blood Demon General.
The moment the poor bastard was able to shrug off the effect of the Genesis Sword Realm, a power slammed into his head, and he passed out. A few seconds later, a message appeared before Kent.
[You have killed the Crimson Blood Demon General.]
"Haaaaa."
Kent sighed, and then he sent his consciousness into his Soul Sea, appearing before the [Underworld Soul River] that had opened, but the river wasn’t summoned.
The demigod lady who had snuck up on him and invaded his soul was pale and on her knees as Linda, the Wingless Tree Dragon that Kent had fought and killed a few times days ago, hovered above her.
When he arrived, Lady Kenzie appeared beside him, munching on an apple.
"Should I kill her?" she asked, though Kent sensed a hesitation in her tone. Clearly, as someone who had cultivated the Life Dao, killing wasn’t in her nature.
"I have a few questions for her. Afterwards, I will decide what I want to do with her."
She nodded and decided to stand to the side.
As Kent approached the lady, her body began to tremble, the fear in her eyes deepening.
"Relax, young lady, I have no interest in killing you. I just want to ask some questions, and based on your answers, I will decide whether or not to keep you alive."
"First question, are you one of the Dark Lich Experiments?"
Her expression changed from fear to shock. However, she answered the question she was asked.
"Yes. Lord Dark is my one true master."
"I see. Then how many of you are out there?"

"I don’t know. However, my team is made up of three others, one of whom you just fought, and judging by the fact that you are here, you have killed him. The other two are outside with your subordinate."
Kent nodded.

He had already seen that Kharvok was locked in battle with two others, a female and a male. While they looked more like beasts than humans, he recognised them as Forbidden Beasts who had attained partial True Awakening.
"What is your name?"
"I don’t have a name. But my teammates call me Green, maybe because of my hair."
"How many of you were sent here after me?"
"I don’t know that either. But if we are here, then I am sure others aren’t far behind."
Kent smiled and nodded.

He didn’t even have to ask, since he knew the Grand Dark Lich would send all his Forbidden Beasts his way. After all, he sought to kill him, and Kent himself wanted to ensure his plans didn’t succeed in the end.
Too bad the dark lich had decided to offend one of the best Beast Tamers in the universe. Even without awakening his Divine Beast Tamer abilities, he could do much more.

"Here is my proposal: become my Beast Companion, and in return, I will awaken your True Forbidden Bloodline, Innate Body, and finally give you a chance to transcend beyond the True Forbidden Beast stage.
If you don’t believe me, ask yourself this question: why did the Grand Dark Lich send all of you after me?"
She was an intelligent being, so the question was enough to prompt her to think.

"Uhm, Master, can I resurrect that red-skinned demon now? After he died, I saw this blue screen appear before my eyes, saying that if I resurrect him within five minutes, I would get a pill that would awaken more of my powers."
"Oh, go ahead and resurrect him then."
Kent smiled and turned to the lady. "Let me know when you come up with a decision."
Kent opened his eyes on the outside, and a green fruit manifested in his hand.
"Squeeze the juice into his mouth or nose, and he will wake up."
Kent followed the method as he was told.
However, the moment the juice entered the Crimson Blood Demon General’s mouth, a Forbidden Contract appeared and merged with him.
"How convenient." Kent smiled and turned to the battle where Kharvok had brought the two other Forbidden Beasts to their knees.
His smile widened, and just then, the lady inside his Soul Sea made her decision. This caused Kent to laugh out loud, a part of him wondering just what kind of luck he had stepped into.
’This is what you call four in one. I came for one Forbidden Beast and ended up walking away with four.’
Somewhere far away, the Grand Dark Lich screamed, his fury burning like firewood dipped in oil.

However, the moment the juice entered the Crimson Blood Demon General’s mouth, a Forbidden Contract appeared and merged with him.
"How convenient." Kent smiled and turned to the battle where Kharvok had brought the two other Forbidden Beasts to their knees.
His smile widened, and just then, the lady inside his Soul Sea made her decision.
This caused Kent to laugh out loud, a part of him wondering just what kind of luck he had stepped into.
’This is what you call four in one.
I came for one Forbidden Beast and ended up walking away with four.’
Somewhere far away, the Grand Dark Lich screamed, his fury burning like firewood dipped in oil.

chapters.title: Chapter 1623: Four New Forbidden Beasts, Reveals
paragraphs: "Haaaa..."
Kent exhaled and sat down, his gaze sharp and locked on the four beasts staring at him. The Crimson Blood Demon Swordsman had already been resurrected and made a Forbidden Beast under Kent’s command.
Lady Kenzie resurrected her and reaped her rewards from the quest the Tower had given her.
Kent expected some dislike, perhaps some resistance, after he woke up. However, to his shock, he actually thanked him for freeing him.
According to him, he remained in the Tormented Layer to escape the control of the high-ranking Forbidden Beasts inside the Chaos Layer.
The hold the Dark Lich had on him compelled him to submit to them the moment he stepped into the Chaos Layer. So he remained in the Tormented Layer and continued to build his strength.

His plan was to go there one day and ascend to become a god. Once that happened, he would establish his rule. However, even if he were to accomplish that, he would only be a slightly better slave who could be commanded to do anything by the Dark Lich.
However, now that the connection between him and the Dark Lich was severed, he could finally be free.
Though hearing him say he was finally free, Kent laughed in his head. He chose not to tell the demon he had just jumped from the frying pan into the fire.
While he would not command them to do things like slaves, he planned to go against the Grand Dark Lich, and they would help him.
The ending would be determined by who had the strength, and Kent didn’t plan to lose.
The other three Forbidden Beasts that came during his battle with the demon were also thrilled to have finally found a worthy master.
They had all experienced things that made them realise they had been missing out on a lot.
They witnessed Kent kill the Crimson Blood Demon General. If that wasn’t shocking enough, they also saw how ridiculously powerful Kharvok was.

He defeated the two of them in mere minutes, a feat they knew should have been impossible considering that both of them were considered some of the most powerful Forbidden Beasts at the demigod stage inside the Chaos Layer.
This defeat opened their eyes, and so they knew they must chase strength rather than blind loyalty.

The two Forbidden Beasts that Kharvok defeated one was an [Abyssal Ravager], a rather dangerous berserker-type beast. After he became one of Kent’s Forbidden Beasts, he named him [Draevok], a name that captured his essence well.

The other was a dangerous beast from a race called [Voidborn Pestilence Sovereigns]. They are mostly plague-type beasts. Their power is well utilised in large-scale battles. Kent named her [Nytheris] after making her his Forbidden Beast.
As for the green-haired lady, what she experienced inside Kent’s soul had changed her for the better. Even now, the fear lingered.
As an [Astral Soul Devourer], she never expected a day to come when her insatiable hunger would lead to her downfall. Now, she had become Kent’s Forbidden Beast, and she was named [Vaeritha].
"I know all four of you want to become stronger like Kharvok. I will do just that; however, I have a few questions, and please, this time, tell me everything," Kent stated, and they nodded.
"Aside from the god you three serve directly under, are there others?"
Kent discovered that they all answered to a True God, a Forbidden Beast. He knew that in the Chaos Layer, even Celestials could be found, so he wasn’t about to risk it.

"Yes, there are others," Vaeritha answered. "3000 years ago, there was a meeting where we all attended. It was at that meeting that we met higher-ups. We answer to a True God who answers to a Universal God, who also answers to a Supreme, who also answers to a Celestial.

There are four Celestial Forbidden Beasts in the Chaos Layer, and each has three Supremes under it. Each Supreme has seven Universal Gods. The rest, I don’t know, but so far, you can see that there are a lot of us in the Chaos Layer."
Kent nodded, his expression showing that he clearly never expected there to be this much danger left behind by the Grand Dark Lich.
The force under that bastard’s control alone was more than enough to take control of the entire Tormented Chaos Abyss.
He knew he had to stop him somehow, or else soon the Banished Zones would become his secret army to command, and when that day came, defeating that old crook would be dangerous.

"I heard from a Forbidden Beast some time ago that our top leader resides in the Abyss Layer," the Crimson Blood Demon General, whom Kent had named Crimson, said, causing Kent to turn his attention toward him.
"There are four overlords there, so I am sure one of them is a Forbidden Beast and another is an Abomination."

"Huh... How did you come to that conclusion? The last I checked, the Abominations had been sealed inside dungeons. How can there be Overlord Abomination Beasts when there aren’t any of them outside like you guys?"
"Oh, there are Abominations inside the Chaos Layer. In fact, they are the most dangerous kingdom there. None of us dares go anywhere near their domains.
Their leader is a Celestial Dragon that has been modified with features from phoenixes, tigers, hawks, and others," Vaeritha revealed with a scared expression.

"Our leaders warned us not to go anywhere near their domains since doing so is guaranteed death. I wouldn’t go anywhere near an Abomination if I were you," Draevok added with the same grim expression.
Kent laughed, knowing that even if he didn’t want to, he would have to. He needed the manpower to prepare for the unknown.
He hadn’t been pressured to form his legion like this before, so the fact that it was happening now pointed to something big on the horizon, and he had to be prepared.
’The moment I awaken my first Grand Shaman, all of these beasts will become mine to command.’ Kent smiled inwardly and proceeded to ask a question.
He had already received the key to open the gateway to Elina’s Galaxy, so the only thing left now was for the evil queen to awaken so he could leave this place.
But for the time being, he would do everything in his power to amass his legion.
"You mentioned kingdoms. Are there others aside from your kind and the Abominations?"

"Yes," Nytheris answered. "Aside from the Forbidden Chaos Kingdom and the Abomination Kingdom, there are the Sentients who call their kingdom Mysthik and the Vagabond Kingdom. Unfortunately, none of us knows much about them since they remain hidden behind their walls.
The Sentients are also a mysterious bunch. We haven’t had interactions with them, so we can’t provide any valuable intel."

"Oh, it appears there are a lot of interesting beings hidden in this world." Kent was genuinely stunned. However, he soon discovered something interesting that made him wonder whether these Vagabonds were related to him.
There was one thing he had discovered ever since the tower started giving him quests. Now, each quest pointed to something bigger.
Just now, he had learned about the Vagabonds, and the next second, a quest regarding them popped up for him to embark on. If this wasn’t a coincidence, then there was nothing worth considering.
[You have received a side quest: The Vagabonds.]
[Quest Level: SSS+]
– Objective: [Find a way to meet the ruler of the Vagabonds and make her your subordinate.]
– Reward: [Divine Beast Tamer New Aspect | The Secret Manual Volume II]

chapters.title: Chapter 1624: Sword Divine
paragraphs: Kent’s eyes sparkled after receiving the quest.
While there was a chance that completing it would be difficult, since the quest had no time limit, Kent knew he could leave and return later to handle it.
However, given the rewards, he knew he had to complete this quest as soon as possible.
He had already awakened an aspect of the Divine Beast Tamer called [Tamer]. This aspect allowed him to feel a connection to beasts he shared destiny with.
He saw how useful that aspect was, and so Kent knew getting a new one would work to his advantage. The only problem here was finding a way to approach the Vagabonds without provoking their malice.
Even so, aside from the aspect rewards, he now also had the chance to win another Secret Manual. The first one revealed Grand Dark Lich Barnabas’ crimes.
Now he had a chance to get the second volume. Maybe there was a chance he would discover more secrets that he could benefit from.

The first one even revealed that this wasn’t the only Banished Zone the Dark Lich had his dirty fingers in. Kent was already aware of another Banished Zone called Upside-Down Cliff. Maybe he might visit there someday.
Banished Zones were basically the most dangerous places in the universe. These were places where the worst of the worst were sent, never to return to society.

The most dangerous in the Infinity Universe were the seven Calamity Zones. Now, Kent had discovered this place, and there was a chance that there were many other places he would soon come to know about.
’I better take this quest seriously so I can get the second volume of the Secret Manual and learn more secrets.’
He sighed and retrieved four Innate Talent Awakening Pills and Bloodline Tempering Pills and handed them to his four new Forbidden Beasts.
"These two pills will help you finally become True Forbidden Beasts and fully awaken and strengthen your bloodlines."
They nodded and, after answering a few questions, which mostly involved where he really came from and what he planned on doing next, they ate the pills and started their evolution journey.
"Kharvok, let’s wait for them to finish before heading out," Kent said, and he threw a pouch full of spirit grapefruits at Kharvok, who caught it and nodded in agreement.
Kent noticed Kharvok wasn’t the talkative type, so he let him be while he turned to the system interface to finally handle the changes that had happened to him.
[Congratulations, you are now a Sword Divine.]
[Your Absolute Heavenly Sword Aura has transcended to Absolute Divine Sword Aura.]
[Your Absolute Heavenly Sword Intent has transcended to Absolute Divine Sword Intent.]
[Divine Sword Energy: Tier 3.]
Kent grinned, finding this development a bit more extreme than he had expected.
Back in the day, when he had finally become a Sword Divine, he became so powerful that the first thing he did was challenge 100 Sword Legends and 10 Sword Immortals to a deathmatch.
That day, he killed all of them, and he hadn’t even discovered a limit to his own sword energy. It was later that he came to understand just how monstrous his sword mastery truly was.
His sword grew sharper, and so did his intent and aura.
Basically, he became a menace in every way. From that moment, many began to pay much closer attention to him.
Now, he could feel that, compared to his past Sword Divine self, he had become at least ten times, if not a hundred times, stronger.
’If this were me before the duel with Crimson, I would have ended the battle in less than ten moves,’ Kent said inwardly, a part of him wishing he had become a Sword Divine a long time ago.
Naturally, the reason he felt this much power was thanks to his absolute sword energy.

He wasn’t all too sure just how lethal his own sword aura had become, but he knew one thing: just his sword alone could help him fight against the most powerful demigods and perhaps even a few God Ascension stage cultivators.
Kent chuckled and turned back to the messages.
[Your Genesis Sword Realm has become much stronger now that you are a Sword Divine.]
The message made it seem simple; however, the changes he had already started to feel within his sword realm made him wonder if it could still be considered a sword realm or a sword domain.
’I am not even a Sword Legend yet, and I can already command such a realm. This is just unreal.’ Kent laughed and proceeded to read the last remaining messages before checking the next requirements.
[All your sword skills and techniques have received a 10,000% buff.]
[Your sword foundations have been transformed into sword techniques.]
[Congratulations, you have learned Heaven’s Rain Descent and Earth Splitting Sword.]
[Heaven’s Rain Descent]
[Rank: God]

[Description: With lightning as a conduit and flame or ice as the material, summon as many swords as you can and rain them down on your foe with no mercy. Every last sword summoned contains your absolute divine sword energy.]
[Earth Splitting Sword]
[Rank: God]
[Description: One sword strike that splits the earth. Allow your brilliance to show by taking advantage of your sword intent and sword aura to unleash a strike that has no equal.]
Be it Heaven’s Rain Descent or the Earth Splitting Sword, both techniques were beyond what they appeared to do.
Kent could feel it; even with his lightning element not fully awakened, the power resting inside him, soon to be unleashed, was more than this world was ready to face.
These two sword techniques were created by him back when he had just become a Sword Saint. It was the Sword Dao that aided him in that endeavour.
Now, after years, he had finally transformed them into true sword techniques.
His happiness at finally having the means to use them made him pause and smile for a few minutes before he returned to the message showing the requirements to become a Sword Legend.
[Requirements to become a Sword Legend]
↠ Win the Genesis Sword Dao Competition
↠ Attain Extreme Divine Sword Energy
↠ Comprehend the first three levels of the Grand Sword Mural
↠ Kill the One-Eyed Spider Demon Queen
’The first two, I can easily handle them. However, the last two, I have no idea where to even start.’ He paused and thought for a moment, recalling a memory from his life as the Ruthless Bandit.

’I once heard of the Grand Sword Mural during the Dark Era. I learned it came to this universe from another during the Shadow Era or so. However, I had never seen it before, nor did I know where to find it.’
Kent paused and thought for a moment, then he sighed.

’Forget it. I am sure I will come across it soon enough. As for the One-Eyed Spider Demon Queen, I guess I will have to visit Spider City one of these days and see if I can find information about her there.’
The next requirements were within reason, so Kent had no reason to complain.
Winning a sword competition sounded simple enough to him. After all, all the sword competitions he had participated in the past were won by him, so he wasn’t worried.
Unbeknownst to Kent, this particular sword event would finally expose him to the world of swordsmen, one that came about due to his brilliance in the past.
He would face the best the universe had to offer, and every last one of them would come with a winning mindset.

chapters.title: Chapter 1625: Grand Ascension (1)
paragraphs: After three days, Crimson and the other three forbidden beasts had fully awakened their innate bodies, showing they had finally become true forbidden beasts like Kharvok.
They had also awakened their bloodlines, making them super powerful and more relatable.
Crimson, who was already a monster in his own right, had become a freak of nature. Kent even wondered if he could kill him this time around if they were to fight again.
Of course, he knew killing him was still within his capabilities. But defeating him would prove a bit daunting, especially after he had awakened True Immortal Sword Energy.
He had even transferred the method of cultivating absolute sword energy to him so that he could become much stronger if he mastered it.
Knowing what he had gained after attaining absolute sword energy, it made Kent wonder just what would become of this subordinate of his after he was done learning absolute sword energy.
For now, he can only wait and see what happens.
The other three forbidden beasts had also become at least ten times stronger now. Kent was even shocked when he discovered all three of them had awakened innate bloodline abilities.
He allowed them to showcase their abilities for a few minutes before nodding with satisfaction.
"Very well, guys. You’ve all made me proud. However, we have work to do and little time to do it, so maybe we should get back to that first," he smiled and revealed his plan.
"There are over a hundred forbidden beasts here. Our mission is to kill all but 23 of them. Those 23 will soon become your brothers and sisters."
They nodded.
"We first have to hunt and kill the beasts not on my list. Afterwards, we will visit the 23 beasts one by one, from the weakest to the strongest, adding them to the family as we move.
Also, we have to be on the lookout for your friends coming from the Chaos Layer. If they aren’t worthy to join our ranks, we will kill them, god or not.
So you should prepare for a battle unlike any other."
Crimson smiled, his red eyes narrowing as his hand brushed against his greatsword. "Let them come. I have been planning on going on a rampage anyway."
Kent could only wonder what would have happened if he hadn’t arrived early to make most of the beasts his companions.
’Crimson is scary and to be frank, he is perfect for my future plans.’ Kent said inwardly, ’Looks like I hit the jackpot this time around.’
Kent smiled and added more details to his plan. After he had said enough, they left to rid the tormented layer of all forbidden beasts.
Grand Dark Lich Barnabas felt his connections severed when Crimson and the others became Kent’s subordinates. Soon, however, he would feel hundreds taken from his web of modified forbidden beasts.
While Kent was away, taunting powerful beings he had no business messing with, his wife, Inaya, was also on her way to attaining Supremehood.
After Baldy and his big brother Han had shut everyone up, Inaya started forming her Supreme Platform, or, more like, upgrading her god platform.
Unlike Kent, who already had a cultivation platform long before he became an Immortal, cultivators first create one when they ascend to the Immortal stage.
During ascension, they undergo Immortal Platform Creation.

Afterwards, they would upgrade it to the God Platform when ascending to godhood. At this stage, the owner would have to temper it vigorously with the laws and other affinities before vying for the Supreme stage.
However, while immortal and god platforms are relatively easy to cultivate, the process of ascending to the Supreme stage is complex yet rewarding.
In the grand scheme of things, a cultivator’s potential is determined by their cultivation platform.

While at the Immortal and God stage, it isn’t considered much, since the laws are the primary focus, it can’t be denied that the larger the cultivation platform, the greater the cultivator’s potential for growth.
Kent has a rather large cultivation platform at the Immortal stage, making him someone with limitless potential. His talent is uncontested.

However, at the Supreme stage, instead of merely wielding a cultivation platform, one can possess multiple layers of it, achieved by comprehending the Dao and challenging the Supreme Ascension Bridge associated with that Dao.
The deeper one understands the Dao, the more layers one can pass through when one challenges it.
Ordinary folks end up maintaining one layer. Good enough ones go up to 3 layers. Slight geniuses like Ainna manage to awaken five layers.
Many go as high as 10 layers, while the geniuses among them, who add meaning to the strength of the universe, go as high as 15 layers.
On rare occasions, some manage to reach 20 layers, and even 25.
Lord Genesis reached 20 layers back then, a feat that made him one of the greatest in the universe.
But before him, the Chaos Dragon in all of the history of the Primordial Era reached the 38th layer, and even the Ruthless Bandit and Pill Celestial Kevin Sage managed to reach the 40th layer.

Inaya, being a one-of-a-kind genius, is expected to reach a much higher layer. So, after hours had passed and she hadn’t finished the Supreme Platform formation, many started wondering about many things.
"If she really was the partner of Lord Genesis, then she wouldn’t come out without exceeding the 20th layer," a Supreme said, drawing attention to himself.
"What do you know? When I ascended, I was only able to reach the 10th layer. Even then, I am sure the Dao had pity on me and let me win in the end."
"And you think you can compare yourself to someone who walked side by side with the first person to ever reach the peak of swordsmanship?"

"Tsk, what is there to be impressed about?" another Supreme with a smug look on his face said, making sure many heard him. "Lord Genesis may have been the first person to reach the peak, but many eras have passed, and the world of swordsmanship has improved. I am sure there are many better swordsmen now than he was back then."
His argument was within reason. After all, a lot had happened, and many talents appeared after Lord Genesis died, so it was only normal for him to say that.
Even if Kent were here, he wouldn’t be offended by what he said. It was his dream for the world of swordsmen to grow and keep growing even after he was no more.
It was why he made sure his knowledge reached the billions before he left for the final battle against the foreign race.
However, the man who spoke forgot one thing. He was in the midst of Lord Genesis fanatics.
A grey-haired man with a tribal mark on his left cheek sneered, "I always knew the Lancaster Family had men with small dicks and jelly brains. Now you have proven me right, Jenrob."

"How dare you, bastard." The man who looked down on Lord Genesis unleashed his aura and retrieved his sword, about to lunge at the grey-haired man, when a sudden beam shot from Inaya’s body and split the clouds.
BEAM BEAM BEAM...
Nine more beams, each bearing a different colour, shot from her body and pierced into the clouds, splitting them apart. All around, everyone focused their attention on what was about to happen.
After all, the moment they had been waiting for had arrived, and none of them would want to miss it.
Baldy summoned a small sword, and so did Han.
Vexthre and her sisters did as well.

Finally, the Six Ancient Primordial Beasts also summoned their weapons, knowing full well that this was the stage at which Inaya would become the most vulnerable, and the enemy might attack at any moment from now on.
Vexthra looked at Ainna. "Have you seen anything yet?" she asked, but Ainna shook her head.
"I saw no grim future, but I can sense danger—multiple dangers." Her expression grew tense as she said those words.
"Relax and stay behind the Void Null Shield." She nodded and made up her mind to die first before anyone dared lay a finger on her best friend.
Just then, Inaya climbed to the first layer...
"Evaluation has started," a Celestial said, his fingers tapping a cylindrical item as a malicious grin formed at the corner of his mouth.

chapters.title: Chapter 1626: Grand Ascension (2)
paragraphs: BOOM

A wave of terrifying Supreme Qi burst out of Inaya’s body for the 10th time, showing she had already reached the 10th layer. The first layer was reached 5 minutes ago, yet in no time, she had already reached the 10th layer.
"What a monster," Vexthra muttered, a smile playing on her lips.
She had lived a bitter life for most of her existence. All she knew was anger, hatred, and resentment. She had never once smiled.

But that all changed when she met Kent and her sisters. Now, she only wanted one thing, and that was to protect the happiness she had gained. She wanted her sisters to become strong enough to protect their man, no matter the danger.
As long as Kent lives, she will never run out of happiness.
So, watching Inaya ascend from one layer to another, she could only smile inwardly and wish she could go further.

Han and Baldy wore smiles as they watched with vigilant eyes. They could not slack off right now. Just then, an 11th explosion of Supreme Qi came from Inaya, signalling her ascension to the 11th layer.
"Hahahahahaha." Just then, a Celestial lady clad in a flowing white dress with blue patterns embroidered into it appeared in the air and laughed.

"For billions of years, we, the descendants of the Kazuto Great Family, have searched for the Ten Emotion Sword Maiden to pay her back for killing our ancestors and elders. We searched far and wide, but—"
"Excuse me, lady, can you skip to the part where you make your threat and we kill you?" Baldy interrupted her, causing a furious expression to appear on her beautiful face.
"You hairless maggot, do you think you can protect her from us?" Just as she said that, a portal opened ahead, and powerful auras descended from it, filling the place.
"We have been waiting for that bastard who calls himself Lord Genesis or this bitch to appear. Today, she dies by our hands."
"Is that so?" Han spoke calmly and walked forward. "All I see are bugs sent to the slaughter. A single sword move is all I need to wipe you out from the face of this universe."
Just then, Inaya ascended to the 12th layer.

"Why waste time when she is already vulnerable?" a voice came from far away. A second later, the void opened, and a man clad in red-and-blue armless armour stepped out, his hands crossed over his chest.
Han narrowed his eyes at this person, sensing danger. The new arrival reeked of blood and death, a feeling that caused many to take several steps back.
"It would be in your best interest not to block my path since I intend to kill the bitch for what she did to my family. I will not leave until she dies, so step aside and let me kill her."
Han’s eyes narrowed. ’Baldy, protect Big Sister with all you’ve got. It will take a while to kill this person,’ he transmitted to Baldy before turning to face the red-armoured Celestial.
"I am afraid I cannot do that."
"Then die first." The Celestial moved, and in no time, he and Han vanished into the void. A battle of that magnitude cannot be fought on a planet like this.
Just one strike would severely damage the structure of the planet.
Baldy now faced against 10 Celestials, turned and looked at Vexthra. "Don’t worry about me. Just make sure nobody gets close to Big Sister."
"I will." Vexthra had already summoned her bow and was ready to burn her own cultivation to protect her sister.
"Well then, shall we?" Baldy stomped on the ground, and all ten Celestials, including himself, also vanished into the void.
The moment they left, Vexthra sensed people moving toward them, some wearing malicious grins.
"What can a mere God do against a Supreme such as myself?" a man holding a wooden staff said, pointing it at Vexthra.
Five others stood behind him, their presence radiating killing intent.
Vexthra sighed, then she ignited her Laws: Hatred and Resentment.
When the aura of her laws swept across everyone, they all frowned, some instinctively taking steps back.

"Big Sister Inaya had offended all of you eras ago, so I trust it has been several billions of years piling your hatred and resentment toward her." A rare smile appeared on Vexthra’s face as she manifested an arrow.

"Too bad you all are now in the presence of the Goddess of Hatred and Resentment." Just as she said that, a powerful aura of hatred and resentment exploded from her body, forcing many to clutch their heads.
"Give me your hatred." Her arrow flew, and a Supreme closer to her was killed, her arrow and his hatred contributing to his own death.
Vexthra did not even allow anyone to charge before she started firing arrow after arrow at the remaining Supremes. With so much hatred in the air, she felt like a drunkard.
The Six Ancient Primordial Beasts also stood guard, making sure nobody, absolutely nobody, sneaked up on their master, who had already reached the 15th layer.
Just like that, chaos broke out on planet Brymrr, causing the entire planet to tremble and forcing many citizens to take cover, fearing their deaths were already upon them.
While this was happening, Inaya’s Supreme soul body stood on the 16th layer, a beast she had not seen before, charging toward her and radiating intense Supreme Dao energy.
The emotion of hatred ignited, and she also charged forward, meeting the beast in a deadly collision of Supreme Qi empowered by the energy of the Sword and Emotions Dao.
A few seconds later, Inaya found an opening, and before the beast could make a move on her, her sword sliced through its neck, cutting its head off.
The beast transformed into an orb and flew into Inaya’s body. On the outside, she released the 16th aura, showing she had reached the 16th layer.

Her Supreme soul body vanished, then reappeared on the 17th layer. She faced off against another beast. The 18th and 19th were the same. She met beasts that could destroy entire planets in mere seconds.
However, it took her less than a minute to cut them all down.
When the 19th beast was defeated, she sighed and muttered, "I must hurry. My enemies are already on their way, and so I cannot be here for long, else my sisters and friends would be in danger."
She gritted her teeth, and then her body was lifted to the 20th layer. This time, when she appeared, her opponent was a humanoid, an Elf holding a bow.
"Lower life form, do you dare take an arrow from me?"
"Low life form?" Inaya furrowed her brow. "Bitch, we both are Elves, so who are you calling a lower life form?"
The lady with the bow smirked. "A half-elf is no Elf in my eyes."
"Then allow this half-elf to kill you since she is in a hurry." Inaya turned into a blur, and the Elf lady frowned. The next second, her bow moved to her left, meeting a powerful swing from Inaya.
Clang.
Their weapons met, and she grinned. However, her eyes rolled back, showing the white part, when a powerful kick from the sole of Inaya’s boot landed on her face.
The kick rattled her head, and using that, Inaya went for the kill.
"A half-elf just killed you."
Inaya’s sword moved, and the Elf lost her head. She had ascended to the 21st layer.
