chapters.title: Chapter 1627: Grand Ascension (3)
paragraphs: Inaya stood on the 28th layer, a green-haired Beastman staring back at her. The man appeared to be an antelope that had awakened his innate body, taking the form of a rather above-average handsome man.
However, his appearance was not the focus of this standoff. What Inaya was staring at was the sharpness in the air around him and the identity of this man.
She recognised him, and judging from what Kent told her, the look of anger in her eyes showed she was very pissed at this man.
After all, this man was the 1st Sword Elder, one of the ten individuals who betrayed Jest in the final moments of his life.
Instead of aiding him to kill their enemy, they sided with the Abyss King, and, outnumbered, Jest had to sacrifice his life to end the battle.
So she wants this bastard to pay severely.
"The look on your face tells me you know my main body," the 1st Sword Elder said, a smile on his face. "Makes me wonder what I had done to you to warrant such intense anger."
Inaya said nothing and just took one step forward.
Her sword ignited in toxic purple and dark green hues, a mixture that showed she had activated the emotion of hatred at full strength.

Suddenly, her speed surged, and before the 1st Sword Elder could say anything else, her sword was coming for his neck. He parried the attack and tried to push back, but Inaya was faster than he calculated.
Her hand suddenly moved and grabbed the 1st Sword Elder by the shoulder, and then, with a powerful kick, her knee went for his chin, knocking the air out of his lungs for a moment.
His body was sent flying back, a shocked look appearing on his face.
They both were Sword Supremes, and from the look of things, Inaya had only just arrived on the 28th layer, meaning her understanding of the Sword Dao should not be higher than his.
If she were someone who had already been through this stage, dominating the battle would be normal. However, she had only just comprehended the Sword Dao, so her understanding was still fresh.
So sending him flying back clearly had no justification at all. But here he was, very fragile as his jaw arched from the knee attack.

He landed on the ground and unleashed a wide arc, hoping to keep Inaya back. But just before his sword could truly manifest the attack, Inaya arrived before him and stabbed her sword into his heart while whispering into his ear.
"This is for my husband, whom you losers betrayed. Fear not. When your main body returns, I will personally kill him and make sure he never reincarnates."
Purple flames burst from her hand, erasing the Supreme Soul Imprint the Dao had left as a challenge for any cultivator challenging the Supreme Sword Dao Bridge.
The next time someone reaches this place, they will encounter an imprint of Inaya’s soul, manifested to wield her emotion of hatred as a Sword Dao Supreme Soul.
"I need to hurry," she muttered as the orb merged with her body, and she vanished to the 29th floor.
Meanwhile, on the outside, many Supremes and Celestials stood on the side, their mouths wide open as they gazed at the carnage being caused by one God.

Vexthra’s eyes turned completely black. Her years of effort to learn how to be a normal lady burned away, hatred and resentment clouding her judgment, waves of dark energy oozing from her body as one arrow after another flew from her bow.
Her body was littered with many injuries, some life-threatening. However, with her life force ignited, she looked calm, a little too calm, in fact, as she killed one Supreme or God after another.

"I know most Domain Gods, but this is my first time meeting one wielding two Domain Laws," a Supreme said, holding a recording bead as she recorded the battle happening between Vexthra and the people who came to kill Inaya while she was vulnerable.
This video would soon go viral, and many would wonder the same thing he did.

"I have heard about her millions of years ago," a Celestial stated, watching a Supreme fall back and collapse to his death as an arrow plunged into his chest and forehead. "She was the quiet type, so many Gods don’t mess around in her domain.

Though I never expected her to possess such outstanding talent for the bow and arrow. In fact, her understanding of the laws seems a bit too deep. I am afraid that unless a Celestial or a powerful Supreme intervenes, she alone would kill everyone."

The Celestial was not lying. Vexthra indeed had the power to kill every last soul that pointed their weapon at her. While the price she was paying was a bit too high, she knew she had to protect her sister at all costs.
On the other side, the Six Ancient Primordial Beasts were also locked in battle, making sure their master was protected on all sides.
Lene had mounted her Hellhorse and was locked in battle with a True God. Many gasped when they saw a Night Rider fighting for Inaya.

Daliah, Uncle Drake’s subordinate, had also summoned her Domain of Darkness and was committing her own style of murder within it. She may be a Demigod, but when it comes down to killing, she excels at it.
Umai, another subordinate of Uncle Drake, had transformed into her Crystal Dragon form and was unleashing icy breath all over the place.
Her left wing was injured, but she was holding her own against her opponent.
However, despite all of them holding their own, everyone present could tell it was only a matter of time before their advantage would be taken away from them.
The danger was already here, but more was on the way, so if no miracle happened, then Inaya would be in real danger, and the outcome would either be catastrophic or devastating.
BOOM
Suddenly, the 29th aura exploded out of Inaya’s body, signalling her ascension to the 29th layer. Now, she had the sacred 30th layer to pass, and if she did, she would unlock Grand Ascension.
Inaya stood on the 29th layer, her expression pale. The battle just now had been against herself. It was not something she expected, but she had to outsmart herself to win.
While she won, her strength seemed to have been drained significantly. Now, she was left with the 30th layer, her target.
"Kent said that by passing the 30th layer, I would awaken Grand Ascension, which would allow me to challenge the Grand Ascension Dao Tower later. I cannot fail, not when I am this close to success."
She said to herself, and then she vanished, appearing on the 30th layer.
She expected to appear on a battlefield like the previous ones. However, she was shocked to find herself in front of a bamboo house.

Seated on a wooden chair in front of the house was a dark-haired man. The man was facing away from her with his back turned. However, even with his back facing her, she sensed something familiar about him.
"I am here to challenge the 30th Layer of the Supreme Sword Dao Bridge," Inaya said, her sword held firmly in her hand.
Something about this man made her feel unsure about winning. However, she could not say for certain unless she tried.
"Always too serious, Inaya. It’s been billions of years. Aren’t you a bit happy to see me?" The man turned and faced her, causing Inaya’s eyes to widen.
"Jest..."
"As I live and breathe." Jest grinned, his expression showing genuine happiness. "I have been waiting for you, Inaya. What took you so long?"

sentences.text: Inaya stood on the 28th layer, a green-haired Beastman staring back at her.
The man appeared to be an antelope that had awakened his innate body, taking the form of a rather above-average handsome man.
However, his appearance was not the focus of this standoff.
What Inaya was staring at was the sharpness in the air around him and the identity of this man.
She recognised him, and judging from what Kent told her, the look of anger in her eyes showed she was very pissed at this man.
After all, this man was the 1st Sword Elder, one of the ten individuals who betrayed Jest in the final moments of his life.
Instead of aiding him to kill their enemy, they sided with the Abyss King, and, outnumbered, Jest had to sacrifice his life to end the battle.
So she wants this bastard to pay severely.
"The look on your face tells me you know my main body," the 1st Sword Elder said, a smile on his face.
"Makes me wonder what I had done to you to warrant such intense anger."
Inaya said nothing and just took one step forward.
Her sword ignited in toxic purple and dark green hues, a mixture that showed she had activated the emotion of hatred at full strength.
Suddenly, her speed surged, and before the 1st Sword Elder could say anything else, her sword was coming for his neck.
He parried the attack and tried to push back, but Inaya was faster than he calculated.
Her hand suddenly moved and grabbed the 1st Sword Elder by the shoulder, and then, with a powerful kick, her knee went for his chin, knocking the air out of his lungs for a moment.
His body was sent flying back, a shocked look appearing on his face.
They both were Sword Supremes, and from the look of things, Inaya had only just arrived on the 28th layer, meaning her understanding of the Sword Dao should not be higher than his.
If she were someone who had already been through this stage, dominating the battle would be normal.
However, she had only just comprehended the Sword Dao, so her understanding was still fresh.
So sending him flying back clearly had no justification at all.
But here he was, very fragile as his jaw arched from the knee attack.
He landed on the ground and unleashed a wide arc, hoping to keep Inaya back.
But just before his sword could truly manifest the attack, Inaya arrived before him and stabbed her sword into his heart while whispering into his ear.
"This is for my husband, whom you losers betrayed.
Fear not.
When your main body returns, I will personally kill him and make sure he never reincarnates."
Purple flames burst from her hand, erasing the Supreme Soul Imprint the Dao had left as a challenge for any cultivator challenging the Supreme Sword Dao Bridge.
The next time someone reaches this place, they will encounter an imprint of Inaya’s soul, manifested to wield her emotion of hatred as a Sword Dao Supreme Soul.
"I need to hurry," she muttered as the orb merged with her body, and she vanished to the 29th floor.
Meanwhile, on the outside, many Supremes and Celestials stood on the side, their mouths wide open as they gazed at the carnage being caused by one God.
Vexthra’s eyes turned completely black.
Her years of effort to learn how to be a normal lady burned away, hatred and resentment clouding her judgment, waves of dark energy oozing from her body as one arrow after another flew from her bow.
Her body was littered with many injuries, some life-threatening.
However, with her life force ignited, she looked calm, a little too calm, in fact, as she killed one Supreme or God after another.

"I know most Domain Gods, but this is my first time meeting one wielding two Domain Laws," a Supreme said, holding a recording bead as she recorded the battle happening between Vexthra and the people who came to kill Inaya while she was vulnerable.
This video would soon go viral, and many would wonder the same thing he did.
"I have heard about her millions of years ago," a Celestial stated, watching a Supreme fall back and collapse to his death as an arrow plunged into his chest and forehead.
"She was the quiet type, so many Gods don’t mess around in her domain.
Though I never expected her to possess such outstanding talent for the bow and arrow.
In fact, her understanding of the laws seems a bit too deep.
I am afraid that unless a Celestial or a powerful Supreme intervenes, she alone would kill everyone."
The Celestial was not lying.
Vexthra indeed had the power to kill every last soul that pointed their weapon at her.
While the price she was paying was a bit too high, she knew she had to protect her sister at all costs.
On the other side, the Six Ancient Primordial Beasts were also locked in battle, making sure their master was protected on all sides.
Lene had mounted her Hellhorse and was locked in battle with a True God.
Many gasped when they saw a Night Rider fighting for Inaya.
Daliah, Uncle Drake’s subordinate, had also summoned her Domain of Darkness and was committing her own style of murder within it.
She may be a Demigod, but when it comes down to killing, she excels at it.
Umai, another subordinate of Uncle Drake, had transformed into her Crystal Dragon form and was unleashing icy breath all over the place.
Her left wing was injured, but she was holding her own against her opponent.
However, despite all of them holding their own, everyone present could tell it was only a matter of time before their advantage would be taken away from them.
The danger was already here, but more was on the way, so if no miracle happened, then Inaya would be in real danger, and the outcome would either be catastrophic or devastating.
BOOM
Suddenly, the 29th aura exploded out of Inaya’s body, signalling her ascension to the 29th layer.
Now, she had the sacred 30th layer to pass, and if she did, she would unlock Grand Ascension.
Inaya stood on the 29th layer, her expression pale.

"I have been waiting for you, Inaya.
What took you so long?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1628: Grand Ascension (4)
paragraphs: Inaya was frozen in place, unsure of what to say as she stared back at Jest.
If this were before she reunited with Kent, she would have jumped into Jest’s arms like a kid welcoming her father after being away for an entire week.
However, things were different now, so she hesitated.
Seeing this, Jest, or at least a strand of his supreme soul, smiled. "I suppose you have already reunited with my future incarnation, huh?"
Inaya furrowed her brow. "How did you know that?"
"Isn’t that obvious? If you hadn’t met my true self, you would have already jumped into my arms. After all, you wouldn’t miss a chance to get close to me."
"You make it sound like I am obsessed with you." A chuckle escaped her lips.

"I am happy for you, Inaya. I know how we ended things wasn’t the right way. However, I had to leave to ensure you didn’t fall victim to my heart demon. I am not asking for forgiveness; however, you should know I am terribly sorry for leaving you."
Inaya smiled and nodded. "It is all in the past now, Jest. I am happy now, so you can rest assured knowing the future is better than any of us could have hoped."
Jest smiled and stood up. "I am glad everything worked out in the end," he said before taking a deep sigh. "So, you are here to defeat me, huh?"
"Yes. That is the plan."

Jest smiled and shook his head. "If we fight, you wouldn’t last a minute against me. That said, I am not here to fight you. I only asked the Sword Dao to leave this imprint of my soul so I could give you this."
Jest opened his palm, and a golden orb appeared in it...
With her enhanced senses, Inaya sensed the danger hidden within the golden orb. "What is that?"
"I couldn’t get close to you back then, so giving it to you wasn’t worth it, not when the danger was more than the gain.
So, I asked the Sword Dao to leave it here for you. It is the 8th strand of the Eternal Sword Intent I comprehended back then when I glimpsed the realm above the Sword Celestial Stage."
Jest paused and smiled at the shocked expression on Inaya’s face. "Since we have reunited in the future, then I am sure you have already met Baldy and the others."
Inaya nodded.
"Yes, they were formed from the Eternal Sword Intent I had comprehended. Now, here is yours. I don’t know how you intend to use it, but it is yours to use.
I turned mine into seven living beings tasked with creating and mastering a sword technique that transcends the Sword Celestial Stage.
You can do whatever you want with it. Just know that with this, your sword will become much sharper, and, knowing the kind of talent you have, I am sure you will shock the entire universe.
So take it and make me proud, Inaya. Show the entire universe that the partner of Legendary Sword Genesis isn’t someone to look down on."
The orb flew from Jest’s palm and merged with Inaya’s forehead. "I look forward to seeing how far you can climb the Grand Ascension Sword Tower."
Just as he said that, Inaya’s world went completely blank.
On the outside, a spear streaked through the air, stabbing Vexthra in the shoulder. She was sent crashing into a mountain 2 km away.
She tried to rise to her feet again; however, two Supreme warriors unleashed their power, directing everything to lock her in place.
Then a third Supreme appeared out of nowhere and stabbed another spear into her heart.
"NOOOOOO!"

Lene’s furious roar spread across the space, her Hellhorse letting out a powerful howl, almost as if it were a wolf. She dashed toward Vexthra, hoping to prevent the Supreme from stabbing her a second time.
However, she hadn’t gotten far when a powerful force slammed into her body, knocking her off her Hellhorse and rendering her unconscious.
Up in the air, a Celestial appeared and unleashed a powerful attack, manifesting a gigantic sword and hurling it toward the unconscious Lene.
Somewhere else, Umai was sent crashing into a mountain, both wings broken and torn like rags. She had held her own against three Supremes, but in the end, she lost.
Daliah was also forced out of her Darkness Domain, her left arm severed and one eye blinded.

As for the Six Ancient Primordial Beasts, they had killed quite a number of Supremes and even Celestials. However, now, aside from Moltros, whose defence was practically impenetrable, the rest had already dropped to one knee.
Finally, Ainna had become bloody from head to toe after merging her entire essence with the [Void Null Shield], making it so nobody could get close to her best friend.
For someone who valued peace of mind, she sure had the courage to make sure that, even if she died, her best friend would live on.

As for Baldy and Han, since they weren’t back, it appeared they had encountered additional dangers. In truth, had it not been for the two of them, Vexthra and the others would have already fallen by now.
Now, Vexthra was halfway to the underworld, Lene would soon be obliterated, and Umai had lost consciousness.
Up ahead, three Celestials, each powerful enough to make even Han take them seriously, appeared.

"Hahahahahaha... I never knew a day would come when the Legendary Ten Emotions Sword Supreme would be left undefended and exposed for all to see her die a pitiful death," one of them said, swinging his sword.
A sword light flew from it, but landed on a transparent shield. Inside, Ainna coughed up blood, but she gritted her teeth and formed more hand seals, pouring her Supreme Qi into the shield.
"Annoying," the Celestial clicked his tongue. "Join me. Let’s shatter that shield."
The two Celestials joined in and attacked. This time, when the attack landed on the shield, a crack formed in it.
"AaaaaHHHH!" Ainna screamed as her soul cracked, and the backlash knocked her unconscious.
"Now is our chance."
They attacked again, and the shield shattered. However, instead of attacking Inaya, it landed on a turtle shell.

"Not when I am still alive," Moltros said, focusing his defence to the maximum as he covered Inaya from all sides, making sure the only opening was him standing in front of the shield, holding an axe.
"Die, you turtle!"
All three Celestials attacked at the same time, their weapons stabbing toward Moltros, who held a fearless smile on his face.
"At long last, here is where my journey ends."
He knew death was staring him in the eye, and there was no escaping it. So he made peace with himself.
Everyone held their breath as the three Celestials drew closer. Vexthra, who was still hanging on, watched through her hazy vision as Moltros stood his ground, arms open as he awaited his death.
’Should I use it?’
A dark thought appeared in her mind, one that, if she executed it, would cause her to cease to exist forever. Not even Lady Kenzie would be able to resurrect her if she used that technique.
Her dark thoughts were interrupted when a calm voice spread across the entire planet...
"You all just died."
All Vexthra saw before she passed out was a purple light, and then everything went quiet.

chapters.title: Chapter 1629: Ten Emotions Sword Supreme Inaya
paragraphs: Billions of years in the future, the legends would speak of the day a purple light lit up on planet Brymrr.
They would say that, on that day, 64 Celestials, 176 Supremes, 420 Gods, and 2,001 Demigods fell, none of them knowing how they died.
The legends would speak of the day bodies, cut into several pieces, rained down from the sky, clouds, and the void, as though it were raining body parts.
The Sword World would speak of the voice that heralded the downfall of an entire great family.
"You all just died."

The Kazuto Great Family had been searching for Inaya for billions of years to settle a debt they believed she owed them. After all, during the Divine Era, their founder, the one who formed the Kazuto Great Family, tried to make Inaya one of his wives.
When she refused him, he sent a Sword God after her.
For years, Inaya ran, hid, and did all kinds of humiliating things to stay alive until she met Jest, who saved her and later helped her kill the Sword God.
After the Sword God was killed, they proceeded to seek out Lord Kazuto, and, as one would expect, they killed him.

Kazuto’s descendants, whom Jest and Inaya spared, grew up and later decided to seek revenge. Unfortunately for them, by the time they came looking, Inaya had vanished from the face of the universe, and Jest was long dead.
However, they never stopped looking. To them, Inaya and Jest were a stain on their reputation, so their death would finally elevate their statues to a new level.
So when they learned she had resurfaced and was ascending to the Supreme Stage, they mobilised their entire force to come and kill her.
Many of them were stopped and transported into the void by Baldy and Han. However, a few managed to enter the planet’s surface.

Unfortunately for them, Vexthra and her team were no simple lineup. Vexthra alone had killed over 60 Supreme and 300 gods, a feat no god in the entire universe can beat their chest and say they can accomplish.

Even so, despite Vexthra and the others holding their ground, they were all reduced to pitiful states. Thankfully, just when it was all coming to an end, Inaya finally passed the 30th Layer, and she returned to her body.
Meeting Jest was an unexpected welcome, one that gave her more than she asked for.
Watching as bodies rained down, severed into several pieces, one could only wonder how she was able to do that.
The answer was rather simple.
After she received the golden orb and her world darkened, she appeared at a crossroads, where she had to make a decision on how to use the Eternal Sword Intent.
It was an intense debate. However, in the end, she chose her sword as the recipient.
Jest never used his seven strands on himself, so why should she?
So she gave it to her sword, and that was when the first-ever sword with an Eternal Weapon Spirit was born. Just one swing was all it took to kill that many cultivators.
While the energy used was quite steep, it was worth it.
Inaya rushed to Ainna’s side and, with a wave of her hand, she vanished into the tower. Vexthra and the others followed.
They weren’t at the point where they would die. However, Vexthra and Ainna would be out for a very long time. Even so, Inaya forgot about revenge because her sister’s life was her priority.
She sent everyone, including her six Primordial Beasts, into the tower, and she soon left without even acknowledging anyone.
A few seconds after she left, Han and Baldy appeared from the void, their bodies littered with sword injuries.
Baldy looked around, seeing the carnage around him.

"Let it be known that we will come for revenge. All who lifted their weapons against my big sister and family today will face the same fate. I will personally make it my mission to ensure their entire bloodline is wiped from the face of the universe."
After issuing his warning, Baldy vanished into the tower.
Han smiled and said, "I will talk to him and maybe calm him down a bit. However, when my big brother returns and makes a decision, then I, Han, the Grim Sword, will aid in the unholy massacre."
He also vanished, leaving the entire planet in stunned silence.
Back inside the Tormented Layer, Kent suddenly paused just as he was about to sever the head of a Forbidden Beast. He froze in his tracks, allowing the spider beast to attack.
However, Kharvok stepped in and defended against the attack aimed at Kent’s chest.
"Something bad has happened, Tower."
His body trembled, and his face went pale as he watched his hands shake.
"Tower, what has happened? I feel like something bad has happened."
"Nothing bad has happened, Master. I can’t sense any danger either."
"Really? I feel like something bad has happened. Can you check up on the girls and see how they are doing?"
"I did, and they are fine, Master."
"Hmm... Okay. I guess learning that Gods are coming after me seems to make me anxious."
Kent forced out a smile and returned to the battle.
Inside the Harem Tower, Inaya stood inside a room where five healing pods lay on the floor. Inside them were Vexthra, Lene, Ainna, Umai, and Daliah.
After the tower was upgraded, this room appeared in almost all the towers. Gaia and her goons worked on improving them. They are the best healing stations in the tower.
The moment they returned to the tower, Inaya made sure all five of her sisters were placed inside the healing pods, which Gaia said would speed up their healing.
Hovering beside Inaya was Tower in her humanoid form.
"Did he notice?" Inaya asked, and Tower nodded.
"I hate lying to Master. He would be angry when he finds out I lied to him, Big Sister."

"Don’t worry, Tower. You said it yourself, he is in a dangerous place right now, so we shouldn’t make him restless by revealing what happened to the ladies. When he returns, I will explain everything and make sure he doesn’t become mad at you."
"Okay, Big Sister. I will keep an eye on them so you can enter seclusion to solidify your Supreme Platform. You cannot risk it, not when you have reached the 30th layer."

Inaya nodded, and after spending a few minutes there, she left. As much as she would love to go on a rampage right now, she knew her sisters came first. So until the last of them recovered, she would swallow her anger for now.

Meanwhile, out there in the universe, word of what had happened on planet Brymrr started to spread, reaching many people. In no time, news travelled as far as the Universe Council and even the Soul Temple, shaking them all to the core.
The Ten Emotions Sword Supreme had returned, and instead of welcoming her with open arms, the universe came against her.
Those who knew the history of the Ten Emotions Sword Supreme and Lord Genesis started to panic.
They were a deadly duo in the past. They weren’t known as the Blood Sword Couple for no reason.
Shockingly enough, even some old sword monsters who had entered seclusion for millions of years started to come out of seclusion when news of what had happened reached them.
To them, the deaths of the thousands meant nothing. What they were interested in was the one who executed the attack.
They wanted to meet her and discuss the sword.
Somewhere far away in a brothel filled with Gods, Supremes and even Celestials, a pink-haired incubus played with the bodies of beautiful women as though they were his trinkets.
Judging by the looks on the ladies’ faces, they seemed to be enjoying themselves.

Suddenly, a seductive lady walked in holding a plate of fruits. "My Lord, have you heard? Apparently, somewhere out there, a huge battle broke out between a very powerful group of people and a team of only a dozen or so warriors. However, in the end, the entire family was slaughtered.
They said a bald kid was part of the team that won. You once said you like bald kids, so I figured you want to know."
"Oh really?"
A handsome smile appeared on the pink-haired man’s face.
"Ladies, it seems it is time for me to return. Time for a family reunion."

So when they learned she had resurfaced and was ascending to the Supreme Stage, they mobilised their entire force to come and kill her.
Many of them were stopped and transported into the void by Baldy and Han.
However, a few managed to enter the planet’s surface.
Unfortunately for them, Vexthra and her team were no simple lineup.
Vexthra alone had killed over 60 Supreme and 300 gods, a feat no god in the entire universe can beat their chest and say they can accomplish.
Even so, despite Vexthra and the others holding their ground, they were all reduced to pitiful states.
Thankfully, just when it was all coming to an end, Inaya finally passed the 30th Layer, and she returned to her body.
Meeting Jest was an unexpected welcome, one that gave her more than she asked for.
Watching as bodies rained down, severed into several pieces, one could only wonder how she was able to do that.
The answer was rather simple.
After she received the golden orb and her world darkened, she appeared at a crossroads, where she had to make a decision on how to use the Eternal Sword Intent.
It was an intense debate.
However, in the end, she chose her sword as the recipient.
Jest never used his seven strands on himself, so why should she?
So she gave it to her sword, and that was when the first-ever sword with an Eternal Weapon Spirit was born.
Just one swing was all it took to kill that many cultivators.
While the energy used was quite steep, it was worth it.
Inaya rushed to Ainna’s side and, with a wave of her hand, she vanished into the tower.
Vexthra and the others followed.
They weren’t at the point where they would die.
However, Vexthra and Ainna would be out for a very long time.
Even so, Inaya forgot about revenge because her sister’s life was her priority.
She sent everyone, including her six Primordial Beasts, into the tower, and she soon left without even acknowledging anyone.
A few seconds after she left, Han and Baldy appeared from the void, their bodies littered with sword injuries.
Baldy looked around, seeing the carnage around him.
"Let it be known that we will come for revenge.
All who lifted their weapons against my big sister and family today will face the same fate.
I will personally make it my mission to ensure their entire bloodline is wiped from the face of the universe."
After issuing his warning, Baldy vanished into the tower.
Han smiled and said, "I will talk to him and maybe calm him down a bit.
However, when my big brother returns and makes a decision, then I, Han, the Grim Sword, will aid in the unholy massacre."
He also vanished, leaving the entire planet in stunned silence.
Back inside the Tormented Layer, Kent suddenly paused just as he was about to sever the head of a Forbidden Beast.
He froze in his tracks, allowing the spider beast to attack.
However, Kharvok stepped in and defended against the attack aimed at Kent’s chest.
"Something bad has happened, Tower."
His body trembled, and his face went pale as he watched his hands shake.
"Tower, what has happened?
I feel like something bad has happened."
"Nothing bad has happened, Master.
I can’t sense any danger either."
"Really?
I feel like something bad has happened.
Can you check up on the girls and see how they are doing?"
"I did, and they are fine, Master."
"Hmm...
Okay.
I guess learning that Gods are coming after me seems to make me anxious."
Kent forced out a smile and returned to the battle.
Inside the Harem Tower, Inaya stood inside a room where five healing pods lay on the floor.
Inside them were Vexthra, Lene, Ainna, Umai, and Daliah.
After the tower was upgraded, this room appeared in almost all the towers.
Gaia and her goons worked on improving them.
They are the best healing stations in the tower.
The moment they returned to the tower, Inaya made sure all five of her sisters were placed inside the healing pods, which Gaia said would speed up their healing.
Hovering beside Inaya was Tower in her humanoid form.
"Did he notice?" Inaya asked, and Tower nodded.
"I hate lying to Master.
He would be angry when he finds out I lied to him, Big Sister."
"Don’t worry, Tower.
You said it yourself, he is in a dangerous place right now, so we shouldn’t make him restless by revealing what happened to the ladies.
When he returns, I will explain everything and make sure he doesn’t become mad at you."
"Okay, Big Sister.
I will keep an eye on them so you can enter seclusion to solidify your Supreme Platform.
You cannot risk it, not when you have reached the 30th layer."
Inaya nodded, and after spending a few minutes there, she left.
As much as she would love to go on a rampage right now, she knew her sisters came first.
So until the last of them recovered, she would swallow her anger for now.
Meanwhile, out there in the universe, word of what had happened on planet Brymrr started to spread, reaching many people.
In no time, news travelled as far as the Universe Council and even the Soul Temple, shaking them all to the core.
The Ten Emotions Sword Supreme had returned, and instead of welcoming her with open arms, the universe came against her.
Those who knew the history of the Ten Emotions Sword Supreme and Lord Genesis started to panic.
They were a deadly duo in the past.
They weren’t known as the Blood Sword Couple for no reason.
Shockingly enough, even some old sword monsters who had entered seclusion for millions of years started to come out of seclusion when news of what had happened reached them.
To them, the deaths of the thousands meant nothing.
What they were interested in was the one who executed the attack.
They wanted to meet her and discuss the sword.
Somewhere far away in a brothel filled with Gods, Supremes and even Celestials, a pink-haired incubus played with the bodies of beautiful women as though they were his trinkets.
Judging by the looks on the ladies’ faces, they seemed to be enjoying themselves.
Suddenly, a seductive lady walked in holding a plate of fruits.
"My Lord, have you heard?
Apparently, somewhere out there, a huge battle broke out between a very powerful group of people and a team of only a dozen or so warriors.
However, in the end, the entire family was slaughtered.
They said a bald kid was part of the team that won.
You once said you like bald kids, so I figured you want to know."
"Oh really?"
A handsome smile appeared on the pink-haired man’s face.
"Ladies, it seems it is time for me to return.
Time for a family reunion."

chapters.title: Chapter 1630: Top Five Forbidden Beasts
paragraphs: After three weeks of carnage, Kent and his beast companions had managed to kill all the Forbidden Beasts, their bodies stored for later use in creating new undead and upgrading the others.
Aside from that, Kent had also managed to work his way from the 23rd Forbidden Beast he shared destiny with all the way to the top 5.
He had made them all his beast companions, and over 15 of them had already awakened their Innate Bodies and bloodlines, finally becoming True Forbidden Beasts.
Some submitted willingly when Kent and his people arrived in their domains. However, some tried to resist, which ended in a beatdown none of them saw coming.
He now only had five more to go, but from what he had learned about them, he knew it would be a struggle unlike anything he was prepared for.
He had already asked Tower to create detailed profiles on the top 5 Forbidden Beasts based on what the Forbidden Beasts he had subdued knew about them.
The 5th on his list was a monstrous tyrant known as the Flame Warden. He learned that this monster had the highest control over flames in all of the Tormented Layer.
Some even said he had killed a few Gods before, while others claimed he had already stepped into the ranks of the Gods 100,000 years ago.
Kent had no plans to back down, so after forming the contract with the 6th-ranked Forbidden Beast, he left for the domain of the Flame Warden.
He is confident that winning would be easy for him.
The Forbidden Beasts sent from the Chaos Layer had yet to arrive, so he wanted to end this battle before they arrived.
This was so he could have enough time to face them. Aside from that, he now has to wait three more weeks for the Evil Queen to awaken.
Once she returned, he would leave and return to the Star Realm, where he would make his way to Elina’s galaxy.
When Kent and his Forbidden Beasts arrived in the Flame Warden’s domain, they were met with a scorching-hot mountain range filled with lava.
[Master, I can sense a Primordial Flame Source hidden somewhere in this place. We can use it to form the 3rd Flame Core once the third Blood Gate awakens.]
’An added bonus, huh?’
Kent smiled, then amplified his voice and issued a command.
"I know you can sense my arrival, so let’s not make this hard. Come and submit to me, or we will duel it out, and if I defeat you, you will become my subordinate."
He wasn’t even done speaking when the heat surrounding him suddenly intensified.
Those who couldn’t withstand it retreated. However, Kent remained standing, his expression calm as he regarded the monster that had appeared 2 km away.

It was a colossal beast wrapped in black volcanic armour, molten cracks, and burning orange-gold veins. Its body resembled a demonic flame titan with horned shoulders, a crown of ember-like spikes, and eyes like two miniature suns.
Its ragged back constantly released flames that formed wings of fire and smoke. Every step it took turned the ground into black glass.
Kent furrowed his brow upon seeing this.
’Looks like the others didn’t exaggerate when they said it wasn’t a normal monster like the ones I had faced before.’
Kent smirked, then said, "Are you here to surrender, or should we fight it out?"
He wasn’t even done speaking when the giant monster moved and appeared before him, its clawed fist moving toward his chest. Its speed was simply too fast to track easily.
However, after adding over 20 beasts to his legion, Kent had become even stronger than he could comprehend.
He moved his hand forward, and a triangular shield formed from the Chaos Scale Shield manifested before him.
BANG
The clawed fist landed on it. To the Flame Warden’s utter shock, the shield didn’t even budge. Rather, its body was pushed back several hundred meters.
"You will need more than a punch to break my defence, Mr. Flame Warden."
Kent sneered, watching the beast retreat back and regard him for a second before lunging forward again.
This time, as it moved, flames gathered around its clawed fist.
With the Omniscient Jade Eye, Kent saw the force behind the punch, but he knew he had nothing to worry about.
The fist came crashing down, and, just like before, the shield didn’t even budge. It was the same shield that had trembled under Crimson’s sword rain.
Right now, Kent had become several times stronger, to the point that even a punch capable of cracking holes through planets failed to leave a single crack on it.
The Forbidden Beast was stunned, and for a beast with monstrous potential, it felt as though today was the day it would die.
However, Kent spoke, and it realized death wasn’t what this dragon was after.
"Well then, should I beat you up, or will you accept my proposal to become my subordinate? In return, I will turn you into a True Forbidden Beast and awaken your Innate Body and bloodline."
The Flame Warden stood there for a few minutes before nodding.
"I only used 20% of my strength since I had no plans to fight you seriously. None of us did. However, managing to defend against my punch, I have to say, Dragon, you are the first to do that."

Kent smiled and was about to brag when the void shattered in four different places. Through the portals that formed, four deadly beasts appeared, each one exuding so much power that Kent trembled in sheer terror.
’Tower, if I fight all five of them, would I survive?’

[I am not sure. All five of them are among the most terrifying Demigod Beasts I have ever seen. Individually, you can survive against some of them, but together, Master stands no chance, not even with the Soul Universe abilities.]
The Flame Warden spoke.

"We have received a command from our creator to kill you. However, after observing you defy him by slaughtering the other weaklings and making the others your subordinates, and seeing that they had all become more powerful, we five decided to submit rather than continue living as incomplete beings.

But you must understand, when it comes to us Forbidden Beasts, we crave strength, so you must promise not to restrict us. We remained Demigods not because we could not become Gods. We remained this way so we could maximise our potential as Demigods before becoming gods.
Now, with you, we believe we can do that. So we will follow you and hope that following you won’t be boring or a mistake."
Kent smirked.
"Personally, I hate weaklings. They bore me to death. So rest assured, I will make sure you all have more than enough fun. I am from a place where there is always something to kill."
"Then, Dragon, proceed to form the contract with us. The reinforcements will arrive soon, so we should prepare for them."
Kent nodded and proceeded to form the contracts.

While doing so, his gaze never left a purple orb-like beast. It looked round, with no hands or eyes. However, Kent could tell it was the strongest and perhaps the most terrifying beast he would ever meet in this Banished Zone.
He proceeded to form the contracts, and two days later, he finally saw the kind of monsters he now had under his command.
With Yggzrael and the others succeeding in their mission, Kent now had 44 Demigod-level Beasts under his command.
But he planned to add four more: the Abominations.
However, before any of that, he planned to awaken the first Grand Shaman.

chapters.title: Chapter 1631: Hierarchy
paragraphs: Kent sat on a small throne formed from Kharvok’s extreme ice. He had created a fortress of ice, and all 44 demigods under Kent’s command sat on smaller thrones.
The one Kent was seated on seemed more regal than theirs.

Yggzrael and the others returned with the 12 demigods from the Eastern, Western, and Southern regions. The mission Kent had given them was a success, so he waited for them to evolve into much stronger versions of themselves.
This was so that all his 44 demigod beast companions would be at their best when danger arrives.

Strangely, one of the demigods from the Western regions, Drakmire, evolved into a monstrous nine-headed Hydra. Each head held so much power that Kent was compelled to make him the fifth strongest in his legion.

This decision was reached because he could sense an untamed power hidden within Drakmire, one yet to be unleashed. Shockingly enough, he was also struck dumb when Crimson managed to learn Absolute Sword Energy in just three weeks and two days.
That pushed his power to the third-strongest, making Kent very happy.

Now, in his legion of 44 demigod beasts, [Nexorphis], the one with the ability of space and time, ranked first. And that was before Kent formed the contract with her and helped her awaken her bloodline and innate body.
Kent knew deep within him that a battle with her would end badly for him. It wasn’t because he was weak; it was more like Nexo’s abilities were strange.
Now that she had awakened her innate body and bloodline, three more affinities were added, making her more powerful than even Kent could comprehend.
Aside from [Space] and [Time (Time Distortion)], she also had an affinity for [Void], [Cosmic Darkness], and [Reality Corruption].

She could use the void to move, darkness to hide her presence, and reality corruption to infect the very reality around her opponent, rendering them at her mercy. If she wanted, she could devour all gravity in a space, making her opponent lose their balance.
But as if that wasn’t enough, she could also shift five seconds into the past and move the same into the future.

While exhausting, since she had yet to comprehend and develop Chrono Essence or Time Essence, the current her could move five seconds into the past and attack, or move into the future and do the same.
Aside from that, she could skip time or loop it, making an event play out over and over until she got the results she wanted or ran out of energy.
She had several other abilities that Kent found alluring. This made him wonder just when he would awaken Symbiosis so he could use some of these abilities himself.
The second strongest was [Ixeron, the Mind Flayer].
His abilities involved mental manipulation and illusion. Kent was taken aback when he learned that the monstrous octopus-type beast he had formed a contract with was merely an illusion made real.

According to Ixeron, his mind, which he referred to as his [Thought Core], resided in a hidden dimension far beyond where anyone could reach. He said he had over a hundred cores, 99% of which were fake.
However, to reach the true core and kill him, one would have to destroy the others, which he described as impossible. It would require someone with superior mind cultivation to attempt that.
Upon learning this, Kent thanked his lucky stars that this monster had chosen to submit without a fight. He wouldn’t have won the confrontation, no matter how monstrous he was.
So, having him submit and become a part of his beast legion made him extremely happy.
The third strongest had now become Crimson after he learned Absolute Sword Energy (Intent + Aura). He earned his place, and that alone made him a worthy lieutenant in Kent’s opinion.

The fourth strongest was [Kaldrex, the Chained King]. From what Kent discovered, these forbidden beasts currently had access to 50% of his strength. The other half had been chained inside his soul sea by a power none of them had any understanding of just yet.
But the nine massive chains binding him had made sure he could only use 50% of his power, which, to Kent’s shock, had managed to make him the fourth strongest.
He wondered what would become of him when his other half merged back with him. Kent didn’t even have to think about the monstrous power Kaldrex could command.

The fifth, of course, was Drakmire, who wasn’t a forbidden beast but a monster in his own right. Yggzrael and the three whom Kent sent couldn’t defeat him. The battle lasted for just 20 minutes, but he defeated all four of them.
Luckily, he was impressed by the power the four demigods displayed, so he chose to join them. With him leading the way, the others didn’t try to resist.
Now, as Kent gazed down at his 44 demigod beasts, especially his top five, he knew the future was bright.
Suddenly, Nexorphis raised her hand to speak, and Kent allowed her.
"Young Lord, I was thinking, why don’t the top four strongest handle the Abominations? We have each become at least 15 times stronger than we were, so defeating them will be possible.
Even before this upgrade, I was able to fight one of the Abominations to a stalemate. I believe we can defeat them."
Before Kent could respond, Crimson added, "Nexorphis is right, Young Lord. I can handle one of them, and I am sure the others can as well. So why don’t you let the four of us handle them?
Since you wanted them dead, we can easily do that. Of course, if we can’t, we will retreat and try again later when we become much stronger."
Kent saw that Nexorphis, Ixeron, Crimson, and Kaldrex had already made up their minds to help. Seeing this, he sighed and nodded.
"Very well, try not to die. While I can bring you back, it takes more soul essence to do so. So be careful."
They nodded and walked away from the fortress. A few seconds after they left, Malgoreth, the Plague Bearer, ran after them.

He caught up a few seconds later. "Take this. The moment you find an opening, clench it; it will slow the Abomination for two seconds. If you can’t kill it within those two seconds, then, well, rest in peace, you four."

After handing them a pill-like item, he returned to the fortress, where his Young Lord was preparing to awaken an ancient evil whose power would soon envelop this world and beyond, spreading evil everywhere.

Unbeknownst to Crimson and the others, Malgoreth had just saved their lives by giving them a part of his core seeds. As the Plague Bearer, Malgoreth was someone who could spread his infectious power everywhere he went.
The four Abominations within the four dungeons weren’t exactly the kind of monsters even someone like them could mess around with.
They would have the greatest shock of their lives when they met them. Thankfully, they had also become stronger, so perhaps they wouldn’t be overpowered from the get-go.

While this was happening, somewhere in the Chaos Layer, a Nine-Tailed Red Fox exuding the power of a Universal God stood behind a large dome that seemed to have trapped 24 demigods, 6 True Gods, and 2 Universal Gods, each a forbidden beast.
"Nuella, what is the meaning of this?" one of the Universal Gods, a rabbit with features resembling a wolf, asked, deadly killing intent oozing from its body.
"What does it look like I am doing? I am preventing you all from entering the Tormented Layer."
"Is your Vagabond Race trying to go against the Forbidden Race?"
The Nine-Tailed Red Fox let out a chuckle. "So what if we are?"

The fifth, of course, was Drakmire, who wasn’t a forbidden beast but a monster in his own right.
Yggzrael and the three whom Kent sent couldn’t defeat him.
The battle lasted for just 20 minutes, but he defeated all four of them.
Luckily, he was impressed by the power the four demigods displayed, so he chose to join them.
With him leading the way, the others didn’t try to resist.
Now, as Kent gazed down at his 44 demigod beasts, especially his top five, he knew the future was bright.
Suddenly, Nexorphis raised her hand to speak, and Kent allowed her.
"Young Lord, I was thinking, why don’t the top four strongest handle the Abominations?
We have each become at least 15 times stronger than we were, so defeating them will be possible.
Even before this upgrade, I was able to fight one of the Abominations to a stalemate.
I believe we can defeat them."
Before Kent could respond, Crimson added, "Nexorphis is right, Young Lord.
I can handle one of them, and I am sure the others can as well.
So why don’t you let the four of us handle them?
Since you wanted them dead, we can easily do that.
Of course, if we can’t, we will retreat and try again later when we become much stronger."
Kent saw that Nexorphis, Ixeron, Crimson, and Kaldrex had already made up their minds to help.
Seeing this, he sighed and nodded.
"Very well, try not to die.
While I can bring you back, it takes more soul essence to do so.
So be careful."
They nodded and walked away from the fortress.
A few seconds after they left, Malgoreth, the Plague Bearer, ran after them.
He caught up a few seconds later.
"Take this.
The moment you find an opening, clench it; it will slow the Abomination for two seconds.
If you can’t kill it within those two seconds, then, well, rest in peace, you four."

After handing them a pill-like item, he returned to the fortress, where his Young Lord was preparing to awaken an ancient evil whose power would soon envelop this world and beyond, spreading evil everywhere.
Unbeknownst to Crimson and the others, Malgoreth had just saved their lives by giving them a part of his core seeds.
As the Plague Bearer, Malgoreth was someone who could spread his infectious power everywhere he went.
The four Abominations within the four dungeons weren’t exactly the kind of monsters even someone like them could mess around with.
They would have the greatest shock of their lives when they met them.
Thankfully, they had also become stronger, so perhaps they wouldn’t be overpowered from the get-go.

While this was happening, somewhere in the Chaos Layer, a Nine-Tailed Red Fox exuding the power of a Universal God stood behind a large dome that seemed to have trapped 24 demigods, 6 True Gods, and 2 Universal Gods, each a forbidden beast.
"Nuella, what is the meaning of this?" one of the Universal Gods, a rabbit with features resembling a wolf, asked, deadly killing intent oozing from its body.
"What does it look like I am doing?
I am preventing you all from entering the Tormented Layer."
"Is your Vagabond Race trying to go against the Forbidden Race?"
The Nine-Tailed Red Fox let out a chuckle.
"So what if we are?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1632: Grand Shaman Malak (1)
paragraphs: Kent stood before the 24 Arcana Coffins, his gaze locked on the first one.

With the key in hand, he could sense it was the one he was meant to awaken. However, for the time being, he stood there, his gaze locked on it almost as if he wanted to see whether he would sense a resonance with it first.
"So, I am really going to do this. I am about to awaken an Ancient Evil."
Kent took a deep breath, Lady Kenzie standing beside him.

"If there was another way, I wouldn’t have recommended awakening whatever is hidden within any of these coffins. However, since we are here now, you might as well get it over with," Lady Kenzie said, showing that she, too, was afraid of what would soon emerge.
Even a True Evil like the Ruthless Bandit was feared by the entire universe during the Dark Era. So an Ancient Evil sure would bring horror.
"I suppose there is nothing to be afraid of then." Kent smiled and released the key, letting it fly toward the coffin.

He had already planned to leave this Shaman Elder in this Star Realm to conquer every aspect of it. Since, aside from the Tormented Chaos Abyss, there were other Banished Realms, he would first start from this stage and work his way toward conquering everything.
Kent knew with absolute certainty that no matter the rank of the shaman that would emerge from the coffin, conquering this realm would be very easy for them.
Considering what he knew about Ancient Evils, making this place their domain would be very simple, so he wanted that to be the case.
Had it not been for that, he would have waited until he was strong enough before awakening them.

The moment the key arrived before the first coffin, it merged with a key-shaped hole on the coffin, and the coffin released a powerful evil qi that spread throughout the soul sea and even outside, far and wide.
[Awakening process initiated. Time till complete awakening: 5 hours]
Kent opened his eyes on the outside, and with them, a large coffin also appeared, causing his beast companions to take several steps back.
"What is that?" Yggzrael asked, his expression pale as he stared at the black coffin decorated with several runes and symbols.
"It would be best if we wait for him to awaken and tell us himself. I have no idea who is inside this coffin, but I know he wouldn’t hurt me or any of you."
"That is reassuring. I was nearly freaked out to death."

Kent chuckled, finding the expressions on the faces of his demigod beast companions a bit funny. The moment the shaman awakened, they would plan to invade the Chaos Layer and perhaps meet the Vagabonds’ leader.
Unbeknownst to Kent, his arrival in the Vagabond Kingdom had already been foreseen by the Overlord of the Vagabonds, who ordered her people in the Chaos Layer to make sure nothing happened to him.
As to why she did what she did, Kent would find that out when he arrived in the Vagabond Kingdom.
That said, while Kent and everyone waited for the shaman to awaken, the Evil Army and its Soul Warriors had already conquered every last city in the first gateway.
With the kind of army they led into battle, Stone City fell within hours. Their leader was killed by the High Priestess, who later brought him back to life and turned him into a wraith.
It was one of the abilities she had awakened after her transformation.
Aside from that, she was able to march all the survivors to Skull City to earn the Mark of Evil, and the warriors were made to undergo the Trial of Evil.

While that was happening, Bello, the third Soul warrior and the strongest, had accumulated enough kills, so he summoned a Grim Reaper to aid in their conquest. Who would have expected the Grim Reaper to be someone extremely deadly?
The moment Stone City fell, the others started to form alliances, but Bello, Kenna, and Calix led the three Shadow Fiends and the Evil Army, which had now expanded to 800,000, to subjugate them all.
It took them two weeks, but they managed to conquer the last of them.
A week later, the army under their command numbered in the millions, 4.5 million to be exact.

However, after the first gateway was conquered, they knew they had to move on to the next. Already, Bello had sent the Grim Reaper, whom he named Ehubo, to the next gateway since he could travel back and forth between realms.
The moment he gathered intel on the next gateway, he returned to report.

"They have already sensed the change here and have started planning. Unlike this place, they have only four cities, but massive ones. Each has an army of 3 million capable soldiers. I counted 12 demigods in each army, but there may be a few hidden.
"In terms of combat power and demigods, we outnumber them. However, I wouldn’t be too relaxed until they are all under our control."
Bello and the others nodded.
"In that case, why don’t you go back and open the gateway for us? We will come over as soon as the gateway opens."

A day later, a massive gateway opened, and the three Soul Warriors led the Evil Army to the next gateway. Kent had already made them aware that he was after the people, so senseless killing wasn’t the approach they used.
Of course, a few tried to play the arrogant card, and they died, only to return as wraiths.
In the end, the second gateway also fell, and the Evil Army grew even more.
Calix, who was a True Immortal when they began, had already reached the peak of the Immortal Lord stage, with Kenna and Bello already ascending to the demigod stage.
Each breakthrough added to their strength and unlocked more powers.
Bello even summoned a second Grim Reaper and named him Gimick. With the two of them under his control, he sent them to the third and fourth gateways to pass the message of the Evil King to them.

Two gateways had now joined the Evil Army. This meant that in no time, the remaining five would be next. And since the gateways could not travel to each other, when the message reached them, three gateways surrendered.
However, the fifth and seventh gateways chose to resist.
Bello and his pals chose to beef up their Evil Army. Once done, they would pay them a visit and have a nice chat.
Kent and his beast companions had been waiting diligently for the five hours to pass. Every passing minute felt like a day to him.
Thankfully, the time for the awakening soon came, and the moment the timer struck zero, the entire Tormented Layer was plunged into absolute darkness.
Everyone except Kent was blinded.

Well, maybe he was also blinded, but from where he sat, he seemed to have appeared in the domain of the Grand Shaman, and staring back at him was an Ancient Evil, one that made Kent break into a cold sweat just by looking at it.
He knew he was staring at the Grand Shaman; however, he couldn’t help but tremble in sheer terror.
If he had the means, Kent would have bolted. After all, staring back at him was the most dangerous sight he had ever seen.
Suddenly, a voice entered his head, freezing him where he stood.
"We meet again, Child of Evil."

chapters.title: Chapter 1633: Grand Shaman Malak (2)
paragraphs: Kent was left dumbfounded and utterly terrified when the voice spoke to him.
First, being in a statue pose wasn’t exactly eye candy, especially when it resembled curses manifested in reality and entangled to form a calamity, perhaps an abomination.

It looked like a horrifying fusion of a cosmic shaman, corpse deity, and primordial nightmare. His skull resembled an ancient deer skull fused with black divine metal. Twelve broken abyssal horns extended backwards like a corrupted crown. The horns constantly leaked dark-red spiritual flames. Ancient evil runes glowed beneath the bone surface.
Kent chose to focus only on the head, since the rest of its body terrified him even more.
Its voice was also far from pleasant.
It was like he had heard the voice of the most dangerous thing in the entire universe. Even if he knew the one speaking to him was the Grand Shaman, that didn’t calm him down, not even for a moment.
He was terrified, and that said a lot for someone who had seen his fair share of terror.
"I see you don’t have your memories back, huh? Allow me to fix that..."
Suddenly, a blue orb flew from the statue and merged with Kent’s forehead. In that instant, memories flooded into his mind.

Inside those memories, he saw the moment the Ruthless Bandit stepped into the Trial of Evil to try to become a True Evil. When he arrived at the trial, he entered a role-playing session in which he was the son of a marquis.
One thing led to another, and his father was betrayed, leading to an overnight massacre. He survived because he sleepwalked out of their estate that night.

When he regained his senses and saw what had happened, he sought revenge, and for three days, he killed so many people that the entire world shed tears of anguish. As part of the trial, he was supposed to lose all his cultivation and start anew.
However, when he saw what had happened to his family, something broke inside him, and the trial couldn’t stop him. So he killed and kept killing until they appeared before him, 24 of them.
They introduced themselves as the 24 Grand Shamans. They said they had been banished and had spent years searching for a master to bring them back into the Universe, any Universe.
The Trial of Evil was their creation, meant to find someone worthy of becoming their master.
They never succeeded until they met the Ruthless Bandit.

So they took him in, and for years, they taught him how to harness the power of True Evil. However, he was incomplete, so they told him to go back, and that one day, when he reincarnated, they would come to him.
What the Ruthless Bandit lacked back then was goodness. He possessed all the evil and none of the good, so he couldn’t reach the stage they never could.
Even Ancient evils knew evil can’t do away with goodness. So Kent was their only chance, per what they said to him before letting him go back to the infinity universe.
At least, that was what Kent remembered.
Now, Kent had returned as a complete True Evil, and with his memories restored, all fear he felt toward the being had washed away.
"Big Brother Malak, that wasn’t cool. You nearly scared me to death," Kent said with a pout as he turned his back to the statue of the Ancient Evil.
For a moment, no voice came. Then, suddenly, a whooshing sound echoed out, and a man spoke, "Relax, Little Brother. I merely wanted to tease you."

Kent smiled and turned back, meeting the gaze of one of his big brothers. Back in that trial, all 24 Ancient Evils took him in as their little brother and made sure he finally came to terms with his trauma.
It was because of them that after the Ruthless Bandit left the Star Realm, he chose to fight for the Universe rather than destroy it.
The trauma that turned him into the Ruthless Bandit was finally handled by the 24 Grand Shamans. In a way, the universe owes them for that.
Kent spent a moment examining his First Big Brother, Malak.

He possessed extremely long black hair mixed with crimson strands. Pale grey skin resembling cold marble. Deep, sharp cheekbones, a narrow jawline, and ancient curse markings spread from his neck to his temples.
Kent blinked a few times before meeting Malak’s gaze. He knew the kind of horror this big brother of his was, so he chose to be cautious.
Malak had crimson eyes with black concentric rings. His pupils resembled ritual symbols, the kind that would make anyone who stares too long feel spiritual pressure crushing their soul.
He was tall and lean, clad in layered black-and-dark-red shamanic robes. Thousands of tiny cursed talismans hung from his sleeves.
As for accessories, Malak wore bone earrings forged from Supreme Beasts. Chains wrapped around both arms. Finger bones were worn as rings.
"You haven’t changed a day, Big Brother." Kent walked forward and hugged him.
If people knew the man Kent was hugging was someone with authority over curses, blood sacrifice, ancient spirits, and corruption, they would probably freak out.
"Well, you don’t look too bad yourself, Little Brother." After breaking the hug, Malak opened his eyes and scanned Kent for a moment before nodding.
"Not bad. I see you have made so much progress early this time around." He paused and narrowed his eyes. A few seconds later, he moved and sniffed Kent’s hair.
"Oh, interesting. Have you met the Nine First Undead?"
Kent’s eyes widened. "How... how did you know?"
Malak laughed. "I can smell them on you, Lil Bro. I hope they didn’t make things hard for you."
Kent was dumbfounded. "Big Brother, do you know them?"
"I sure do, we created them."
"What?" Kent nearly lost his balance, but Malak steadied him with his staff.

"No need to be in shock. We had just been banished from our universe and were looking for a home. We found their universe and chose to settle there until we found a master. However, it didn’t take long for that universe to be attacked by one of the Corrupted Kings.
"We watched them all become corrupted, except for nine brave souls who chose death over corruption. In that instant, someone we had no idea who they were appeared and temporarily freed us.

"The person said nothing and just left. So we debated what to do, and I suggested we create the first kind of warriors that could neither die nor become corrupted. Their mission was to counter the Corrupted Kings.
"So we created them, and after they defeated the Corrupted King, we let them drift around like us."
Malak sighed, and then he looked at Kent with a serious expression.

"If they are here and so are we, then I am afraid the corruption is coming, and this universe will be swept over like a tide. We must prepare, Little Brother, because like it or not, you are the only one who can put an end to all this."
Kent nodded and smiled. "Rest assured, Big Brother, I have no plans on letting even a single soul in this universe become corrupted."
"That is the spirit." Malak laughed. "Now, allow me to announce my awakening to the entire world."
"As you wish, Big Brother."
Kent opened his eyes on the outside, and at the same time, the lid on the coffin opened, and Malak sat up. Then he stood up and stepped out of the coffin.
He nodded at Kent and his horrified beast companions before his bone-chilling laughter spread across the entire Tormented Chaos Abyss.
Every beast, be it the weakest or the strongest, felt cold sweat break out across their backs. No threat was heard, but they all felt it.
A Real Evil had arrived in their domain.

chapters.title: Chapter 1634: Nuella
paragraphs: Nuella, the Nine-Tailed Red Fox, moved with a speed that would put even Supremes to shame as she rushed toward the Tormented Layer.
As she moved, one could see every step she took leave a rune mark on the ground. As a beast that specialised in illusion, she was making sure those following behind wouldn’t catch up too early.
After all, she had trapped some very angry forbidden beasts inside a dome she knew would take them at least a day to break free from.
Now, she was rushing to the Tormented Layer, specifically to the dragon who had already become the Monarch of the Tormented Layer.
"I need to hurry and reach the Young Lord before these bastards break free and call for reinforcements."
Just as she was about to jump over a large boulder, a chilling wind blew over her, causing her body to freeze in place for a second.
When she regained control of her body, she stumbled and fell, or at least she was supposed to fall face-first into thick dust. However, she found herself hugging a coffin.
Immediately, she sensed many powerful presences around her, including one that made her bones tingle. Raising her head, she met Kent’s handsome golden-purple eyes, which made her calm down a bit.
However, she proceeded to turn to her left, and that was when she met Malak’s gaze. Her body froze again, and under everyone’s gaze, she fell backwards and collapsed.
Kent and his demigods were left dumbfounded as they watched Nuella collapse like she had seen a ghost.
"Big Brother, maybe you should do something about your presence. Look, even my companions are scared of you."
Indeed, Yggzrael and the others were terrified of Malak despite knowing he was one of them.
Kent even tried to make them shake Malak’s hand; however, they ran back, turning their gaze away from him, saying he scares them.
Malak laughed. "This is me restraining myself, Little Brother. I guess, as an Ancient Evil, my presence naturally freaks people out."
Kent could only shake his head. "I suppose we must have a bonding session to make sure everyone gets comfortable around you. I can’t have my companions terrified of my big brother."
Malak laughed. "I can bestow upon them an attribute that would make them less terrified of me. However, they would have to accept it willingly."
Kent thought for a moment and then turned to his beast companions.
"What do you guys think? Are you willing to accept Big Brother’s gift?"
They didn’t answer for a few minutes. While they were scared of Malak, that didn’t justify the suppression they were under. It was like staring at him made them feel small, almost insignificant.
They hated that feeling, so changing it seemed ideal.
Kent saw the 40 demigod beasts debate using their shared connection as a medium for a few minutes before Cryodrak, the Glacial Wyrm, replied to Kent.
"We want to do it, Young Lord."
"Very well." Malak smiled and gently tapped his staff against the ground, manifesting a red formation. He formed a few hand seals with his left hand, then spoke some ancient, unknown words.
Kent understood what he said because they had taught him their language, a language only the 24 of them knew. After he finished whatever he was working on, he turned to Kent.
"You have to name this attribute. It works based on how much trust they have in you. The weaker their trust, the weaker the effect."
Kent nodded and thought for a moment before managing to come up with a name.
"I will name it Evil Fiends."
Just as he spoke the name, runes emerged from the formations and merged with their foreheads.
[Your Forbidden & Grim Beast Companions have received a new Attribute: Evil Fiends]
[Evil Fiends]
[Description: Blessed by Grand Shaman Malak, an Ancient Evil, based on your trust in your Young Lord, no evil shall shake your resolve.]
"Oh, looks like you have some of the most loyal beasts I have seen," Malak mused, sensing that all 40 demigod beasts gathered around had become less afraid of him.
"I only accept beasts I share kinship with, Big Brother. I have no room for traitors," Kent said with his shoulders held high.

"They sure are loyal. However, to make sure they are completely immune to all forms of evil, you must raise your ranking. You are only a True Evil, Little Brother; you must rise through the ranks and unlock the unique powers hidden within you."
Kent nodded.
He knew from the start that after the True Evil stage, there was Great Evil, Cursed Evil, Unholy Evil, Tyrant Evil, Supreme Evil, and finally Ancient Evil.
"I still have a few things to handle, Big Brother. Once I am done with that, I will take the Great Evil Trial."
Kent said with conviction, and then his gaze shifted to the red fox on the ground.
She calmly opened her eyes and jerked up and landed on her feet. Then she transformed into her beast form, and her aura as a Universal God started to spill out.

"Relax, young lady, we have no interest in hurting you," Malak spoke and waved his staff, clearing the Universe God aura inside the ice fortress. "I brought you here because I heard you say you were coming to the dragon in the Tormented Layer."
Malak gestured toward Kent. "Here you go. Why were you coming to him?"
Nuella turned, and her gaze landed on Kent, the same person her Queen had sent her to find.
She shook off the lingering pressure pressing down on her. Then she addressed Kent, making sure her focus didn’t return to Malak.
"My name is Nuella, a Vagabond Captain..."
Kent furrowed his brow. "A Vagabond, huh. Can’t say I am surprised. However, why are you here?"
"My Queen sent me to come fetch you. She has been expecting you for a while now."
"A while, you say. How long has she been waiting?"
"I don’t know, but it has been a couple of years," Nuella replied.
’About the same time I arrived on Planet Sonox, if we factor in the time difference.’ Kent nodded and turned to Malak.
"I guess we will be taking a trip soon, Big Brother."
"I will prepare the transport formation," Malak said before teleporting away from the fortress. His coffin dissolved into mist, turned into a runic mark, and merged with Kent.
A message appeared before Kent.
[You have received the Mark of Malak. Because your ranking is low, the benefits have been sealed. Required ranking to unlock benefits: Great Evil]
[Your Evil Heart is reacting with the Mark of Malak.]
[Attempting to retrieve a benefit...]
[Congratulations, you have unlocked a benefit from the Mark of Malak. Benefit: Malak’s Authority]
[Malak’s Authority]
[Description: You have permission to invoke ancient curses on anyone using Grand Shaman Malak’s name without any backlash.]
[Curse Points: 2]
’Damn, now I have no reason to be afraid of even a Universal God, or two Universal Gods.’ Kent laughed inwardly, his happiness bubbling.

20 kilometres away, Malak smiled and muttered, "What an interesting guy. Is he perhaps the one True Evil the Ancient Scrolls spoke of?" He sighed and gazed back at the fortress. "Whether it is him or not, only time will tell."
He returned to creating the formation that would transport them directly to the Vagabond Kingdom.
Meanwhile, Kent created a throne for Nuella.
"Tell me more about this Queen of yours."
