chapters.title: Chapter 1635: The Four Abominations (1)
paragraphs: While Kent was busy awakening Malak, his top four strongest demigod-level Beasts had finally made it to the dungeon. Since the four dungeons were scattered across the four regions, they had to travel to the central region that once belonged to Crimson before splitting up.
Crimson chose to go to the Northern Dungeon, while Nexorphis, the strongest of them, went for the Southern Dungeon.
Ixeron, the second strongest, chose the Eastern Dungeon, and finally, Kaldrex, the fourth strongest, went for the Western Dungeon.
They knew it would be a dangerous battle, so they all decided to go all out from the start. At the end of the day, they must kill their opponent, not defeat it.
[Crimson vs The Skullrender]
Crimson arrived at a place called the Crimson Grave Depths. It was a graveyard, or so it appeared. The moment he stepped into the place, he felt a pair of crazed eyes land on his body.
"I know I am going to regret this. However, why do I feel like this would be the most exciting battle of my life?" Crimson smiled, his crimson hair billowing behind him in the air.
He held his sword, a weapon that had accompanied him for years now. He looked at the sword and knew the weapon spirit was close to awakening.
Kent had already assured him that soon, the weapon spirit would awaken, and his strength would rise once again.
"If I can kill this abomination, I will ask the Young Lord to help awaken you. While I can’t surpass Ixeron and Nexorphis, if I don’t become even stronger, that Kaldrex guy will soon take my spot."

Crimson was a competitive Beast. While he ranked as the third strongest in the Beast Army, he recognised that his spot was not cemented like Nexorphis and Ixeron, who could hold their heads high and move uncontested.
He knew he had to become even stronger.
Before Crimson realised it, he had traversed quite a vast distance into the Crimson Grave Depths. Soon, he could sense the presence of a very powerful being.
"Demon, have you come here to die for real this time?" A twisted voice, almost as if several voices had been cut apart and merged together, spoke, causing the very air to tremble.
"No... I am actually here to kill you this time around," Crimson replied, his gaze narrowing at the being he had fought 54,000 years ago and barely survived against.
Back then, he had just become the strongest in the Tormented Layer, or so he thought, so he went to challenge the Abominations. His target, however, had been the Skullrender.
The battle lasted for only half an hour, but he had been forced to flee with his tail tucked between his legs. Coming today was both for revenge and to regain his dignity.
"The last time, I fought you with just 20% of my power. Today, I can tell you are much stronger, so I will use 50%. I hope you don’t die too fast before I have enough fun, Demon"
A claw came out of nowhere and took a swipe at Crimson’s head. He used his sword to block and was pushed back a few meters.
Just as he stabilised himself, a tail attached to a cleaver arrived before his chest, with deadly speed.
"Too slow, Demon."
Crimson barely dodged the cleaver when a tentacle lined with razor-sharp bones arrived before his eyes. This time, it grazed his shoulder, drawing blood.
"Damn it," Crimson cursed as he turned his body into blood mist and reformed 3 km away. However, just when he reformed, a blood spear stabbed into his chest, sending him flying backwards...

"Blood Chaos Qi? Really? Are you that dumb, demon, thinking you can use blood-related skills against me?" The Skullrender appeared above Crimson, finally allowing him to see the monstrosity clearly for the first time ever.
From Crimson’s perspective, Skullrender was not merely a beast but a walking catastrophe of flesh, bone, blood, and ancient Chaos corruption fused together.
Its existence alone distorted the atmosphere around it, making the sky bleed crimson while the ground decayed beneath its footsteps.
Standing at over 120 meters tall, it resembled a monstrous fusion between a primordial demon, an abyssal dragon, and a skeletal war titan.
He had no time to take in more details because, before he knew it, he was at the mercy of ten tentacles extending from Skullrender’s back, each stabbing toward his head and chest.
"Crimson Moon Slaughter!"
Crimson unleashed a wide arc slash that severed several tentacles, and using the momentum, he moved back, distancing himself.
’I may have underestimated this monstrosity,’ Crimson said inwardly as he finally came to the realisation that he would not be able to win, not if he fought like a true warrior.
’Good thing the Young Lord himself didn’t come.’
Crimson moved back again, and his body transformed, taking on his demonic appearance. His height rose to 40 meters, and so did his greatsword.
"Blood Rain Thousand Pierces!"
He activated the skill he had used against Kent’s Scale Shield. At once, a rain of swords started falling toward Skullrender, who sensed danger and created a dome of crimson energy around his body.
But would that be enough?
Crimson didn’t bother waiting to find out as he started bombarding his opponent with deadly sword arcs, each infused with Absolute Immortal Sword Energy.
"No more talking," he taunted, seeing that he had finally started pushing Skullrender back. The power behind his sword energy was not something that could be easily defended against.
Skullrender realised that, but in the short term, he could not do anything about it.
Even so, as more swords rained down on him and more sword arcs struck its bone-like body, Crimson could tell killing it was far beyond his reach.
’I guess I must play dirty and use the item Malgoreth gave us.’
He hated the idea of using dirty tricks, but he knew he had to kill this punk, just as instructed by his Young Lord.

Their battle soon turned even more chaotic. However, the advantage constantly alternated between them, as one would gain the upper hand for a moment, only for the other to take over in the next second.
However, one thing was certain: Crimson had already acknowledged Skullrender’s ability and had resorted to using underhanded means to win.

Later, when they became teammates, perhaps he would challenge him to a proper duel. Already, he could tell this bastard threatened his position as the third strongest, so winning here would give him some bragging rights.
’Damn it, to think I went from the strongest to the third strongest, and now I am uncertain where I would place... I am truly unlucky.’
He cursed his luck, but his focus remained rooted in the battle.
[Nexorphis vs The Fatebreaker]
Meanwhile, Nexorphis had also arrived in the Southern Region and made her way toward the Shattered Void, a space where the void itself had completely transformed the environment.
Nexorphis had no problem with the nature of the battlefield since she also commanded the power of the void.
However, the moment she stepped inside the Shattered Void, she felt her body shift through several layers of dimensions before finally stopping before a monster of unimaginable horror.
The moment their gazes met, Nexorphis felt her soul travel through countless distorted realms before returning...
"Welcome to my domain, Reality Bender." the being greeted.
"Well met, Fatebreaker."
There was a pause where not even the wind dared to blow.
The next second, space shattered completely, and Nexorphis grinned.
"Ah, how I long for a battle of this magnitude."
"Same, Reality Bender, same. Now, allow me to devour you so I can evolve to the next stage, where not even fate can bind me."

chapters.title: Chapter 1636: The Four Abominations (2)
paragraphs: Nexorphis was a Reality Bender. She possessed affinities for Void, Space, Darkness, and Time. That made her the strongest demigod-level Beast under Kent’s command. Her abilities are just too much to comprehend.
However, her opponent perfectly countered her and, in a way, even surpassed her. Fatebreaker possessed affinities for Fate, Space, Corruption, Dimension, and Void.
While time was not part of his abilities, his [Throne of the End] skill allowed him to slow down time considerably, among many other terrifying effects.
So, the battle was not one Nexorphis could afford to underestimate.
However, it was precisely because of the danger Fatebreaker possessed that she felt this would become the most exciting battle of her life.

From the day she was created until this very moment, she had never been defeated, not even once, so this battle would test her abilities to their absolute limits or maybe not if her intelligence was factored in.
Naturally, she was more than ready to see what would happen when she reached that limit.
Unfortunately for her, she saw the limit of her abilities just thirty seconds into the battle.
"Dimension of Corruption."
Fatebreaker activated a skill, and all Nexorphis could see was darkness before her body started decaying.
The attack came so suddenly that before she could make sense of anything, 50% of her energy had already been drained. It was simply too sudden...
But the moment the danger settled into her mind, she felt excitement wash over her.
’Then let me use it.’
The moment those words echoed in her mind, her Time Element activated, and everything paused.
"Reversal."
Everything reversed, restoring the dimension around her to its former shattered state, the exact moment before [Dimension of Corruption] had been activated.
Two seconds later, Fatebreaker used [Dimension of Corruption] again, and Nexorphis found herself trapped within the decaying dimension once more.
However, this time, she remained calm.
Three seconds later, time reversed itself again, and they returned to the point before [Dimension of Corruption] had been activated.
Yet again, two seconds later, the Dimension of Corruption activated once more.
Three seconds later, time reversed itself again.
"What..." Fatebreaker noticed the anomaly, but before he could make sense of anything, [Dimension of Corruption] activated once more.
"What are you doing?" Fatebreaker asked in a furious tone.
"Not what I am doing, but rather what have I done."
A giggle escaped Nexorphis’s lips as she tried to make out the true form of Fatebreaker now that she had some time on her hands.
From what she could see, he looked like a catastrophic fusion of an abyssal dragon, a void entity, and a living dimensional collapse.

Though she saw a giant draconic figure standing on two legs, or at least that was what she was meant to see. Regardless, she had already formed a loop, not to prolong her own inevitable death, but to outsmart Fatebreaker.
Aside from her monstrous affinities, her intelligence is only second to Ixeron’s.
"Fatebreaker, I never really expected you to have this much power at your disposal. I mean, the ability to create dimensions and even corrupt them is simply too powerful.
Let’s not even talk about the power of Fate. You truly are a much better counter to me, even stronger than I am, the moment the power to manipulate fate comes into play.
However, you are mistaken about one thing. I may not possess the power over fate, but I am the Reality Bender.
My power fundamentally revolves around reality, and within reality, there is Time. No matter how powerful you are, you can never escape time."
Nexorphis chuckled.
Just then, Fatebreaker sensed that something was terribly wrong.
"You... what did you do?"
Five seconds in the past, he sensed a scythe sever his head from his body. At the same time, five seconds in the future, he sensed two blades stab into his head.

"I know you can sense it... hehe." Nexorphis laughed. "You don’t actually expect me to play fair, do you? As the Reality Bender, I rewrote the reality around us, making it seem as though we had already fought and would continue to fight.
However, knowing how monstrous you are, I knew I had to make you believe you had the upper hand, so I trapped you in the present, while the true battle was happening in the future and the past.
Reality is indeed a dangerous element to manipulate, especially with time attached to it."
Just then, the [Dimension of Corruption] reversed, and the time loop shattered. Nexorphis felt her energy draining once again.
However, she merely stood there, and five seconds later, two swords emerged from nowhere and pierced Fatebreaker’s head, killing him instantly.
"I guess I remain undisputed as the strongest demigod," she laughed.
Before she could think about taking away the body, a little girl with purple hair appeared and hovered beside her.
"Nicely done, Big Sister Nexorphis."
Tower extended her hand, and a green fruit hovered in the air before her.
"Feed the juice to him."

This was Nexorphis’s first time seeing Tower, but she felt no threat from her. In fact, she felt drawn toward her, the same attraction she and the others had felt when they formed their contract with Kent.
So, she did as she was told and squeezed the fruit, letting the juice drip into Fatebreaker’s mouth. Tower waved her hand once more, and an Abomination Contract appeared and merged with Fatebreaker.
His body was cocooned, and with another wave of her hand, both he and Nexorphis vanished.
Tower sighed.
"Master clearly underestimated Big Sister Nexorphis."
After letting her thoughts settle, Tower also vanished and reappeared somewhere near the Ice Fortress.
[Ixeron vs The Soulmaw]
Ixeron had also been matched against a perfect counter to his abilities. However, from the moment he appeared in the dungeon, he felt that something was terribly wrong with his opponent.
This became clear when he arrived at the core layer of the Domain of Tormented Nightmares.
He saw that his opponent, the Soulmaw, was lying unconscious on the ground and twitching as though it had been electrocuted.
Ixeron could tell at first glance that the battle wouldn’t be between him and the Soulmaw. His intelligence is so high that a mere was all he needed to deduce complex observations.
Suddenly, a grey orb flew out from its body, transformed into a winged dragon, and flew toward Ixeron.
At first sight, he wanted to attack and kill it. However, just as it drew closer, Ixeron realised it was not approaching him with hostile intent.
"Are you here to kill me for rebelling?" the dragon spoke, causing Ixeron to blink slowly.
"Naturally, yes, but not for rebelling. However, I have reasons to believe you are not asking this out of malice. Also, judging by your deformed state, I believe you are already at death’s door."
"Perceptive, I see."
The dragon hovered silently for a few seconds before speaking again.
"I am indeed dying. However, I do not wish to die this way. I want you to kill me, but before that, there is something you need to see."
The dragon transformed into mist, which shifted and formed a portal, more accurately, a Mind Portal.
Ixeron raised his brow at the sight.

As someone with the power of mind manipulation, he knew exactly what a Mind Portal represented. It was a gateway into one’s Mind Space. If not properly protected, an intruder could enter and inflict severe damage upon the mind itself.
Opening it for him was essentially Soulmaw’s way of telling him he meant no harm and that he was truly desperate.
Ixeron stood there for a few moments before a sigh escaped his lips.
He extended his hand and summoned one of his [Thought Cores], sending it through the Mind Portal. The portal closed a second later, and Ixeron appeared within a domain of collapsing stars.
"I’ll be damned... a true Primordial Space, huh?"
"Welcome to my mind domain, fellow Mind Cultivator..."
Ixeron heard chains rattling behind him, so he turned around.
That was when he saw the real Soulmaw, shackled within his own mind.

chapters.title: Chapter 1637: The Four Abominations (3)
paragraphs: Ixeron first studied Soulmaw with a narrowed expression, both confused and intrigued.

He had not had much interaction with beasts, so he was taken aback to see someone trapped within their own mind. Soulmaw was bound by four thick chains, each exuding a terrifying power, one that Ixeron recognised all too well.

Before he became Kent’s Forbidden Beast companion, he also had a seal with the same energy signature planted in his mind. It was through that seal that all of them had received the command from the dark lich to kill Kent.
Now, that same power had bound Soulmaw, and from the look of things, he would soon die.

"First of all, how did you end up in this situation?" Ixeron asked, but then a better question popped into his mind. "More importantly, how are you sane when you are clearly an Abomination Beast? From what I heard, abominations are an insane bunch."
"You did not hear wrong. We abominations are indeed a rowdy bunch. However, I am different."
"How different?"

"I managed to become aware of my true nature, you know, the state I was in before that madman turned me into this. I regained my sanity, and thanks to that, I managed to grow beyond anything he had ever dreamed I could become.

However, after regaining my sanity, I sought freedom. So, like you, I tried to break the seal, but as you can see, I failed. Now, I will die, and that madman will revive me, permanently turning me into an insane puppet."
Ixeron nodded, perfectly understanding Soulmaw’s situation. He could see the unwillingness in Soulmaw’s eyes, a sigh that this beast doesn’t want to become insane.
"I commend you for regaining your sanity. However, I am not the one who broke the seal. It was my Young Lord."
"Young Lord?" Soulmaw furrowed his brow, hearing such a title for the first time.

"My Young Lord is a monarch, and he has a way of breaking seals. Aside from that, he also awakened our innate bodies and bloodlines. As you can see, I am much different from the Forbidden Beasts you once knew."
"Indeed. But I have to ask, did that madman not try to kill you before this Young Lord broke the seal?"
Ixeron shook his head.

"No. I do not know the intensity of the seal placed upon us, but mine was not strong enough for him to take control of my mind the way he did yours. Perhaps he never anticipated that a day like this would come, a day when someone would dare take his creations away from him."
"Interesting. I never knew we could be freed this way."
Soulmaw was stunned, though he tried to hide it. But he saw a glimmer of hope, even if he only sought death at this point.
"Do you perhaps think I can meet this Young Lord you spoke of? Looking at you now, I can tell you are far superior to the Forbidden Beasts and even me. I would not mind pledging my loyalty to him."
Ixeron smiled.
"Trust me, you would fare far better with him than with that madman. However, since you called me here, I assume you wanted me to kill you."
"Yes. If you can sever the Tormented Chains, killing me would free me from becoming a puppet of my creator."
"Very well. I will kill you as a final act of mercy to a fellow Mind Cultivator."
"Thank you, friend."
Soulmaw exhaled and closed his eyes. For an abomination to actually manage to fight against its nature and even attempt to free itself, Ixeron found him worthy of receiving a merciful death.
Ixeron extended his hand as the [Silent Crown] appeared before him. He placed it on his head, and the eye on the crown snapped open, revealing the weaknesses within the four chains.
The moment he spotted the weak points, he summoned the [Abyssal Mind Spears] and sent them lunging toward the flaws in the chains.
A second later, the spears struck, and the chains, which would not have budged even under an assault from a God Ascension Stage cultivator, snapped and shattered into countless pieces.
Somewhere far away, Grand Dark Lich Barnabas felt something pierce his soul, causing his body to tremble.
Directing his attention toward the source, he saw the chains binding one of his perfect Abominations shatter and disperse into smoke.
His furious scream of anguish filled the entire planet he was staying on.
Meanwhile, Ixeron, who had only been sent to kill the abominations, directed a mental skill called [Desolation Mind], using it to pierce Soulmaw’s forehead, killing him instantly.
It was quick and painless.
On the outside, Ixeron sighed and muttered, "Rest well, friend."
"I am afraid Soulmaw’s journey had not even begun yet."
Tower appeared beside Ixeron, licking a flat-shaped lollipop and wearing a pirate hat.
Tower extended her hand, and a similar lollipop flew toward Ixeron, who caught it with a stunned expression.
"You’ve earned it. Treating an enemy that mercifully shows you are not the bloodthirsty kind."
After hearing Tower’s compliment, Ixeron smiled and bowed toward her.
"Thank you, Young miss. I suppose the Young Lord sent you."
"Yes."
Tower produced the same type of green fruit she had given to Nexorphis.
"Squeeze the juice into his mouth or nose."
Soon, they were away from the dungeon, appearing beside Nexorphis and the cocoon containing Fatebreaker.
A second later, Crimson also appeared, his body littered with several cuts, though a smile could still be seen on his face.
"What a monster you were, Skullrender."
Crimson had fought a brave battle, but in the end, he had played dirty and won. Even so, he commended himself for surviving against such an opponent.
"Looks like you had it rough, Crimson," Nexorphis teased while standing atop a brown stone.
Turning toward her, Crimson saw that she was completely clean and looked even more graceful than before.
Crimson sighed.
"Not everyone can bend reality as they see fit, so don’t compare yourself to me."
Nexorphis giggled.
"I suppose there is a reason I am number one. None of you can measure up to me."

"That is why none of us even tried to. However, from where I stand, you are basically a cheat manifested as a Beast," Crimson said with a chuckle, recalling how ridiculous Nexorphis’s abilities had sounded when they discussed their powers a few days ago.
"The ability to bend reality and fight in the past, present, and future... who can defend against such an ability?"
Ixeron smiled, and as calm and quiet as he was, he patted Crimson on the shoulder.
"It would be best if you did not think too much about how monstrous she is and instead focus on improving yourself.
I can hypnotise you so you can focus more on yourself and forget about others."

"That will not be necessary, Ixeron. I have only just tapped into Absolute Sword Energy. Once I learn to wield it together with my Sword Intent, Aura, and Domain, we will see if she can keep running her mouth."
"I like the spirit, Crimson, but don’t bite off more than you can chew."
Just as Nexorphis was about to let out another one of her classic giggles, Kaldrex appeared with his body completely covered in thousands of cuts and burn marks, even more than Crimson.
The three moved toward him, and Crimson supported his body before he could fall.
"What happened, buddy?" Ixeron asked.
The green cocoon beside him showed that Kaldrex had succeeded in defeating his opponent.
However, looking at his injuries, one could only wonder what exactly had happened when he faced off against his opponent.
Kent appeared beside Kaldrex and handed him a yellow fruit.
"Eat this, Kaldrex."
Kaldrex accepted the fruit and ate it in one bite. A second later, yellow energy washed through and over his body, healing his injuries at a terrifying speed.
In less than a minute, he had recovered enough to speak.
He turned and looked at Kent.
"Young Lord, that abomination was a plague..."
His body trembled as he started to narrate what had happened when he arrived in the Plague Kingdom.

chapters.title: Chapter 1638: The Four Abominations (4)
paragraphs: Kaldrex, being the fourth strongest, was also among the demigods sent to hunt down the abominations. His opponent, though he was not aware of it yet, might as well be considered the most dangerous of all four abominations.
Kaldrex had no idea, so like the others, he went after one of the four Abominations.
Kaldrex possessed the power worthy of his rank as the fourth strongest. However, what none of the other Beasts knew was that Kaldrex was actually far more monstrous than that.
The part of his power that had been suppressed and sealed within his soul was actually an untamed force that, when he fully awakens, would place him at the top.
Even now, he could already be considered a terrifying opponent.

However, the moment he stepped into the Plague Kingdom, he felt as though he had walked directly into danger. Kaldrex sensed it immediately, a wave of necrotic energy carrying decay, corruption, and every vile thing a person would instinctively flee from.
But it was already too late.
By the time Kaldrex realised the danger he was in, he had already reached the core of the Rotten Domain, and to his absolute shock, he found himself surrounded on all sides.
"Eat him, my parasites. Feast upon his fresh flesh and drink his blood."
"That was all I heard before all hell broke loose. I was surrounded on all sides by insect-like beasts, each carrying poison and acid. The burn marks came from them detonating their own bodies.
That corrosive acid was what made me realise that victory was not something I could achieve easily, especially when I had no idea where the main target was."
Kaldrex sighed.
"I only survived because, during a critical moment, one of the seals inside my body partially unsealed and allowed me to use Extreme Gravity.

That bought me two seconds to search for my target and another two seconds to kill him before my advantage disappeared. Thankfully, after three seconds, I spotted him, and with Malgoreth’s poison, I managed to buy myself two more seconds.
That is the only reason I am standing here right now. Had it not been for that partial unsealing, I would have died."

If one were to ask what a true abomination looked like, the Plaguefather would be the perfect example. The powers that abomination possessed were far beyond what a Beast at its current stage should have been capable of wielding.
"Looks like you’ve gathered yourself some rather interesting subordinates, little brother."
Malak suddenly appeared and brushed his hand against the green cocoon housing the Plaguefather’s resurrected body.
Kent smiled.
"I have the Dark Lich to thank for that. He planned on taking over the Star Realm, so he performed experiments on all of them. Now, they are part of my family, and one day, we will bring him down."
Kent paused before smiling at Malak again.
"In fact, your mission will be to bring every last Beast within this Banished Zone under my command. The last thing I want is to let a deranged madman continue possessing this much power."
Malak nodded.

"I will make sure that one day you possess a power capable of facing any obstacle. Though I must say, if you do not mind, after you have your revenge on this madman, would you hand him over to me? I believe that if he could create something this dangerous, I can turn him into an obedient subordinate."
"I have no problem with that, as long as he never gets the chance to harm innocent Beasts again."
"Rest assured, whatever we do will only serve to expand your power."
Kent knew the kind of monsters his big brothers were, so he had no reason to doubt his words. However, he could not help but wonder what would happen if Malak and the Dark Lich combined their powers.
Kent chose not to dwell on that thought.
He introduced Malak to his four strongest subordinates since they had not been around when he awakened him.
He also bestowed the [Evil Fiends] attribute upon them, causing their fear of Malak to lessen slightly.
Once that was handled, they began making plans for what awaited them in the Chaos Layer.

From what Nuella had told him, the Vagabond Kingdom was the smallest kingdom within the Chaos Layer. However, the reason it still remained standing was because of the power of its Queen, a Phoenix who had already reached the rank of a True Celestial and possessed the strength to battle even Celestial Lords.
Aside from that, their Overlord, who resided within the Abyss Layer, was not an opponent anyone would willingly provoke.

Nuella also shed light on the other races within the Chaos Layer aside from the Forbidden Beast Race and the Abomination Beast Race. The Sentients, from what she knew, had once been a race of Star Beasts banished to the Tormented Chaos Abyss by a powerful ruler.
That was all she knew, but they were not truly beasts. Instead, they resembled angelic beings. They also possessed an Overlord whom they called the Angel King.
The moment she revealed the angels’ nature, Kent recognised them.

After all, several years ago, when the Ruthless Bandit arrived in the Star Realm, he offended a member of their clan, and so for thirty years, they had chased him all the way to the Tormented Chaos Abyss, which back then had been known as the Abyssal Domain.
It was thanks to them that he met the Evil Queen and learned of his hidden potential.
He and the angels had not exactly been friends from the beginning. However, after he united the entire Star Realm, they became his allies and later his followers.
To learn they had been banished to this place made him wonder who exactly had dared to do such a thing. His blood boiled with rage, but he knew he could not act recklessly.
Now that he knew Overlords were involved, he understood that he had to wait for the Evil Queen to awaken before doing anything drastic.
His plan was to travel to the Vagabond Kingdom, meet the Vagabond Queen, and discover why she had sent Nuella to fetch him.
Kent also had several matters he needed to handle, but for now, he knew meeting the Vagabond Queen was the highest priority.
Thankfully, a few hours later, the four cocoons finished awakening the innate bodies and bloodlines of the four abominations. They were soon released as Kent’s subordinates.
He named Skullrender, the same beast Crimson had fought and nearly died against, Khorvex.
He named Soulmaw, the trapped abomination beast that had tried to break free from the Dark Lich’s control, Vorzith.
Fatebreaker, who had been defeated by Nexorphis, was given the name Xelthar, and finally, the Plaguefather, who had completely dominated Kaldrex, was named Malgrath.
With their arrival, the rankings changed.
Nexorphis retained her position as the strongest, and so did Ixeron. While nobody truly knew how powerful Ixeron was, Malak did, so he updated the rankings, placing Ixeron second strongest.
Fatebreaker, now known as Xelthar, became the third strongest, while Malgrath, the Plaguefather, became the fourth strongest. The fifth spot was surprisingly given to Kaldrex.

According to Malak, Kaldrex possessed the potential to one day rank among the top ten within Kent’s Beast Legion. This came as a shock to everyone, but after Malak revealed that if even one of the nine chains binding half of Kaldrex’s power were to shatter at this very moment, he would immediately rank third, they all began looking at him differently.
The sixth and seventh spots went to Khorvex, Crimson’s nemesis, and Vorzith, the Soulmaw. In the end, Crimson came in eighth, which he was surprisingly happy with.
Once the rankings were finalised, Malak activated the formation, and moments later, they found themselves within the Vagabond Kingdom, surrounded on all sides.

sentences.text: Kaldrex, being the fourth strongest, was also among the demigods sent to hunt down the abominations.
His opponent, though he was not aware of it yet, might as well be considered the most dangerous of all four abominations.
Kaldrex had no idea, so like the others, he went after one of the four Abominations.
Kaldrex possessed the power worthy of his rank as the fourth strongest.
However, what none of the other Beasts knew was that Kaldrex was actually far more monstrous than that.
The part of his power that had been suppressed and sealed within his soul was actually an untamed force that, when he fully awakens, would place him at the top.
Even now, he could already be considered a terrifying opponent.
However, the moment he stepped into the Plague Kingdom, he felt as though he had walked directly into danger.
Kaldrex sensed it immediately, a wave of necrotic energy carrying decay, corruption, and every vile thing a person would instinctively flee from.
But it was already too late.
By the time Kaldrex realised the danger he was in, he had already reached the core of the Rotten Domain, and to his absolute shock, he found himself surrounded on all sides.
"Eat him, my parasites.
Feast upon his fresh flesh and drink his blood."
"That was all I heard before all hell broke loose.
I was surrounded on all sides by insect-like beasts, each carrying poison and acid.
The burn marks came from them detonating their own bodies.
That corrosive acid was what made me realise that victory was not something I could achieve easily, especially when I had no idea where the main target was."
Kaldrex sighed.
"I only survived because, during a critical moment, one of the seals inside my body partially unsealed and allowed me to use Extreme Gravity.
That bought me two seconds to search for my target and another two seconds to kill him before my advantage disappeared.
Thankfully, after three seconds, I spotted him, and with Malgoreth’s poison, I managed to buy myself two more seconds.
That is the only reason I am standing here right now.
Had it not been for that partial unsealing, I would have died."
If one were to ask what a true abomination looked like, the Plaguefather would be the perfect example.
The powers that abomination possessed were far beyond what a Beast at its current stage should have been capable of wielding.
"Looks like you’ve gathered yourself some rather interesting subordinates, little brother."
Malak suddenly appeared and brushed his hand against the green cocoon housing the Plaguefather’s resurrected body.
Kent smiled.
"I have the Dark Lich to thank for that.
He planned on taking over the Star Realm, so he performed experiments on all of them.
Now, they are part of my family, and one day, we will bring him down."
Kent paused before smiling at Malak again.
"In fact, your mission will be to bring every last Beast within this Banished Zone under my command.
The last thing I want is to let a deranged madman continue possessing this much power."
Malak nodded.
"I will make sure that one day you possess a power capable of facing any obstacle.
Though I must say, if you do not mind, after you have your revenge on this madman, would you hand him over to me?
I believe that if he could create something this dangerous, I can turn him into an obedient subordinate."
"I have no problem with that, as long as he never gets the chance to harm innocent Beasts again."
"Rest assured, whatever we do will only serve to expand your power."

Kent chose not to dwell on that thought.

chapters.title: Chapter 1639: Memories of the Divine Beast Tamer
paragraphs: Getting surrounded on all sides should have freaked Kent out.
However, he looked calm, almost too calm for someone who could be crushed by just one of the Universal Gods surrounding him.

His calmness stemmed from Malak being beside him. There was just no way any harm would come to him with Malak by his side. If anything, the people surrounding him should have been the ones freaking out.
Unfortunately, Kent stood in the middle, his 48 Beast companions surrounding him on all sides, so the vagabonds did not see him, and by extension, they did not see Malak.
Not that he was willing to let Malak freak anyone out.
"Stand down," suddenly, a voice spread across the space, causing the vagabond guards to lower their weapons and stand at ease.

Up ahead, 11 people appeared, each a Celestial. Ten of the Celestials were already at the peak of the Celestial King stage; however, the lady in the middle, despite being only a True Celestial, possessed a power that put all ten of them to shame.

In the middle stood a woman with flowing red hair. She looked mature, yet her appearance suggested she was a 20-year-old woman. She had a graceful body and a presence that demanded attention. A lotus-shaped flame tattoo could be seen on her forehead, showing her understanding of the flame is very deep.
Kent was even mesmerised for a moment when his gaze met that of the redhead. However, as if a dam had broken in his head, Kent felt memories of his past self as the Divine Beast Tamer flood in.
At once, Kent felt as if he had undergone a rebirth, one that caused his body to radiate a unique aura that caught everyone’s attention.

Kent could clearly see it. Up in the air, just as his aura started to change, the hostility in the atmosphere slowly began to shift. The air soon turned welcoming, almost as if the Vagabonds were welcoming their long-lost king.
But Kent was more focused on the redheaded lady who, despite possessing a human form, looked more like a demi-phoenix. She had awakened her bloodline but not her innate body.
This gave her and the others appearances that showed they were not fully human just yet. Some even had bestial features, such as beastly ears, eyes, tails, and other body parts.
"Welcome to the Vagabond Kingdom, Lord Aurelion. I have been expecting you."
Kent raised his brow at the mention of his name, the same name he bore when he was the Divine Beast Tamer.

The memories he had recovered covered his entire life from the moment he stopped painting ordinary things and dove into exploring the world of Beast Taming. It was a big decision for him to venture into such a world.
It took him a few months to discover a connection between humans and Beasts. This drove him to focus more on how to bring out the best in beasts.

Soon, Aurelion developed a method to tame beasts without enslaving them. His first tamed beast was a three-tailed white fox. When he tamed this fox, to both his and everyone else’s shock, the fox gained the ability to speak.
Aurelion was so shocked that he had to go back and study his own paintings. Later, he discovered he could perfectly capture the essence of innate talent in one of his paintings.

So he began to study it, and before long, the three-tailed fox became a four-tailed white fox, and she continued to grow until the day she became a nine-tailed fox, a phenomenon that drew the attention of both humans and beasts.
Aurelion had to go on the run since a nine-tailed fox back then was considered a divine miracle.
Later, he managed to discover Innate Bodies, and so his Nine-Tailed Fox gained the body of a human. Aurelion was happy, so he continued to refine his methods while still on the run from his enemies.
Many gave up, while others grew even more persistent.
100,000 years later, Aurelion returned with 13 beasts, each a Monarch, or at least that was what many called them. He named them the 13 Divine Wonders.
Among the 13 Divine Wonders, there was the Thirteen-Headed Calamity Dragon, a Calamity Beast said to rank only second to the Primordial Chaos Dragon.

There was the Nine-Tailed Vagabond Fox, a beast with power over illusion, space, and time so powerful that her presence on battlefields terrified everyone. Most importantly, she was a beauty even in her beast form.

There was the Devastating Forbidden Lightning Phoenix, Star Devouring Abomination Ant Empress, Celestial Jade Qilin, Azurewing Storm Garuda, Black Tortoise of Endless Age, Bloodmoon Dire Wolf, Voidwalker Serpent, Twin Bladesaber Leopard, Silent Bone Crane, Crimson Mane Lion, and Depthsea Leviathan.
Later, these 13 beasts became Overlords, the peak of bloodline evolution and the first time ever for 13 Overlords to appear in the same place. Most shocking of all, they all followed one man.
Aurelion became a being many feared.
They said he left as a fragile man but returned as a monster in his own right. In truth, Aurelion returned stronger than even his 13 Divine Wonders.
That was because of the symbiotic relationship they shared. He inherited between 20% and 50% of each beast’s power, added to his own strength.
However, his monstrous power also translated to his beasts.
As time passed, the 13 Divine Wonders also took in followers. Those who followed them added to the power of the 13 Wonders, which in turn added to Aurelion’s.

Thanks to the memories he had recovered, Kent immediately recognised the Phoenix lady as one of the Vagabonds who followed the Nine-Tailed Vagabond Fox. She was someone who carried a sacred flame called the Nine Astral Hypnotic Flame.
Because of that, she chose to follow the Nine-Tailed Vagabond Fox instead of the Devastating Forbidden Lightning Phoenix.
But if he remembered correctly, all the beasts that followed the 13 Divine Wonders fell during the Chaos War. So then, how were the 11 Celestial Vagabonds alive?
Kent remembered all of them, the redhead most of all, since she used to be a little girl who was always looking for trouble, only to run to him to save her.
"Is that you, little Mila?" Kent asked, a broad smile playing on his face.
Up in the air, the redheaded beauty pouted. "I am not little anymore, Lord Aurelion."
The ten Celestials beside her smiled, seeing her start to throw a tantrum over something so trivial. Kent just smirked and turned to his big brother.
"Big Brother, meet Mila and the ten troublemakers. They used to follow me around back in the day."
"I see." Malak nodded toward the 11 Celestials, whom he could tell were trying their best not to freak out due to his presence reeking of evil.
"Maybe we should go inside and have a talk, Mila. I believe you asked for my presence today because you have something to say."
Mila nodded, and soon they were inside a large hall built from expensive jade and rare stones.
Kent had no idea how they managed to build something this beautiful. Of course, he knew the beasts here were intelligent, so nothing was beyond them.
Even so, the nature of their buildings and the style suggested a human touch. For now, he would not dig into that, not when he was here to learn more about the status of his 13 Divine Wonders.
Since he had already recovered all of his memories as the Divine Beast Tamer, Kent knew he had nothing to worry about now.
As long as he reunited with his 13 Divine Wonders, he would be able to command enough power to face whatever danger came his way.

chapters.title: Chapter 1640: Whereabouts of the 13 Divine Wonders
paragraphs: Kent sat with Malak on his right and Nexorphis on his left.

Mila and the 10 Celestials were all beasts that followed the Nine-Tailed Vagabond Fox. According to his memories, they had died, but now they are alive, and not only they, but they have also become Celestials.
Naturally, he wanted to know how any of this was possible.
"So why don’t we start with why you eleven are alive and why this kingdom exists?"
Kent asked, knowing that answering this question would reveal the whereabouts of the Nine-Tailed Vagabond Fox, or at least what happened after he jumped into the Chaos Gate and closed it.

Mila answered, "If you are wondering how we are still alive, then know it was thanks to My Lady, who used her status as an Overlord to send the eleven of us through the cycle of reincarnation to undergo true reincarnation.

We reincarnated here a million years ago and have been waiting for you to arrive ever since. As for this kingdom, it had been here long before we came. The former rulers and strongest experts migrated to the Abyss Layer to directly serve under My Lady."
"So Yukiko is here, huh?"

"Yes, and she has been expecting you. She knew you would be coming here and that we would be meeting today. In fact, she knew you would offend that madman, so she gave instructions to ensure you did not face any trouble until we met."
Kent chuckled. "She had always been that perceptive. But I am happy to hear she is alive."

Yukiko, or as the rest of the universe knew her, the Nine-Tailed Vagabond Fox, possessed many extraordinary qualities. She excelled at illusion, space, and time. However, she could also see into the future and perform divinations.
In fact, it was thanks to that ability of hers that the Divine Beast Tamer was able to meet the other 12 Divine Wonders.
So learning that she still lived and was in the Tormented Chaos Abyss put a smile on Kent’s face.
"Though I have to ask, are the Overlords of the Forbidden and Abomination members of the Divine Wonders?"
"No. Only My Lady is here. Those two are creations of that madman. While they are powerful, they pale in comparison to My Lady, Lady Huyan, or Lord Zhentian."
Huyan was the Devastating Forbidden Lightning Phoenix, and Zhentian was the Star Devouring Abomination Ant. Both of them were among the most dangerous beasts during the Chaos Era.
"Then do you know where the others are? I told them to wait for my return, so I trust they each went into hiding."

Mila nodded. "My Lady told me that all 13 of them went to different Banished Zones. She came to the Star Realm with Lord Zhentian. She came here while Lord Zhentian went to the Upside-Down Cliff, another banished zone in the Star Realm.
As for the others, she said Lady Huyan went to a Banished Realm called Lightning Land. It is not in this Star Realm, but somewhere out there.
Aside from her, Lord Voraxion entered one of the Calamity Zones, a place called No Man’s Land. They are the only ones I know of. When you meet My Lady, she will tell you more."
Despite hearing where some of his Divine Wonders had gone, Kent did not seem bothered. Deep down, he knew that no matter where they had gone, they would be fine.
They were not weak, and knowing that all of them were Overlords put his mind at ease.
"When can we meet Yukiko? I am sure she misses me greatly."
Mila nodded, knowing her lady surely missed Kent. After all, she had been the Divine Beast Tamer’s first Beast companion and also the first to experience the power of the Divine Beast Tamer.
It could be said that she was the one who tested all of the Divine Beast Tamer’s inventions. Some experiments went badly, while others yielded results, and she had been through it all.
So the relationship they shared was much closer than the one he shared with the other Divine Wonders.
"We will go after you are done forming the Vagabond Contract with all of us. We have been living without a purpose, so since you are here now, we have to get right on it."
Kent nodded.

He already knew how powerful his incarnation as the Divine Beast Tamer was, so forming a contract with all the Vagabond Beasts here would not only expand and strengthen his soul but also allow him to unlock some aspects of his power and finally clear the quest to gain access to the Secret Manual.
"Before we get to that, what can you tell me about the Sentients?"

"They are a peaceful race, if you ask me. They are also humans with wings, so I suppose you can say they are angels. I’ve only been to their kingdom once, but I counted no fewer than a million of them.
They have an Overlord in the Abyss Layer, and My Lady said we should be careful around them. Why she did not go deeper with her warning, I believe, had to do with their Overlord.
In the past, the Abominations tried to mess with them, but it ended badly for them, so we did our best not to step on their toes, and they also left us alone.

If you are asking this so you can visit them, I would suggest you meet with My Lady first." Mila paused and thought for a moment before adding, "I learned they were banished because they chose not to bow to a certain powerful ruler who lives outside this Banished Zone."
"I see. Then how about we get on with the contracts?"
A few minutes later, Kent was outside, beginning to create a large formation to contract with all 1.2 million Vagabonds.

From what he had seen and heard so far, the Void Beasts, Forsaken Race, Dark Fiends, Foreign Races, and Chaos Beings were still a threat. So forming more contracts to build his army was not such a bad idea.
It would take him one week and five days to finish the contracts. By then, the Evil Queen would awaken, and things would start to take shape.

Meanwhile, far within the Forbidden Kingdom, a man—a demonic-looking dragon man with several tattoos covering his body—stood atop a tree, his hands clasped behind his back, his gaze directed at the five powerful Star Beasts locked in battle with a Supreme Forbidden Beast.
The five Star Beasts were all Universal Gods, so naturally, the battle was not going their way.
However, as he continued to watch, he saw the will to live burning in the eyes of the Star Beasts, whom he would later come to learn had been banished from the Star Realm to this place.
"They would make perfect Evil Agents," he muttered, taking a step forward. A few seconds later, he stood just 200 meters away from the battle.
"I don’t need a seer to tell me you five won’t be leaving here alive. Luckily for you, I can help you kill this monster, but at a price."
"Name your price, demon," one of them, a slim yet short-looking man with a sharp gaze and quick movements, asked while dancing between the deadly attacks of the Supreme Beast.
"The price is simple. You five will serve my majestic self for 100 years. If you agree, then let’s sign the contract, and I will help you..."

sentences.text: Kent sat with Malak on his right and Nexorphis on his left.
Mila and the 10 Celestials were all beasts that followed the Nine-Tailed Vagabond Fox.
According to his memories, they had died, but now they are alive, and not only they, but they have also become Celestials.
Naturally, he wanted to know how any of this was possible.
"So why don’t we start with why you eleven are alive and why this kingdom exists?"
Kent asked, knowing that answering this question would reveal the whereabouts of the Nine-Tailed Vagabond Fox, or at least what happened after he jumped into the Chaos Gate and closed it.

Mila answered, "If you are wondering how we are still alive, then know it was thanks to My Lady, who used her status as an Overlord to send the eleven of us through the cycle of reincarnation to undergo true reincarnation.
We reincarnated here a million years ago and have been waiting for you to arrive ever since.
As for this kingdom, it had been here long before we came.
The former rulers and strongest experts migrated to the Abyss Layer to directly serve under My Lady."
"So Yukiko is here, huh?"
"Yes, and she has been expecting you.
She knew you would be coming here and that we would be meeting today.
In fact, she knew you would offend that madman, so she gave instructions to ensure you did not face any trouble until we met."
Kent chuckled.
"She had always been that perceptive.
But I am happy to hear she is alive."
Yukiko, or as the rest of the universe knew her, the Nine-Tailed Vagabond Fox, possessed many extraordinary qualities.
She excelled at illusion, space, and time.
However, she could also see into the future and perform divinations.
In fact, it was thanks to that ability of hers that the Divine Beast Tamer was able to meet the other 12 Divine Wonders.
So learning that she still lived and was in the Tormented Chaos Abyss put a smile on Kent’s face.
"Though I have to ask, are the Overlords of the Forbidden and Abomination members of the Divine Wonders?"
"No.
Only My Lady is here.
Those two are creations of that madman.
While they are powerful, they pale in comparison to My Lady, Lady Huyan, or Lord Zhentian."
Huyan was the Devastating Forbidden Lightning Phoenix, and Zhentian was the Star Devouring Abomination Ant.
Both of them were among the most dangerous beasts during the Chaos Era.
"Then do you know where the others are?
I told them to wait for my return, so I trust they each went into hiding."
Mila nodded.
"My Lady told me that all 13 of them went to different Banished Zones.
She came to the Star Realm with Lord Zhentian.
She came here while Lord Zhentian went to the Upside-Down Cliff, another banished zone in the Star Realm.
As for the others, she said Lady Huyan went to a Banished Realm called Lightning Land.
It is not in this Star Realm, but somewhere out there.
Aside from her, Lord Voraxion entered one of the Calamity Zones, a place called No Man’s Land.
They are the only ones I know of.
When you meet My Lady, she will tell you more."
Despite hearing where some of his Divine Wonders had gone, Kent did not seem bothered.
Deep down, he knew that no matter where they had gone, they would be fine.
They were not weak, and knowing that all of them were Overlords put his mind at ease.
"When can we meet Yukiko?
I am sure she misses me greatly."
Mila nodded, knowing her lady surely missed Kent.
After all, she had been the Divine Beast Tamer’s first Beast companion and also the first to experience the power of the Divine Beast Tamer.
It could be said that she was the one who tested all of the Divine Beast Tamer’s inventions.
Some experiments went badly, while others yielded results, and she had been through it all.
So the relationship they shared was much closer than the one he shared with the other Divine Wonders.
"We will go after you are done forming the Vagabond Contract with all of us.
We have been living without a purpose, so since you are here now, we have to get right on it."
Kent nodded.

He already knew how powerful his incarnation as the Divine Beast Tamer was, so forming a contract with all the Vagabond Beasts here would not only expand and strengthen his soul but also allow him to unlock some aspects of his power and finally clear the quest to gain access to the Secret Manual.
"Before we get to that, what can you tell me about the Sentients?"
"They are a peaceful race, if you ask me.
They are also humans with wings, so I suppose you can say they are angels.
I’ve only been to their kingdom once, but I counted no fewer than a million of them.
They have an Overlord in the Abyss Layer, and My Lady said we should be careful around them.
Why she did not go deeper with her warning, I believe, had to do with their Overlord.
In the past, the Abominations tried to mess with them, but it ended badly for them, so we did our best not to step on their toes, and they also left us alone.

If you are asking this so you can visit them, I would suggest you meet with My Lady first." Mila paused and thought for a moment before adding, "I learned they were banished because they chose not to bow to a certain powerful ruler who lives outside this Banished Zone."
"I see.
Then how about we get on with the contracts?"
A few minutes later, Kent was outside, beginning to create a large formation to contract with all 1.2 million Vagabonds.
From what he had seen and heard so far, the Void Beasts, Forsaken Race, Dark Fiends, Foreign Races, and Chaos Beings were still a threat.
So forming more contracts to build his army was not such a bad idea.
It would take him one week and five days to finish the contracts.
By then, the Evil Queen would awaken, and things would start to take shape.

Meanwhile, far within the Forbidden Kingdom, a man—a demonic-looking dragon man with several tattoos covering his body—stood atop a tree, his hands clasped behind his back, his gaze directed at the five powerful Star Beasts locked in battle with a Supreme Forbidden Beast.
The five Star Beasts were all Universal Gods, so naturally, the battle was not going their way.
However, as he continued to watch, he saw the will to live burning in the eyes of the Star Beasts, whom he would later come to learn had been banished from the Star Realm to this place.
"They would make perfect Evil Agents," he muttered, taking a step forward.
A few seconds later, he stood just 200 meters away from the battle.
"I don’t need a seer to tell me you five won’t be leaving here alive.
Luckily for you, I can help you kill this monster, but at a price."
"Name your price, demon," one of them, a slim yet short-looking man with a sharp gaze and quick movements, asked while dancing between the deadly attacks of the Supreme Beast.
"The price is simple.
You five will serve my majestic self for 100 years.
If you agree, then let’s sign the contract, and I will help you..."

chapters.title: Chapter 1641: Awakening of the Evil Queen
paragraphs: Kent had not even stopped for a minute to relax during the past week and five days. He knew just how important it was to gather strength now.

He might not have recalled all his memories as the Chaos Dragon to fully understand the scale of the battle during the Great War, but after recalling the Divine Beast Tamer’s memories, he saw just how limited he had been during the Chaos War.
Had it not been for a trump card that allowed him to exchange his life to seal the Chaos Gate, he would have died alongside the rest of his beasts.
The same was for his life as Lord Genesis.
Seeing that they had paved the way for him this time around, he wasted no time and made sure to form contracts with all the Vagabonds.
During the process, Kent came to better understand his powers as a Beast Tamer. Now, without even giving them Innate Talent Awakening Pills, they could awaken their Innate Bodies and bloodlines.
It was one of the many abilities that made him stand out back in the day.
When he created the Beast Kingdom, many beasts came seeking asylum. They knew that with the Divine Beast Tamer in charge, no harm would come to them.
Even to this day, many beasts that once followed him still live there with one of the Divine Wonders as their ruler.

Other Beast Tamers hated him, but he did not concern himself with their petty insults. In the end, nobody with a functioning brain would dare attack him, not when he was surrounded by the 13 Divine Wonders.
Kent expected many good things to happen to him. However, when he formed the contracts with the Vagabond Beasts, he was stunned to learn that an Overlord could bestow unique traits upon beasts.
Aside from Mila, Kent saw that the other beasts possessed a unique trait called [Vagabond]. This trait turned them into Vagabond Beasts, and as they grew stronger, they evolved into True Vagabonds.
Mila was already a True Vagabond, so all Kent did was awaken her Innate Body, but the others had to undergo true bloodline and Innate Body awakenings.
Kent planned to ask his 13 Divine Wonders how they managed to do that since he wasn’t an Overlord back then.
He had never once expected them to be this overpowered after he died and left them to fend for themselves. This came as a complete shock to him, but a pleasant one.
The moment he finished drafting the contracts, he decided to rest and recover his energy.

Surprisingly, he was just too tired, so he slipped into a deep, peaceful sleep. In his sleep, he dreamt of arriving in the Elina Galaxy and reuniting with Elina atop a glass tower. In his dream, Elina was the crown princess of a vast human Empire.
His sleep, however, was interrupted when the entire Tormented Chaos Abyss suddenly shook, and across the entire realm, an evil presence spread everywhere, shaking everyone’s resolve.
Kent woke up and immediately made his way to the hall, where he found Mila and her people were armed and ready for battle. Even Malak seemed prepared to jump into battle.
As an Ancient Evil, he knew just how tyrannical the presence felt. While his evil rank might be higher, the presence he sensed was not someone he could afford to offend.
Maybe when he rose back to the Celestial stage, he could compensate for the remaining gap by utilizing his Ancient Evil rank.
But today, things aren’t looking good for him or anyone.
"What are you guys doing?" Kent asked, a bit confused when he saw all the strongest beasts gathered inside the jade hall of the Vagabond Kingdom.
"You are awake, My Lord." Mila rushed to Kent’s side. "My Lady sent word. The Fifth Overlord is awakening from her slumber."
"Is that why you all seem like you are going to war?" Kent smirked, though Mila’s serious expression told him she was not joking.

"My Lady said we should not leave your side. Apparently, even My Lady does not think she can defeat the Fifth Monarch. That being was already here when she arrived, so she knew best to prepare for anything."
Just then, the air grew even more chaotic and chilling.
Even Kent furrowed his brow. ’This presence... it is even stronger and denser than the one I felt when Lord Genesis faced the Abyss King.’

Kent realized that perhaps the Evil Queen had already stepped into the rank of a Primordial, the same rank he suspected existed above the Celestial stage. If that was the case, then he knew he had been slacking off all this time.
’No wonder Big Brother Malak even seems ready for battle.’
"Stand down, everyone. I know the one causing this phenomenon. She was the main reason I came here."
"WHAT?" Kent’s Beast companions exclaimed in shocked tones, their expressions growing tense.
"What do you mean you know her?" Malak asked, his gaze narrowing at Kent. Even Kent felt his soul tremble when he met Malak’s red eyes.

"I met her a very long time ago. She was the one who opened the Trial of Evil for me, Big Brother. It appears you were not the only one banished from your universe. We became friends, and later she became my master... unofficially."
Malak blinked a few times before asking, "Do you trust her?"
"Yes, Big Brother."
"I see. Then let us wait and see what happens next. If she proves to be a menace, I will take action and seal her, even if it is the last thing I do."
Far away in the Abyss, a large coffin, similar to the one Malak came out of, slowly opened. A pale-skinned figure with graceful features and a pair of dark eyes slowly rose and hovered in the air.
Lightning tore through the sky and bathed her in its unholy radiance for several minutes. After it had finally calmed, she opened her eyes and sighed.
"After who knows how long, I have finally awakened." She smiled and added, "If I am awake, then it means he is here."
This made her beam with joy. Her mood led her to ignore the four people hovering 20 kilometers from her dark castle.

She first changed her clothes, dressing to impress. She made sure less skin was covered since she planned to impress Kent with her good looks. After that, she spent a couple of minutes handling her overflowing aura.
It was only after an hour that she managed to bring her aura under control.
Afterward, she took a single step and appeared 200 meters away from the four Overlords of the Tormented Layer. When they saw her arrive, all four of them immediately went into battle stances.

"Oh, please. If I wanted you dead, I could kill you within the blink of an eye." She smiled faintly. "You four have potential, especially you two." She pointed at a fox lady and an angelic man with flowing golden hair.
"As for you two, how about becoming my subordinates? I will transform you into Evil Fiends and bestow upon you powers beyond your comprehension."
Her eyes narrowed, and before the Overlords of the Forbidden and Abomination Beast Races could reject her offer and insult her, she moved and appeared directly before them.
"I was not asking for your permission, puppets."
A third eye opened on her forehead, and at once, the two Overlords lost consciousness. The fox lady and the angel stepped back, sweat breaking out across their foreheads.
Within a single minute, the two Overlords regained consciousness and knelt before the dark-haired lady.
"We greet the Queen of Evil."
"Better." She laughed softly. "Giving you two as gifts to my Prince would make him like me more."
She then turned toward the fox lady and the angel. "I have reasons to believe you two share a destiny with my Prince. It would be best if you met him on good terms."
She waved her hand, and the void shattered apart.
"The choice is yours."
She stepped into the void, and the two Overlords followed after her.
"Who could be her Prince?" the angel overlord asked, stunned by what had just happened.
The fox lady shook her head. "I do not know, but I intend to find out."
With that, she stepped through the portal, and the angel followed after her.
