chapters.title: Chapter 1642: Leaving The Tormented Chaos Abyss
paragraphs: Grand Dark Lich Barnabas clearly had no idea that after Soulmaw was rescued from his control, his nightmare would not end there.
Just moments ago, he had been planning to send warriors to the Tormented Chaos Abyss to investigate what had happened there, knowing that by the time they arrived, Kent would likely be long gone.
Of course, there was also a chance Kent might still be there, which, in his opinion, would be good for him and bad for the bastard who dared to steal from him.
Unfortunately for him, things were far from over.

Just as he was preparing to move forward with his decision to send the warriors, a terrifying force dug into his soul and forcefully extracted the seals he had placed on the two Overlords in the Abyss Layer.

Unlike the others whom he could command, the two Overlords had long since become aware of his control over them. So, using their Overlord authority, they had placed seals over the seals he had planted on them.

He knew the day he became a Primordial would be the day he could fully command them. It was also the day he was waiting for to finally unleash his army and bring the entire Star Realm under his control.
However, that opportunity had been forcefully taken from him, and with it, a large portion of his soul was ripped away, leaving him passed out on the floor with blood oozing from his nose.
He had no idea who dared to take what belonged to him, but he knew they were not people he could afford to provoke.
Even so, he could feel that his soul had been severely damaged, and as he drifted into unconsciousness, he made a mental note to one day find a way to get revenge.
If only he knew his nightmare had only just begun. The Tormented Layer he cherished so much would soon be taken from him.
Meanwhile, back in the Vagabond Kingdom, Kent sat on his throne, fully aware that the Evil Queen would appear at any moment.
As expected, a sudden bang echoed through the throne room as a massive tear in space opened, forming a large void portal in the middle of the hall and causing everyone present to go on high alert.
A second later, the Evil Queen walked out with graceful steps. Behind her, the Overlords of the Forbidden and Abomination Beast Races followed closely.
The Evil Queen clearly intended for her arrival to command everyone’s attention. However, the moment her gaze landed on Malak, part of her froze.

She recognized the power within Malak, and as someone who had cultivated Evil Qi her entire life, she instantly understood that Malak was bad news. However, seeing him seated on Kent’s right side, she realized that taking an offensive approach would be a terrible idea for everyone involved.
’They are together. He doesn’t seem to be in distress, so there was no need to attack,’ she thought inwardly.

She swallowed her fear and continued walking forward like a model on a catwalk as she approached Kent. When she stopped two meters away from him, she did something that shocked everyone present, including Kent himself.
She bowed.
"I greet my Prince."
Kent clearly did not see that coming. In his memories, he knew the Evil Queen, or as she called herself, Pandora, was his master.
She had taught him everything he knew up until the point he entered the Trial of Evil. So her bowing to him was completely unexpected. If anything, he was supposed to be the one doing the bowing.
Kent narrowed his eyes and was about to ask her what exactly she was doing when something suddenly clicked in his mind, and a flood of memories rushed into his head.
The memories belonged to the Ruthless Bandit. They began from the moment he emerged from the Trial of Evil. It was just after he parted ways with the 24 Arcane Elders.

Although they spanned only five years, he saw that after he became a True Evil, Pandora constantly referred to him as her Prince, claiming he was the prophesied Prince of Evil, the one destined to bring order to evil itself.

Kent had clearly never expected such memories to have been hidden from him all this time. But now that he remembered them, he felt even more embarrassed. However, one thing was certain: he was no longer merely a disciple, but a Prince.
"No need for the dramatics, Pandora. I see you brought some friends."
Kent turned toward the two Overlords. Just before Pandora could say anything, two more Overlords stepped out through the void portal.
Kent’s eyes widened the moment he saw the white-haired fox lady emerge from the portal.
"Yukiko... fancy seeing you here."
"Master," a smile appeared on her face. However, she frown whe she saw Pandora standing 2 meters away from Kent.

Yukiko recognized Kent long before she arrived since she had seen him in her vision, so for this monstrous lady to be standing close to him, her eyes narrowed, and she was about to gather energy to attack when Kent spoke.
"Pandora, you never told me you and Yukiko are friends."
Even Pandora was stunned. When she saw Yukiko and the Angel Overlord, who preferred to be called Angel King, she felt like attacking them would be bad for her.
It wasn’t fear, not when she was a Primordial and Yukiko was merely a Pseudo-Primordial. What she felt was more like a feeling.
Who would have thought that feeling would turn out to be this reveal?
"You two know each other," Pandora asked, and Kent nodded, feeling very happy.

"Yes. Yukiko was my friend and protector during one of my Incarnations." Kent laughed and added, "News flash, your theory that I had reincarnated before I became the Evil King turned out to be true. I was indeed someone amazing in my past lives."

Kent smirked and decided to explain himself before they started asking him questions, "Long story short, after I died as the Ruthless Bandit, I reincarnated as other people, one of these incarnations was a being called the Divine Beast Tamer.
Yukiko was my first and favourite Beast companion. She accompanied me throughout that life. She is like my best friend, lover, protector and advisor."
"Oh, that is actually sweet." Pandora may be an evil Queen, but her personality reeks of a good person. Perhaps that was why she was banished and also why she is unpredictable.

Yukiko approached Kent and poked his cheek to make sure he was real. When she saw that, a smile appeared on her face, and she transformed into a tiny version of her beast form and jumped into his arms, her nine tails brushing against his cheek and face.
This wasn’t the first time Mila and the ten celestials had seen her do that. But it was the first time for the rest, so they just stood there stunned.
"We have so much catching up to do, but until that, let me introduce everyone," Kent said, and went ahead with the introductions. A few minutes later, only one person was left.
"Finally, I want you all to meet my Big Brother. He is an Ancient Evil and one of the 24 Grand Arcane Elders, Grand Shaman Malak."

Pandora’s eyes widened, and she quickly bowed toward Malak, "Greetings, Grand Shaman, I am Pandora Ni Juhmika, a banished Princess of the Grand Arcane Star Family, one of the seven Royal families of the -"
Malak raised his hand to stop her from saying the last word; otherwise, she would risk destroying everyone.
"Nice meeting you, Daughter of Evil. We will talk later, so for now, celebrate your reunion with my little brother."
Pandora nodded, extra happy. She quickly introduced two overlords to Kent, who immediately accepted her gift and handed them over to Malak.
Afterward, he turned to the Angel King. "It seems after a billion years had past you forgot my face, you little punk," Kent said, directing his words to the lost and shocked Angel Overlord.

"Allow me to refresh your memory," Kent flicked his hand, and a small orb flew and merged with his forehead. A few seconds later, a frown appeared on his face. Soon, that frown turned to happiness, then reverence.
"So it is you, Evil King," he smirked, an air of arrogance appeared around him, "I never knew you, the mighty Evil King, is merely an Immortal now. I can kill you with a mere snap of my finger."

Kent smirked and turned to Pandora, "This brat was the reason I came to the Tormented Chaos Abyss back then. I merely stole a Jade Core from him, and he called his brothers, sisters, friends and parents to come after me.
I nearly died because of him."
"Do you want me to kill him?" Pandora asked with a serious expression, causing the Angel King to tremble in sheer terror. He turned pale at once.
Kent laughed, "No. His parents helped me after I left the Abyss, so I own him one."
"You are lucky, Angel," Pandora muttered, then she smiled.
"So tell me, Gideon, where are your parents and why are you her instead of up there?"
Gideon gritted his teeth, "That bastard imprisoned them in the upside-down cliff and banished the rest of us here."
"Who banished you?" Kent asked.

"One of the four rulers who betrayed you, Grand Sword Overlord Jggmat, or as he preferred to be called, the Prison Master. He owns the entirety of the Upside-Down Cliff, where he had imprisoned people he deem a threat to his rule."
"Is that so?" Kent stood up, "Go inform your people, I think it is time we leave this place."
Kent turns to the Overlords of the Forbidden and Abomination race; the same applies to you. We are all leaving this godforsaken place.

A few days later, Kent, alongside Pandora, Yukiko, Malak, his 48 demigods, the two Overlords now turned Evil Fiends, Gideon, and a few Forbiddens, Abominations, Sentients, and Vagabonds, appeared back in Skull City.
The rest would be summoned later.

sentences.text: Grand Dark Lich Barnabas clearly had no idea that after Soulmaw was rescued from his control, his nightmare would not end there.
Just moments ago, he had been planning to send warriors to the Tormented Chaos Abyss to investigate what had happened there, knowing that by the time they arrived, Kent would likely be long gone.
Of course, there was also a chance Kent might still be there, which, in his opinion, would be good for him and bad for the bastard who dared to steal from him.
Unfortunately for him, things were far from over.

Just as he was preparing to move forward with his decision to send the warriors, a terrifying force dug into his soul and forcefully extracted the seals he had placed on the two Overlords in the Abyss Layer.
Unlike the others whom he could command, the two Overlords had long since become aware of his control over them.
So, using their Overlord authority, they had placed seals over the seals he had planted on them.
He knew the day he became a Primordial would be the day he could fully command them.
It was also the day he was waiting for to finally unleash his army and bring the entire Star Realm under his control.
However, that opportunity had been forcefully taken from him, and with it, a large portion of his soul was ripped away, leaving him passed out on the floor with blood oozing from his nose.
He had no idea who dared to take what belonged to him, but he knew they were not people he could afford to provoke.
Even so, he could feel that his soul had been severely damaged, and as he drifted into unconsciousness, he made a mental note to one day find a way to get revenge.
If only he knew his nightmare had only just begun.
The Tormented Layer he cherished so much would soon be taken from him.
Meanwhile, back in the Vagabond Kingdom, Kent sat on his throne, fully aware that the Evil Queen would appear at any moment.
As expected, a sudden bang echoed through the throne room as a massive tear in space opened, forming a large void portal in the middle of the hall and causing everyone present to go on high alert.
A second later, the Evil Queen walked out with graceful steps.
Behind her, the Overlords of the Forbidden and Abomination Beast Races followed closely.
The Evil Queen clearly intended for her arrival to command everyone’s attention.
However, the moment her gaze landed on Malak, part of her froze.
She recognized the power within Malak, and as someone who had cultivated Evil Qi her entire life, she instantly understood that Malak was bad news.
However, seeing him seated on Kent’s right side, she realized that taking an offensive approach would be a terrible idea for everyone involved.
’They are together.
He doesn’t seem to be in distress, so there was no need to attack,’ she thought inwardly.
She swallowed her fear and continued walking forward like a model on a catwalk as she approached Kent.
When she stopped two meters away from him, she did something that shocked everyone present, including Kent himself.
She bowed.
"I greet my Prince."
Kent clearly did not see that coming.
In his memories, he knew the Evil Queen, or as she called herself, Pandora, was his master.
She had taught him everything he knew up until the point he entered the Trial of Evil.
So her bowing to him was completely unexpected.
If anything, he was supposed to be the one doing the bowing.
Kent narrowed his eyes and was about to ask her what exactly she was doing when something suddenly clicked in his mind, and a flood of memories rushed into his head.
The memories belonged to the Ruthless Bandit.
They began from the moment he emerged from the Trial of Evil.
It was just after he parted ways with the 24 Arcane Elders.

Although they spanned only five years, he saw that after he became a True Evil, Pandora constantly referred to him as her Prince, claiming he was the prophesied Prince of Evil, the one destined to bring order to evil itself.
Kent had clearly never expected such memories to have been hidden from him all this time.
But now that he remembered them, he felt even more embarrassed.
However, one thing was certain: he was no longer merely a disciple, but a Prince.
"No need for the dramatics, Pandora.
I see you brought some friends."
Kent turned toward the two Overlords.
Just before Pandora could say anything, two more Overlords stepped out through the void portal.
Kent’s eyes widened the moment he saw the white-haired fox lady emerge from the portal.
"Yukiko... fancy seeing you here."
"Master," a smile appeared on her face.
However, she frown whe she saw Pandora standing 2 meters away from Kent.

Yukiko recognized Kent long before she arrived since she had seen him in her vision, so for this monstrous lady to be standing close to him, her eyes narrowed, and she was about to gather energy to attack when Kent spoke.
"Pandora, you never told me you and Yukiko are friends."
Even Pandora was stunned.
When she saw Yukiko and the Angel Overlord, who preferred to be called Angel King, she felt like attacking them would be bad for her.
It wasn’t fear, not when she was a Primordial and Yukiko was merely a Pseudo-Primordial.
What she felt was more like a feeling.
Who would have thought that feeling would turn out to be this reveal?
"You two know each other," Pandora asked, and Kent nodded, feeling very happy.
"Yes.
Yukiko was my friend and protector during one of my Incarnations." Kent laughed and added, "News flash, your theory that I had reincarnated before I became the Evil King turned out to be true.
I was indeed someone amazing in my past lives."

Kent smirked and decided to explain himself before they started asking him questions, "Long story short, after I died as the Ruthless Bandit, I reincarnated as other people, one of these incarnations was a being called the Divine Beast Tamer.
Yukiko was my first and favourite Beast companion.
She accompanied me throughout that life.
She is like my best friend, lover, protector and advisor."
"Oh, that is actually sweet." Pandora may be an evil Queen, but her personality reeks of a good person.
Perhaps that was why she was banished and also why she is unpredictable.
Yukiko approached Kent and poked his cheek to make sure he was real.
When she saw that, a smile appeared on her face, and she transformed into a tiny version of her beast form and jumped into his arms, her nine tails brushing against his cheek and face.
This wasn’t the first time Mila and the ten celestials had seen her do that.
But it was the first time for the rest, so they just stood there stunned.
"We have so much catching up to do, but until that, let me introduce everyone," Kent said, and went ahead with the introductions.
A few minutes later, only one person was left.
"Finally, I want you all to meet my Big Brother.
He is an Ancient Evil and one of the 24 Grand Arcane Elders, Grand Shaman Malak."

Pandora’s eyes widened, and she quickly bowed toward Malak, "Greetings, Grand Shaman, I am Pandora Ni Juhmika, a banished Princess of the Grand Arcane Star Family, one of the seven Royal families of the -"
Malak raised his hand to stop her from saying the last word; otherwise, she would risk destroying everyone.
"Nice meeting you, Daughter of Evil.
We will talk later, so for now, celebrate your reunion with my little brother."
Pandora nodded, extra happy.
She quickly introduced two overlords to Kent, who immediately accepted her gift and handed them over to Malak.
Afterward, he turned to the Angel King.
"It seems after a billion years had past you forgot my face, you little punk," Kent said, directing his words to the lost and shocked Angel Overlord.
"Allow me to refresh your memory," Kent flicked his hand, and a small orb flew and merged with his forehead.
A few seconds later, a frown appeared on his face.
Soon, that frown turned to happiness, then reverence.
"So it is you, Evil King," he smirked, an air of arrogance appeared around him, "I never knew you, the mighty Evil King, is merely an Immortal now.
I can kill you with a mere snap of my finger."
Kent smirked and turned to Pandora, "This brat was the reason I came to the Tormented Chaos Abyss back then.
I merely stole a Jade Core from him, and he called his brothers, sisters, friends and parents to come after me.
I nearly died because of him."
"Do you want me to kill him?" Pandora asked with a serious expression, causing the Angel King to tremble in sheer terror.
He turned pale at once.
Kent laughed, "No.
His parents helped me after I left the Abyss, so I own him one."
"You are lucky, Angel," Pandora muttered, then she smiled.
"So tell me, Gideon, where are your parents and why are you her instead of up there?"
Gideon gritted his teeth, "That bastard imprisoned them in the upside-down cliff and banished the rest of us here."
"Who banished you?" Kent asked.
"One of the four rulers who betrayed you, Grand Sword Overlord Jggmat, or as he preferred to be called, the Prison Master.
He owns the entirety of the Upside-Down Cliff, where he had imprisoned people he deem a threat to his rule."
"Is that so?" Kent stood up, "Go inform your people, I think it is time we leave this place."
Kent turns to the Overlords of the Forbidden and Abomination race; the same applies to you.
We are all leaving this godforsaken place.

A few days later, Kent, alongside Pandora, Yukiko, Malak, his 48 demigods, the two Overlords now turned Evil Fiends, Gideon, and a few Forbiddens, Abominations, Sentients, and Vagabonds, appeared back in Skull City.
The rest would be summoned later.

chapters.title: Chapter 1643: The Grand Plan
paragraphs: By the time Kent returned to Skull City, his three Soul Warriors had finished conquering all seven gateways and had amassed over 20 million ready to match into battle warriors already.
Millions were still taking the Trial of Evil, while millions were still trying to earn the Mark of Evil. Kent quickly summoned more gateways to the Trial of Evil to speed things up.
Naturally, he speculated that by the end of the year, all of them would earn the Mark of Evil, and the warriors would have passed the trial and become Epic Evils.
His estimation also showed that by the time all of them were done, he would have over 60 million warriors under his command.

Kent knew this kind of army, while strong, was nothing compared to what the enemy had in mind. Back then, over five hundred million void beasts attacked the primordial era, and they were merely one legion of many legions.

So he handed them over to Malak, who immediately created the Trial of Evil for those he deemed worthy to take and become True Evils. He also built a unique Tower of Ascension, so all who would ascend would not be under the authority of the heavens but under the authority of the Evil Dao.
Kent had already planned to give him enough manpower to conquer the entire Star Realm and all Banished Zones inside the Star Realm.
His plan had already been realized when he awakened his Evil Heart. Now, he knew that with Malak in command, it was only a matter of time before every last Star Beast would become his to command.
He estimated there would be at least 300 million evil warriors when Malak was done here.

Before Kent opened the gateway that would take him to Elina’s galaxy, he decided to finalize some details first. He would be leaving Malak to handle the mission to conquer the entire Star Realm, but he would not leave him without aid.

"Big Brother Malak, Gideon and his sentient army have decided to aid you in your quest. Now, you have the Evil Army, the Forbidden Beast Army, the Abomination Beast Army, and the Vagabonds at your disposal to command.

Your mission is to conquer the Upside-Down Cliff, the Second and Third Heavens, and other Banished Zones. I know you want to work your magic on them, but for now, focus on bringing order to the Star Realm.

Once you handle that, I will have a place ready for you to bring your army. Also, I will try to awaken the rest of my brothers. This way, you all can work together to build the strongest army in the universe for me."
"Do not worry, Little Brother. I will be done long before you know it." Kent had no doubt that Malak would be able to handle the mission.
After all, he had already amassed a large enough army, and after he conquered the Upside-Down Cliff, he would have more than enough forces to command while conquering the other Star heavens.
"Also, you must know that there is a chance that three out of the seven Rulers are on my side. If that turns out to be the case, make them take the Trial of Evil and assimilate them into your ranks.
I have no idea what you are going to accomplish, Big Brother, but I cannot wait to see the kind of Evil Legion you will be building here."

Malak smiled and nodded at Kent. To be frank, he had been bored during the billions of years he spent sleeping. So this sounded like the perfect time to take action and build something great for his little brother.
In the end, Kent decided to take his 48 Demigod Beasts with him once he got to Elina’s universe and could enter the tower again. Tower will handle that, of course.

His three Soul Warriors would also be leaving with him. Bello had summoned a total of ten Grim Reapers. and each had become a demigod. They had also managed to gain 100 more warrior candidates, which he would work on when he returned to the tower.
Kent had no mission for them yet, but Tower told him that once he ascended, there would be more than enough missions to keep everyone busy.
He would also be leaving with Pandora, Yukiko, Mila, Nuella, and the High Priestess, who had now become an Enchantress and chosen to change her name to Misana.
"Misana, your mission is to make sure all the non-warriors get the Mark of Evil. They will be leaving here since the Star Realm would soon become chaotic, and I do not want them implicated."
"I will get right on it, Evil Prince."

Kent nodded, not minding how the Evil Race now referred to him. While he had no idea what any of this truly meant yet, he could tell that the more people knew him and called him by that name, the stronger his hold on his evil powers became.
So, weird as it may sound, he did not care much about being called the Evil Prince.
For now, Kent knew he must hurry back so he and Gaia could plan how to build cities large enough to accommodate everyone.
While they were non-combatants, living inside the tower would contribute to his growing soul strength, so Kent wanted them there. The only issue was their numbers.
Gaia would need a lot of time to handle such a demand. But Kent could already see how happy she would become to have such missions given to her and her minions.
The moment Kent was done handling all the other minor missions, he summoned Ryoa, who returned with five subordinates.
Kent was a bit taken aback, but after learning what he had been up to since they parted ways, he decided to let him continue his exploration.
Gaap had awakened and had now broken the second seal. Aside from that, the second weapon Lady Kenzie had created had also awakened, and just like Gaap, he had also broken the second seal.
With two living weapons at his disposal, Ryoa could roam as far as he wanted, provided he did not get into trouble.
Lastly, Kent was shocked to learn that the Shadow Fiends he had sent to aid his three Soul Warriors had become Demigods and, even more shocking, that over 200 more had awakened.
Kent decided to keep them inside the Faceless Shadow Realm. This way, whenever he used the Faceless Shadow Realm, they would serve as added muscle.
He had no idea what any of this meant yet, but Kent could not wait to reach the Immortal Stage for both his sword and shadow professions to become domains.
"I feel like taking you all with me would make my legion back home sad and heartbroken, considering the gap in strength is just too vast.
Well, Kaizo would be thrilled to have more powerful people to fight, but for the mental health of my pals back home, the moment Tower sends you there, try to get along with them."
Kent said to his 48 Demigods as he got ready to open the gateway to Elina’s Galaxy.
They laughed but nodded.
"We will take it easy on them, Young Lord," Crimson said, his hands crossed over his chest.
"That is good to hear. Also, whatever you do, do not challenge the one named Avotha to a duel. He is a monster and a very dangerous dragon."
Tower had revealed some things to Kent, so he knew Avotha and some members of his legion had become monsters while he was away.
"I will see you guys soon enough." Kent waved goodbye and opened a swirling green portal. The moment it opened, he jumped in, and it closed behind him.
Somewhere far away, a young lady with silver hair and golden eyes froze in her tracks, a look of shock painting her face.
"You bastard, let go of my little sister!" Elina screamed, reaching for the little loli she had been taking care of for the past 14 years inside the Abyss Slave Mine.

chapters.title: Chapter 1644: A Hell Quest
paragraphs: Landin City is one of the many cities in the Grand Magic Empire. In the Hyumbi Star System, the Grand Magic Empire ranks first due to its massive production of minerals.
Planet Gorn is the largest planet in the Hyumbi Star System and also the home of the Magic Emperor, a being said to have his hands in the pockets of Immortals and Gods.
Despite only being a Supreme High World, his wealth and connections had made him untouchable.
Landin City is a low-level city, so the number of crooks and delinquents there is staggering. They do not care what time of day it is. As long as they desired it, they would rob, beat or even kill.

Aside from robbing people of their hard-earned money, most delinquents went as far as capturing orphans and selling them into slavery. It was said that one of the major sources of income on Planet Gorn, and by extension the entire Hyumbi Star System, was the slave trade.
Bandits ambush and capture people to be sold into slavery every single day.
Most orphans hid from such people since, in Landin City, an orphan was merely a few Spirit Stones waiting to be claimed.

A 15-year-old boy clad in dirty and tattered clothes took a sharp turn and bolted forward, his speed matching that of someone who had already started cultivating, when in fact he was not even of age to begin.

But even if he were a genius, since most geniuses started cultivating at the early age of 14, looking at his clothes and the skin clinging tightly to his bones, it was clear he barely had enough to eat, much less purchase resources to cultivate.
His speed was an unnatural gift, something he had developed after spending years running from thousands of delinquents.
Today, he had caught the attention of a local crime boss who wanted him to become one of the many children he planned to ship to a slave mine within a few days.
Origin had no plans of becoming one of the unfortunate ones, not when his entire family had been sold into slavery after being ambushed on their way from a neighbouring city.
"Hey brat, stop running and be grateful I am not firing arrows at you!" a Spirit Ascension Stage cultivator shouted as he leaped from one building to another.
On the ground, Origin moved like the wind, his speed surging higher. Behind him, three others closed in rapidly.
"Leave me alone, you scums! Haven’t you taken enough from me already?" Origin cursed as he took another sharp turn, using his memory of the terrain to his advantage.
"Ungrateful brat. By becoming a slave, you would at least get to eat two meals a day and perhaps put on a few pounds."
"Relax, boss. He will not be getting away from us today."

Just as the men took a turn, they came to a sudden halt, their feet skidding across the ground for several meters. Up ahead, Origin stood trembling as a figure with purple-and-golden hair with streaks of red here and there, standing before him, arms crossed over his chest.
The one chasing from the rooftops also stopped the moment he arrived at the scene.
Origin, being the one closest to the figure, tried to force himself to run, but no matter how hard he tried, he could not move.
The purple-haired man looked down and asked, "Are you the one named Origin?"
The trembling boy nodded, and in a shaky voice, he pleaded, "P-Please... please do not hand me over to them. I beg you... please."
Kent crouched down and used his hand to brush through Origin’s hair. "Do not worry. I am not here to hurt you or hand you over to anyone. I actually need your help to find someone very close to me."
One could tell from hearing Kent’s words that Origin relaxed, almost as if he sensed the sincerity in Kent’s tone.
"I-I will do my best to help you find who you are looking for."
"Wonderful." Kent stood up and turned toward the four men chasing Origin. "You have until the count of three to vanish from my sight, or not even your bodies will remain to be found."
"Bold words from a nobody," one of the men chasing on foot said, pointing a finger at Kent.
"One." Kent began counting, unbothered by the insults and threats being hurled at him. He had sealed his aura, so to people like them, he was indeed a nobody wearing fancy clothes.
"Two."

The four advanced forward, knowing it would be four against one. However, just as they were a meter away, Kent reached the third count. He covered Origin’s eyes with one hand and briefly activated the Faceless Shadow Realm.
When he deactivated it, not even their bones were left behind to bury.
"Huh? Where are they?" Origin asked the moment he regained his sight.
Kent smiled and scoffed. "They ran away with their tails tucked between their legs. Lucky for them, if you ask me."
Origin believed his lie, which made Kent smile.
"Let’s get you cleaned up and fed before we discuss my reason for seeking you out."
Food always won, so Origin began following Kent. Of course, Kent knew there was a small chance the boy would run, so he baited him with a few Spirit Fruits.

Kent had arrived in Elina’s galaxy a month ago. The moment he arrived, he received a rather unexpected quest, one he had been following for the past month across many worlds and cities, all to find this mundane child.
[You have received a quest: Empire in Ruins.]
[Quest Level: Hell]

– Objective: [Travel to a planet called Gorn, to a city called Landin, and find a human child called Origin. Once you find him, ask for his help in locating your loved one and offer to help save his family. Whatever decision you make afterward depends entirely on you. Good luck.]
– Reward: [Nine Tribulation Dragon Blood Essence]
Kent had no idea what the quest truly wanted him to do aside from finding Origin and asking for help in locating his family. The rest would depend entirely on him.

Deep down, he knew things would not end well. This made him wonder if all of this had something to do with Elina. With no answers in sight, he continued following the destiny map, and after an entire month, he had finally located Origin.

Kent first took him to a boutique for a change of clothes, then to a high-end restaurant for a meal. After they had eaten their fill, Kent took Origin to a hotel, where he let him sleep for two full days.
He might have been in a hurry, but he was not about to work the poor kid without first letting him rest.
Thankfully, two days later, Origin woke up, and that was when Kent finally asked him the question.
"Origin, right?" The boy nodded.

"I am Kent Madson. I come from a very distant place in search of someone very dear to me. I was led to you and instructed to offer my help. So tell me, Origin, do you want me to help you get your family back?"
"What?" Origin stood up and gave Kent a suspicious look.
"You are joking, right?"
"I do not joke around, kid. I am indeed here to help you."
"You can forget it. The Abyss Slave Mine is not a place anyone returns from alive, much less a place where someone can save a family of five."
Kent frowned the moment he heard where Origin’s family had been taken.
"A slave mine, huh..." His gaze turned cold.

Today, he had caught the attention of a local crime boss who wanted him to become one of the many children he planned to ship to a slave mine within a few days.
Origin had no plans of becoming one of the unfortunate ones, not when his entire family had been sold into slavery after being ambushed on their way from a neighbouring city.
"Hey brat, stop running and be grateful I am not firing arrows at you!" a Spirit Ascension Stage cultivator shouted as he leaped from one building to another.
On the ground, Origin moved like the wind, his speed surging higher.
Behind him, three others closed in rapidly.
"Leave me alone, you scums!
Haven’t you taken enough from me already?" Origin cursed as he took another sharp turn, using his memory of the terrain to his advantage.
"Ungrateful brat.
By becoming a slave, you would at least get to eat two meals a day and perhaps put on a few pounds."
"Relax, boss.
He will not be getting away from us today."
Just as the men took a turn, they came to a sudden halt, their feet skidding across the ground for several meters.
Up ahead, Origin stood trembling as a figure with purple-and-golden hair with streaks of red here and there, standing before him, arms crossed over his chest.
The one chasing from the rooftops also stopped the moment he arrived at the scene.
Origin, being the one closest to the figure, tried to force himself to run, but no matter how hard he tried, he could not move.
The purple-haired man looked down and asked, "Are you the one named Origin?"
The trembling boy nodded, and in a shaky voice, he pleaded, "P-Please... please do not hand me over to them.
I beg you... please."
Kent crouched down and used his hand to brush through Origin’s hair.
"Do not worry.
I am not here to hurt you or hand you over to anyone.
I actually need your help to find someone very close to me."
One could tell from hearing Kent’s words that Origin relaxed, almost as if he sensed the sincerity in Kent’s tone.
"I-I will do my best to help you find who you are looking for."
"Wonderful." Kent stood up and turned toward the four men chasing Origin.
"You have until the count of three to vanish from my sight, or not even your bodies will remain to be found."
"Bold words from a nobody," one of the men chasing on foot said, pointing a finger at Kent.
"One." Kent began counting, unbothered by the insults and threats being hurled at him.
He had sealed his aura, so to people like them, he was indeed a nobody wearing fancy clothes.
"Two."
The four advanced forward, knowing it would be four against one.
However, just as they were a meter away, Kent reached the third count.
He covered Origin’s eyes with one hand and briefly activated the Faceless Shadow Realm.
When he deactivated it, not even their bones were left behind to bury.
"Huh?
Where are they?" Origin asked the moment he regained his sight.
Kent smiled and scoffed.
"They ran away with their tails tucked between their legs.
Lucky for them, if you ask me."
Origin believed his lie, which made Kent smile.
"Let’s get you cleaned up and fed before we discuss my reason for seeking you out."
Food always won, so Origin began following Kent.
Of course, Kent knew there was a small chance the boy would run, so he baited him with a few Spirit Fruits.
Kent had arrived in Elina’s galaxy a month ago.
The moment he arrived, he received a rather unexpected quest, one he had been following for the past month across many worlds and cities, all to find this mundane child.
[You have received a quest: Empire in Ruins.]
[Quest Level: Hell]
– Objective: [Travel to a planet called Gorn, to a city called Landin, and find a human child called Origin.
Once you find him, ask for his help in locating your loved one and offer to help save his family.
Whatever decision you make afterward depends entirely on you.
Good luck.]
– Reward: [Nine Tribulation Dragon Blood Essence]
Kent had no idea what the quest truly wanted him to do aside from finding Origin and asking for help in locating his family.
The rest would depend entirely on him.
Deep down, he knew things would not end well.
This made him wonder if all of this had something to do with Elina.
With no answers in sight, he continued following the destiny map, and after an entire month, he had finally located Origin.
Kent first took him to a boutique for a change of clothes, then to a high-end restaurant for a meal.
After they had eaten their fill, Kent took Origin to a hotel, where he let him sleep for two full days.
He might have been in a hurry, but he was not about to work the poor kid without first letting him rest.
Thankfully, two days later, Origin woke up, and that was when Kent finally asked him the question.
"Origin, right?" The boy nodded.
"I am Kent Madson.
I come from a very distant place in search of someone very dear to me.
I was led to you and instructed to offer my help.
So tell me, Origin, do you want me to help you get your family back?"
"What?" Origin stood up and gave Kent a suspicious look.
"You are joking, right?"
"I do not joke around, kid.
I am indeed here to help you."
"You can forget it.
The Abyss Slave Mine is not a place anyone returns from alive, much less a place where someone can save a family of five."
Kent frowned the moment he heard where Origin’s family had been taken.
"A slave mine, huh..." His gaze turned cold.

chapters.title: Chapter 1645: Empire in Ruins (1)
paragraphs: "Thank you for buying clothes for me and feeding me, but you really should not risk your neck over something unachievable." Origin might only be 15 years old, but his words carried the weight of someone over 30.

"I heard from some mercenaries that the Abyss Slave Mine is the most heavily protected place in this world. They said over 200,000 guards have been stationed there, and they would not hesitate to kill.
Saving anyone is impossible, so while I would love to one day see my parents again, the only way that would happen is if I also became a slave. So please, drop this and save yourself from danger."
Kent smiled and tossed a Spirit Grapefruit into his mouth, chewing on it casually.
"Relax, Origin. Even if there are a million guards there, I will still save your parents. Besides, I did not come here only to walk away empty-handed."
Origin stared at Kent for a long moment before letting out a sigh.

He reached into his pocket and retrieved a whistle. "Take this. My mother said that whenever I found myself in trouble I could not handle, I should blow it, and I would somehow find myself in a safe place. I have never been in real trouble yet, so you can have it.
At least it might save your life. Also, if you really manage to get inside, it will help my parents recognize you."
Kent accepted the whistle and stored it inside his Space Ring. He knew the whistle was an ordinary thing, but he liked the trust Origin had in his parents.
"Rest assured, Origin, I will return with your parents. Just stay here. I have already paid for the room, and you will be fed three times a day."
Origin nodded, and Kent stood up to leave.
"By the way, what are your parents’ names?"

A few minutes later, Kent used the Soul Map to teleport away. Tower had already locked onto the location of the Abyss Slave Mine, so the moment he left the city, he immediately began moving in that direction.
On his way there, Kent only had one thought in mind, and that was to destroy the mine before leaving.
Nothing could have prepared him for what awaited him five hours later.
[Abyss Slave Mine]

Over 3 million slaves lived in the Abyss Slave Mine, one of the largest mines in the entire Hyumbi Star System. Around the clock, the slaves mined Spirit Stones and Spirit Crystals. No matter the time of day or how fragile one was, they either worked or they did not eat.
Every slave there knew freedom was impossible for them, so they forced themselves to work hard so that feeding themselves would not become a problem.
Even so, many slaves died every single day, some from mining accidents, others from sickness, exhaustion, or the brutality of the guards.
Of course, with weekly shipments of new slaves arriving, nobody truly mourned the dead. After all, more would come to replace them within the week.
Today, 34 slaves were tied up to be executed for disobeying orders.
Among them were two young ladies, one far more striking and beautiful due to her recent changes brought about by an unknown evolution.
She possessed silver hair, golden eyes, round breasts, broad hips, and a slender waist that, combined with her curvy figure, made her resemble a living doll.

This lady was Elina, a banished heir whose family had been slaughtered by a rival clan. Beside her stood a loli with big brown eyes and short orange hair. Looking at the pale expression on her face and the black veins spreading across her neck, it was obvious she had been poisoned, but also scared.
Her name was Love, the daughter of a slave who died a few days after giving birth to her. Elina had practically raised her, so in many ways, she was like a daughter to her.
About a month ago, Elina discovered that Love had been poisoned through a snake bite. She tried everything within her power to seek help, but nobody listened to her.
So she did the only thing she could. She stole an antidote from a guard, but before she could completely cure the venom, the two of them were arrested and sentenced to death.
Today was the day of their execution, and looking around, everyone who had ever interacted with the two girls could only watch with teary eyes.
"Just close your eyes, Love. It will all be over before you know it." Elina tried everything she could to calm the poor child, but Love was more focused on pleading for Elina’s life than on her own.
She knew it was only a matter of time before she died from the venom, so execution was not something she feared anymore.
"I-I am... I am sorry, Big Sister. I am sorry," she said, tears rolling down her face as the guards began the execution process from the left side.
"Mere slaves, and yet you dare disobey orders? You dare steal from the very hands that feed you?" the guards sneered as their leader activated the slave collar around a slave’s neck.
It exploded instantly, blowing the slave’s head clean off his body.
They moved on to the next slave, and soon, only one slave remained before it reached Elina’s turn.
Turning to her left, Elina smiled softly at Love. "In the next life, I want us to be sisters again, Love."
Just then, the slave beside her lost his head.
"You may have been a princess before becoming a slave. However, that does not give you the right to steal from a guard. In your next life, stealing should be the last thing on your mind."
The guard smiled and prepared to activate the slave collar when, suddenly, his body froze.
His body rapidly contracted, and under everyone’s stunned gaze, he turned into ice before shattering apart.
High above the sky, Kent appeared, his body radiating overwhelming killing intent.
His gaze met Elina’s, and for a brief moment, scenes of her death during the Primordial Era flashed through his mind.
Then something inside him snapped.
Kent’s eyes turned blood red. Even the air around him became crimson, and before anyone could even question what was happening, he moved.
Blood filled the air.
The only thing anyone could hear was the roar of an enraged dragon.
Kent had turned off his humanity, or rather, it had shut itself off automatically, returning him to the same state he had entered when Elina died during the Primordial Era.
He had completely lost control, and to the guards and the rest of the world, he was very bad news.
He came there to save Origin’s parents.
Instead, he arrived only to witness the execution of the one person he had travelled across galaxies to find.
Everywhere around them, all anyone could see were claws tearing through flesh as blood sprayed endlessly into the air.
Still standing on the execution platform, Elina had tears streaming down her face as she watched Kent rampage through the mine.
Memories of her past life began to return.
Even without her past life memories, she recognized the young dragon before her, killing as though no humanity remained within him.
Suddenly, Kenna appeared out of thin air and stood beside Elina. With a flick of her hand, the slave collar around Elina’s neck shattered.
She repeated the same for Love, whom Elina immediately pulled into her arms and covered her eyes.
Part of Elina wanted to stop Kent, but she understood that whatever was happening to him now could not be stopped, at least not now, when she herself wanted all the guards dead.
She understood Chaos better than anyone, so she simply held Love tightly while Kent continued his rampage.
Suddenly, a portal opened high in the air, and a voice echoed out from within.
"Here I come!"
Kaizo dropped from the portal like a falling mountain and landed heavily on the ground. The entire mine trembled
"Master, your orders?" he asked, a deep frown plastered across his face.
"Kill everyone. Bring this Empire to ruins."
Kent’s voice echoed across the entire mine, causing chills to run down the spines of the guards.
Kaizo raised his hand and snapped his fingers, issuing a command.
"Call of the Legion."

chapters.title: Chapter 1646: Empire in Ruins (2) [End of Volume X]
paragraphs: If the slaves and guards within the mine had existed during the Primordial Era and had witnessed the Great Way, especially the moment the Primordial Chaos Dragon stirred his soul into 13 pieces and sent them across space and time, summoning the 13 Legion Portals, they would have been horrified to see five similar portals open the moment Kaizo snapped his fingers.
Five massive portals tore open across the sky.
From the first portal, Kent’s wives descended like Goddesses of War. They were led by the Mother of Killers herself, Neomi.
She landed gracefully, and without even asking what had happened, she immediately began slaughtering the guards, something she enjoys very much.
A glorious murder.
Unity, Lilian, Alina, Val, and the others joined the battle alongside her, with the exception of Vexthra, Lene, Miryssa, and Inaya.
Miryssa had returned to the Ice Source after sustaining severe injuries during Inaya’s Supreme Ascension, while Vexthra and a few others still hadn’t recovered.

Inaya also appeared, but instead of joining the slaughter, she flew directly toward Elina and, with a wave of her power, teleported all 3.7 million slaves far away from the slave mine so Kenna could safely work her magic on their slave collars.

From the second portal, the Undead Legion descended into battle under the command of Sylara, the Vampire Demoness. Sensing their master’s overwhelming fury, they asked no questions and immediately began killing.
The Night Riders, led by Uncle Drew, emerged from the third portal.
From the fourth portal came the Eternal Wrath Legion, led by Aetheris the Flame Giant. Their descent shook the entire mine like a devastating earthquake.

Lastly, the fifth portal opened, and the Beast Legion, led by Nexorphis, charged into battle. Even though all of them had been restricted to the Peak of the Heavenly Ascension Stage, none of them seemed to notice.
Crimson and several others who had yet to officially join any legion followed shortly after the five legions descended.
In no time at all, the 200,000-plus guards were annihilated, and Kent shot toward the eastern horizon, his legion following closely behind him.
They could all feel his rage, so none of them questioned him or attempted to stop him.
Even Inaya, who possessed the power to stop him by force, was already furious over what had happened to her sisters during her ascension, so she allowed Kent to vent his fury.

A few minutes after they left the mine, Pandora, Yukiko, Mila, Nuella, and several others who had returned from the Star Realm also appeared and immediately began helping Inaya and Kenna deal with the slave collars.
"I have never seen him this angry before," Inaya muttered, recalling the terrifying look she saw in Kent’s eyes when their gazes met briefly.
Uncle Drake, who had also chosen to assist the women, let out a sigh.
"I have seen it before, and it is not a pleasant sight."
Seeing everyone turn toward him, he slowly revealed a piece of his past.

"During the Primordial Era, I once heard rumours about a madman who wandered around slaughtering Forsaken beings. Nobody knew why he was doing it. Of course, those hateful bastards deserved the most painful deaths imaginable.
However, that madman was like a plague. His fury became so terrifying that the Forsaken Race eventually began begging people like us to help them.
I later learned that he alone had killed over 45% of the Forsaken Race before he suddenly stopped.
A few years later, I met him personally, and that was the day I realized what kind of monster the Primordial Era had given birth to.
I do not know about you ladies, but if we do not find a way to stop him, he will wipe out this planet, move to the next one, and continue killing until this entire Star System is drowned in blood."
"But can we truly stop him... or should we?" Pandora asked, a part of her secretly wishing Kent would continue until every evil soul in the Star System had been eradicated.
"If we do not stop him, he will slowly fall into a state none of us will be able to pull him back from," Yukiko said, biting her lower lip.

The Kent she knew was a happy and loving person. Even after the two of them had been hunted for years, he had never sought revenge. The Beast Tamer was perhaps the best version of Kent in his 13 reincarnations.
So she could not bear seeing him in such a terrifying state.
The women immediately began debating how they should approach the situation.
To them, Kent would not react kindly to anyone standing in his way, so even though they possessed the power to stop him, they knew they had to handle this delicately.
"I know how to stop him, but I do not want him to stop," Elina suddenly said, her furious expression making it clear that she, too, was filled with rage.
"Those people tried to kill my little sister, so I want every last one of them dead."
The previous Elina would never have said something like that. She was the kindest person Chaos had ever met. So for her to say such words meant she was genuinely furious.
Inaya and the others knew she was right, but now they had to convince her to help stop Kent, or else he would sink too deeply into his madness.
Meanwhile, in the capital where the Emperor resided, alarms blared the moment news arrived from the mine that someone had attacked them and was now heading toward the capital.

Ten minutes after they received the news, Kent arrived, blasting through the city gates far ahead of his legion. However, the moment he appeared, his legions used their connection with him to teleport directly to his side and immediately began another massacre.
Within only a few minutes, tens of thousands of guards were slaughtered, and the main palace was breached.
Kent and his legion were like a tide of death. Everywhere they passed, cities and lives fell into ruins.
Soon, they reached the deepest part of the palace where the Emperor resided. However, they discovered that he had already teleported away, abandoning his family and eldest heirs behind.
Kent slaughtered every last one of them, and with Tower equally enraged, she activated another teleportation portal.
Soon, Kent and 80% of his legion were transported to Planet Fakk, where they immediately began cutting down everyone who stood between them and the Emperor.
Meanwhile, the remaining 20% spread across the empire and began hunting down slave masters, bandits, and every other individual on Tower’s kill list.
She had already prepared a complete list of everyone who deserved death, and by the end of two days, Planet Gorn had been cleansed of all filth.
By then, over three planets had already been reduced to ruins.
It was on the third day that the Emperor was finally captured by Kent and thrown into the Prison Tower.
Yet Kent continued the massacre.
On the fifth day, after seven planets under Emperor Damakis’s authority had been reduced to ruins, Elina finally decided to stop Kent.
On the tenth day, a simple hug that came out of nowhere was all it took to stop Kent from attacking the fourteenth planet.
Kent finally regained his sanity before collapsing unconscious, not from exhaustion, but from sheer fury.
He fell into Inaya’s arms, bringing an end to the massacre, at least for everyone except Kaizo, Neomi, and Crimson.
Those three continued onward separately to conquer three more planets as quests assigned to them by the Tower.
In the end, the entire empire once ruled by Emperor Damakis was reduced to ruins, and with that, Kent had officially declared war on all slave traders across the universe.
This also opened everyone’s eyes to the fact that in the universe, not everyone could be offended, especially not someone who still carried trauma from several past lives.
The Primordial Chaos Dragon had returned, and with him came Lord Genesis (the slave swordsman) and the Ruthless Bandit (traumatized child).
[A/N: And that brings us to the close of Volume 10: Pursuit of Happiness. We still have many more adventures ahead of us, but those journeys will continue within the Immortal and God Realms.
Also, expect more sexy time in the next volume and a lot of universe-shattering reveals and battles.

Yes, Kent is ascending to the Immortal Realm, but he will not be limited to just that place. We will witness more God Worlds and encounter even more unique Gods. After all, he must prepare his Legion for the dangers yet to come.
Volume XI: Tale of 13 Incredibly Terrible Lives]

"But can we truly stop him... or should we?" Pandora asked, a part of her secretly wishing Kent would continue until every evil soul in the Star System had been eradicated.
"If we do not stop him, he will slowly fall into a state none of us will be able to pull him back from," Yukiko said, biting her lower lip.
The Kent she knew was a happy and loving person.
Even after the two of them had been hunted for years, he had never sought revenge.
The Beast Tamer was perhaps the best version of Kent in his 13 reincarnations.
So she could not bear seeing him in such a terrifying state.
The women immediately began debating how they should approach the situation.
To them, Kent would not react kindly to anyone standing in his way, so even though they possessed the power to stop him, they knew they had to handle this delicately.
"I know how to stop him, but I do not want him to stop," Elina suddenly said, her furious expression making it clear that she, too, was filled with rage.
"Those people tried to kill my little sister, so I want every last one of them dead."
The previous Elina would never have said something like that.
She was the kindest person Chaos had ever met.
So for her to say such words meant she was genuinely furious.
Inaya and the others knew she was right, but now they had to convince her to help stop Kent, or else he would sink too deeply into his madness.
Meanwhile, in the capital where the Emperor resided, alarms blared the moment news arrived from the mine that someone had attacked them and was now heading toward the capital.
Ten minutes after they received the news, Kent arrived, blasting through the city gates far ahead of his legion.
However, the moment he appeared, his legions used their connection with him to teleport directly to his side and immediately began another massacre.
Within only a few minutes, tens of thousands of guards were slaughtered, and the main palace was breached.
Kent and his legion were like a tide of death.
Everywhere they passed, cities and lives fell into ruins.
Soon, they reached the deepest part of the palace where the Emperor resided.
However, they discovered that he had already teleported away, abandoning his family and eldest heirs behind.
Kent slaughtered every last one of them, and with Tower equally enraged, she activated another teleportation portal.
Soon, Kent and 80% of his legion were transported to Planet Fakk, where they immediately began cutting down everyone who stood between them and the Emperor.
Meanwhile, the remaining 20% spread across the empire and began hunting down slave masters, bandits, and every other individual on Tower’s kill list.
She had already prepared a complete list of everyone who deserved death, and by the end of two days, Planet Gorn had been cleansed of all filth.
By then, over three planets had already been reduced to ruins.
It was on the third day that the Emperor was finally captured by Kent and thrown into the Prison Tower.
Yet Kent continued the massacre.
On the fifth day, after seven planets under Emperor Damakis’s authority had been reduced to ruins, Elina finally decided to stop Kent.
On the tenth day, a simple hug that came out of nowhere was all it took to stop Kent from attacking the fourteenth planet.
Kent finally regained his sanity before collapsing unconscious, not from exhaustion, but from sheer fury.
He fell into Inaya’s arms, bringing an end to the massacre, at least for everyone except Kaizo, Neomi, and Crimson.
Those three continued onward separately to conquer three more planets as quests assigned to them by the Tower.
In the end, the entire empire once ruled by Emperor Damakis was reduced to ruins, and with that, Kent had officially declared war on all slave traders across the universe.
This also opened everyone’s eyes to the fact that in the universe, not everyone could be offended, especially not someone who still carried trauma from several past lives.
The Primordial Chaos Dragon had returned, and with him came Lord Genesis (the slave swordsman) and the Ruthless Bandit (traumatized child).

We still have many more adventures ahead of us, but those journeys will continue within the Immortal and God Realms.
Also, expect more sexy time in the next volume and a lot of universe-shattering reveals and battles.
Yes, Kent is ascending to the Immortal Realm, but he will not be limited to just that place.
We will witness more God Worlds and encounter even more unique Gods.
After all, he must prepare his Legion for the dangers yet to come.

chapters.title: Chapter 1647: Everlasting Happiness
paragraphs: [A/N: Before y’all come for my head, know that this volume will have it all—battles, slice of life, sexy time, past-life reveals, and, as always, more introductions to the other legions. Aside from that, I just saw my timetable, so I will try to do 3-4 Chapters daily and maybe 5 on weekends.
That means, send me gifts and, well, buy me coffee (link in the Discord server). The Chaos Dragon knows I need some fine coffee to pull this off.]
After the massacre, word quickly spread across all High Worlds, Immortal Worlds, and even God Worlds, traveling even further.
The contents of the message all carried the same meaning: someone had appeared, and he was hunting down Slave Traders and Slave Masters.

Many took the warning seriously, while others simply shrugged it off. After all, most doubted that someone with a functioning brain would dare come after them, considering the kind of power they possessed as slave traders.
They knew the risks of their trade, so they surrounded themselves with powerful cultivators. Some even have alliances with sects, clans, families, and many more.
Many even sent out public messages challenging Kent to come for them if he truly dared.
Luckily for those people, Kent was not in a state to accept their challenge since he had remained unconscious ever since Elina stopped him from sinking too deeply into his hatred and anger.
Months passed in the outside world, which translated into years inside the tower.
While Kent slept, many things happened.

The first was the complete annihilation of the Planet Killer Dungeon. With the Beast Legion joining the mission, it took them only a few weeks to reach the 37th floor, where the Ant King, who turned out to be a God King, awaited them.
Nexorphis, Ixeron, and Crimson defeated him within ten minutes.
Afterward, the Ant King became a member of the Eternal Wrath Legion, just as Veera and the others once had. He received the Innate talent awakening Pill and some other stuff.
Aside from that, after clearing the dungeon, they each received rather generous rewards from the Universe for completing the mission successfully.
Lani also received a second Deathnote Mission, which took her to an Immortal World where her task was to assassinate a tyrant and his entire inner circle.
Vari and Indie accompanied her on the mission. All three of them were some of the greatest assassins to walk the face of this universe.
While they were away, Kent’s wives worked tirelessly to relocate the slaves from the Abyss Slave Mine alongside the Evil Race from the Star Realm.
Gaia was practically worked to the bone creating two of the largest cities yet.
In the end, she created two majestic cities, one surrounded by a blue river and the other suspended on a mountain.
Each city was large enough to house over 300 million people. She went all out this time around since she had no plans to build more cities for now.

With the massacre committed by Kent and his legion, combined with the campaign the Three Soul Warriors carried out while Kent was away in the Tormented Chaos Abyss, they managed to gather enough Tower Points to completely clear Kent’s debt.

Then, with the campaign Malak had started within the Star Realm and the Planet Killer Dungeon fully conquered, there were more than enough Tower Points left for Gaia and Tower to use in constructing the two massive cities.
It took years inside the tower due to the time difference, but eventually every last person was successfully migrated there.
In the end, Kent again ran out of tower points. But Malak and the evil army soon repaid his debt and started accumulating more tower points.
Ten years into Kent’s slumber, Vexthra, Lene, Ainna, Umai, and Daliah finally emerged from the Healing Pods refreshed and completely healed, something that greatly eased everyone’s worries.
After learning what had happened during Inaya’s Ascension Ceremony, all of them dreaded the day Kent would awaken and discover that his wives and friends came this close to death.
He would have gone on another rampage, and this time, he would likely summon Malak and the evil army to lead the charge.
Thankfully, they all recovered, leaving Miryssa as the only one yet to return.
That one too, thanks to Runa, who had entered seclusion to break through to the Immortal Stage since that was the only way for her to enter the Ice Source, succeeded.
So, in the eleventh year of Kent’s slumber, she and her sister finally managed to enter the Ice Source and discovered that Miryssa had fully recovered.
However, that was not all.
Three of her sisters, members of the Fourteen Chronicles of Ice, had also returned to the Source after sensing her life force fading when she was injured.
All of them eventually returned to the tower to wait for Kent to awaken.

In the twelfth year, the legion received a quest that took them to another Immortal World, where they saved an entire human kingdom from near annihilation and resettled its people in the city where the people from the Abyss slave mine were living.
It was after saving the kingdom that they discovered they had once been members of an order that had followed the Goddess of Light.

After digging deeper, they realized that Yuyin and that ancient order were connected far more deeply than they had originally believed. In fact, they had been protecting her Ascension tablet, which held her memories.
A few weeks into their investigation, Yuyin awakened her Goddess of Light Divinity, becoming a Goddess. She completely skipped the Immortal Stage.
The entire universe felt hope return once again.
After all, while the Goddess of Light was no warrior, her presence alone on the battlefield raised morale tremendously.
Following her awakening, the legion returned to the Legion Tower, while Kent’s wives, alongside several potential candidates, moved into the Harem Tower to await his awakening.
In the sixteenth year, Kent finally opened his eyes.
He was stunned to find no one by his side. However, he quickly sensed their presence, almost as though they had been keeping a constant watch over him.
The first person to enter the room was Elina, who had been waiting for him to awaken for the past sixteen years.
She immediately jumped into Kent’s arms and hugged him tightly, pouring all the love she never had the chance to show him during the Primordial Era into that embrace.
The other women stopped outside and allowed the two of them to have their moment.
Elina had never expected a day like this to come.

In her dreams, she had often fantasized about gaining her freedom and taking her little sister, Love, around the world the same way she once traveled as a child, long before her father was killed and she was sold into slavery.
In the end, the one who came to save her was the very person she had been dreaming about all along.
It was thanks to those dreams that she woke up every day, worked tirelessly, and never lost hope.
Today, she had finally reunited with him, and as it turned out, Kent was the Dragon she had never gotten the chance to love fully in her past life.
She had spent the last sixteen years inside the tower replaying those memories over and over again, hoping for the day Kent would finally wake up and hold her in his arms.
Now that he had returned, she could finally love him the way she had always intended to during the Primordial Era.
And thus began a level of enjoyment even Kent had not been prepared for.
He never expected Elina to demand that he make her his woman as soon as he woke up.
But she was not the only one.
Kent was stunned to find himself surrounded by beauties capable of bringing down empires with a mere wave of their hands, all now gathered within his bed, fully naked and craving his dick.
He never saw this coming, not this early into his journey, at least.
However, the moment he found himself embraced by such women, he realized that making them happy was the most important thing to him.
Ascending to the Immortal World could wait for now.

So Kent devoted all of his attention to making every last one of his wives happy, including new additions like Elina, Yuyin, Fallon, Vika, Pandora, Yukiko, Mila, Nuella, and the others who had entered his life while he slept.
Even Adina, who had finally managed to reach the Immortal Stage, was not excluded from this happiness.
Kent ended up spending four more years inside the Harem Tower, making sure every single woman was satisfied.
All other matters could wait for the everlasting happiness he believed they deserved.
He knew that the moment he ascended, the universe would become far more chaotic for him and everyone.
After all, while he had been asleep, he overheard everything that his wives talked about. The one that nearly caused him to lose his mind was what happened during Inaya’s Ascension Ceremony.
He knew Vexthra had nearly died, and he also learned that Miryssa had been forced to return to the Ice Source to recover.
The very moment he opened his eyes, he sent Uncle Drew a message asking him to gather every piece of information he had regarding the people who attacked his wives.
Kent was stunned when he learned that Uncle Drew had already prepared a kill list for him.
So while he was happy now, the universe would soon learn just how unreasonable the Primordial Chaos Dragon truly was.

chapters.title: Chapter 1648: Nine Tribulation Dragon
paragraphs: Kent held Elina’s hand as they walked through the Love Garden, which had now become even more beautiful and overflowing with life essence.
As they moved through the garden, one could easily tell how close the two had become over the years they spent in each other’s arms.
The past four years had been a wild ride for Kent and the women in his life.
A lot had happened since he left for Elina’s galaxy, and after waking from his slumber, he spent much of that time making sure Elina and everyone else were truly fine.
During that period, he also made sure Tower worked around the clock, developing all kinds of life-saving techniques for each of his women.
He even borrowed from Tower once again to ensure that every last one of them was protected.
Even Pandora, who could currently be considered the strongest being in the entire universe, was not spared the extra care and attention.

The women tried to downplay what happened during Inaya’s Supreme Ascension, but discovering Elina in a near-death state had completely shaken Kent, so he stuffed every single one of them with countless life-saving treasures and techniques.
Only after he was fully satisfied did he finally give them his complete attention and spend quality time with them all.
Now, four years later, he was finally ready to ascend.
But before that, there were a few things he needed to do first, and the very first was taking an afternoon stroll with Elina, whom he had plans to turn into a dragon this time around.
Even before receiving the Hell Quest, he had already planned to give her a portion of his blood essence, something that would have transformed her into a Chaos Dragon Variant.
However, thanks to the Hell Quest, he now possessed the Nine Tribulation Dragon Blood Essence, which he intended to give to her instead.
"You do know I am fine, right?" Elina asked as they walked through the garden filled with flowers and ancient trees. She knew Kent was giving her extra treatment than the rest of her sisters.
Holding her hand, Kent smiled softly and replied, "I know, but I want to hold you more."
Hearing his response, Elina smirked mischievously. "If you were this romantic back then, I wouldn’t have died a virgin."
Kent immediately blushed in embarrassment.

Now that he and Elina had truly become a couple, Kent could honestly admit that he had been an absolute idiot back then for not taking advantage of the sinful body practically offered to him on a silver platter.
Looking at Elina’s curves and generous chest, Kent could only curse his past self for being such a fool.
"I was an idiot back then... not anymore, though."
He landed a gentle slap on Elina’s butt, which was covered by a rather thin pair of pants. Honestly, things would have been much better if she had been naked.
However, Selene’s rule, turning the Harem Tower into a nude-only zone, had long since taken effect. Elina wore only a pair of pants and a bra for the sake of this stroll with Kent.
After walking several kilometers, Elina suddenly stopped and turned to face him.
"I am sorry, Kent. I tried very hard back then to hold on until you returned, but I could not. I was too weak... and because of that, I caused you pain."
A tear slid down her cheek.
"Uncle Drake told us what you became after I died. I truly am sorry."
"It was never your fault, Elina."
Kent gently wiped the tear from her face with his thumb.
"I should never have left in the first place. Even if my people would have suffered without me there to save them, they would have persevered in the end."
He leaned forward and kissed Elina softly on the forehead before continuing.
"I should be the one apologizing. If I had been faster, maybe I would have arrived in time to save you from those savages."
Elina smiled faintly before kissing Kent.
"It is all in the past now. I am here with you now, and this time, I will train extra hard so you will not have to worry about me all the time."
Kent smirked and ruffled her hair affectionately.
"Do not be silly, Elina. You are my woman, so it is my job to worry about you. That said, I have a way to turn you into a dragon... if you are willing."
Elina’s eyes instantly lit up with excitement.
"Hell yes! I want my own dragon horns!"
She reached out and touched Kent’s cute golden-red dragon horns, but the sly bastard who hated people touching his horns quickly pulled his head back.
Elina pouted, but the joy she felt after learning she could become a dragon remained impossible to hide.
Back then, she had been practically obsessed with Chaos, always talking about how she wished she had dragon scales, dragon eyes, and dragon horns.
Her favorite abilities were Dragon’s Horn Kick and the Dragon Breath Attack. If she could have said abilities, she would become the happiest person in the entire universe.
Seeing her beam with joy, Kent could not help but smile.
’Worth it. All the suffering was worth it.’
However, his gaze soon turned cold as he recalled the pain the Forsaken Race had put him through.
This time around, he promised himself he would make them pay, every last one of them.
After spending three hours wandering through the garden and talking about countless things, Elina spoke about her life in this era and how she eventually became a slave.
She hated that experience; however, she became happy considering the kind of people she lived with in the slave mine.
She especially talked a lot about Love, who had now joined Gaia’s group.
Kent had no idea what the three cosmic lolis, Gaia, Akira, and Dori, had been feeding the girls, but whenever he saw them, they seemed stronger than before.
He had no doubt that Love would also grow into a far better version of herself in no time.
Even Li Hua had joined them after completing her assassin training.
Elina and Love were practically sisters, so Elina was extremely happy to see her smile and play with girls her own age.
Or at least, that was what Elina believed.
If only she knew Gaia, Akira, and Dori were as old as the universe itself, perhaps she would start calling them Great Grandmas instead.
After the two of them had enjoyed enough time together, they returned to the Love Pool, where Kent was greeted by the sight of over three dozen naked women.
Seeing the likes of Pandora, Yukiko, Adina, Vexthra, Unity, Selene, Neomi, and many others gathered there, he allowed himself a moment to fully admire the breathtaking scene before him.
’I am one lucky bastard,’ he thought inwardly before retrieving the Nine Tribulation Dragon Blood Essence.
"What is that?" Vexthra asked, staring at the crimson liquid Kent had brought out.
"It is the Nine Tribulation Dragon Blood Essence. I intend to use it to turn Elina into a dragon."

"The Nine Tribulation Dragon, huh?" Pandora walked over and stopped beside Kent, completely naked. "If I remember correctly, the Nine Tribulation Dragon was one of the Seven Void Generals who marched under the command of the Void Commander during the invasion of the Primordial Era."
"Yes. I personally drove my claws through her chest and ripped her heart out."
Runa, who had witnessed that battle personally, smiled faintly, and so did Miryssa alongside the three new members of the Fourteen Chronicles of the Storm: Hetty, Thea, and Morgana.
The rest of the women who had fought in the Great War also smiled.
Back then, whenever a Void General died, the Void Army would lose formation, allowing the Universe Warriors to gain the upper hand in battle.

"If she can cultivate to the rank of an Overlord Dragon and unlock all Nine Tribulations, she might rival even you, Kent," Vexthra, the nerd who had thoroughly studied the Nine Tribulation Dragon, confidently stated.
However, Kent only smirked confidently.
"Ladies, I will forgive you all for underestimating me. But you should know one thing."
He grinned arrogantly.
"I am one of a kind, and I have no equal."
