I was too weak... and because of that, I caused you pain."
A tear slid down her cheek.
"Uncle Drake told us what you became after I died.
I truly am sorry."
"It was never your fault, Elina."
Kent gently wiped the tear from her face with his thumb.
"I should never have left in the first place.
Even if my people would have suffered without me there to save them, they would have persevered in the end."
He leaned forward and kissed Elina softly on the forehead before continuing.
"I should be the one apologizing.
If I had been faster, maybe I would have arrived in time to save you from those savages."
Elina smiled faintly before kissing Kent.
"It is all in the past now.
I am here with you now, and this time, I will train extra hard so you will not have to worry about me all the time."
Kent smirked and ruffled her hair affectionately.
"Do not be silly, Elina.
You are my woman, so it is my job to worry about you.
That said, I have a way to turn you into a dragon... if you are willing."
Elina’s eyes instantly lit up with excitement.
"Hell yes!
I want my own dragon horns!"
She reached out and touched Kent’s cute golden-red dragon horns, but the sly bastard who hated people touching his horns quickly pulled his head back.
Elina pouted, but the joy she felt after learning she could become a dragon remained impossible to hide.
Back then, she had been practically obsessed with Chaos, always talking about how she wished she had dragon scales, dragon eyes, and dragon horns.
Her favorite abilities were Dragon’s Horn Kick and the Dragon Breath Attack.
If she could have said abilities, she would become the happiest person in the entire universe.
Seeing her beam with joy, Kent could not help but smile.
’Worth it.
All the suffering was worth it.’
However, his gaze soon turned cold as he recalled the pain the Forsaken Race had put him through.
This time around, he promised himself he would make them pay, every last one of them.
After spending three hours wandering through the garden and talking about countless things, Elina spoke about her life in this era and how she eventually became a slave.
She hated that experience; however, she became happy considering the kind of people she lived with in the slave mine.
She especially talked a lot about Love, who had now joined Gaia’s group.
Kent had no idea what the three cosmic lolis, Gaia, Akira, and Dori, had been feeding the girls, but whenever he saw them, they seemed stronger than before.
He had no doubt that Love would also grow into a far better version of herself in no time.
Even Li Hua had joined them after completing her assassin training.
Elina and Love were practically sisters, so Elina was extremely happy to see her smile and play with girls her own age.
Or at least, that was what Elina believed.
If only she knew Gaia, Akira, and Dori were as old as the universe itself, perhaps she would start calling them Great Grandmas instead.
After the two of them had enjoyed enough time together, they returned to the Love Pool, where Kent was greeted by the sight of over three dozen naked women.
Seeing the likes of Pandora, Yukiko, Adina, Vexthra, Unity, Selene, Neomi, and many others gathered there, he allowed himself a moment to fully admire the breathtaking scene before him.
’I am one lucky bastard,’ he thought inwardly before retrieving the Nine Tribulation Dragon Blood Essence.
"What is that?" Vexthra asked, staring at the crimson liquid Kent had brought out.
"It is the Nine Tribulation Dragon Blood Essence.
I intend to use it to turn Elina into a dragon."
"The Nine Tribulation Dragon, huh?" Pandora walked over and stopped beside Kent, completely naked.
"If I remember correctly, the Nine Tribulation Dragon was one of the Seven Void Generals who marched under the command of the Void Commander during the invasion of the Primordial Era."
"Yes.
I personally drove my claws through her chest and ripped her heart out."
Runa, who had witnessed that battle personally, smiled faintly, and so did Miryssa alongside the three new members of the Fourteen Chronicles of the Storm: Hetty, Thea, and Morgana.
The rest of the women who had fought in the Great War also smiled.
Back then, whenever a Void General died, the Void Army would lose formation, allowing the Universe Warriors to gain the upper hand in battle.

"If she can cultivate to the rank of an Overlord Dragon and unlock all Nine Tribulations, she might rival even you, Kent," Vexthra, the nerd who had thoroughly studied the Nine Tribulation Dragon, confidently stated.
However, Kent only smirked confidently.
"Ladies, I will forgive you all for underestimating me.
But you should know one thing."
He grinned arrogantly.
"I am one of a kind, and I have no equal."

chapters.title: Chapter 1649: Meeting the 7 Ancient Primordial Beasts
paragraphs: "Do not try to resist. Just allow the blood essence to merge with your core and let it rework your entire system. It will be painless, so simply enjoy the sensation while it lasts," Kent instructed, and Elina nodded obediently.
So far, she was the weakest among her sisters, so becoming a dragon sounded like the perfect step toward building her own strength.
Luckily for her, she was surrounded by powerful, loving, and supportive sisters who would do anything to make her happy.
Kent poured the blood essence into her mouth, and before long, she became cocooned within a swirling crimson shell.
The next time she emerged, she would become the Nine Tribulation Dragon, an existence that had once forced even the Primordial Chaos Dragon to go all out just to kill her.

Back then, the Nine Tribulation Dragon had only awakened six Tribulations. Had she reached her peak, not even Chaos himself would have survived against her. But then again, Chaos wasn’t even close to his peak, either.
Now, that terrifying power would belong to Elina, whose destiny and fate had been completely shattered the moment she met Chaos.
After making sure she was stable, Kent freshened himself up and, for the first time in twenty years, finally left the Harem Tower.
The first person he decided to visit was his mother in Nature City, the Elven City, after learning she had been worried sick when she found out he was unconscious.
He appeared on the streets of Gaiaville before quickly making his way toward Nature City.

Before leaving for Elina’s galaxy, Gaia had already built Gaiaville for humans, Nature City for the Elves, Blood City for the Bloodvein Tribe, Skyjade City for the Skyfoxes, City of Rain for the Rabbitkin, and Pyraxia City for the Dragons.
However, with the Evil Race and countless slaves migrating into the tower, two entirely new cities had been added, both of them the largest yet.
One of those cities was naturally named Evil City.
It was the largest city in the tower and had enough capacity to house over 400 million people.
So far, over 300 million residents have already settled there.

Gaia even designed seven different segments within the city to mirror the Seven Gateways of the lower realm in the star realm. This way, the people transported there would still live among familiar faces.
She would expand that later to accommodate the non-combatants from the Middle and High Heavens.
The second city created for the rescued slaves and their families had been named after Elina’s little sister, Love.
The City of Love was now home to nearly five million people of mixed races.

Although Planet Gorn, where the slave mine had existed, was primarily a human planet, slaves from countless races and worlds had also been transported there. So they were housed there, everyone settling in.
Origin had finally managed to reunite with his parents.
Overall, the Tower City was slowly evolving into a continent.
After leaving GaiaVille, Kent quickly sped toward Nature City.
The moment he entered the city, seven powerful presences immediately caught his attention.
After Tower’s latest upgrade, cultivation was no longer restricted within the cities, so the presence of seven Supremes living within Nature City immediately stood out to him.
After returning to the tower, Black Fang, who had remained within Inaya’s Soul Sea the entire time while reforming her body, had finally been released.
As a result, all seven of them were now residing within Nature City.
The moment Kent stopped moving, the seven figures appeared before him.
"We greet Lord Chaos," Moltros said respectfully while cupping his fists.
The others quickly followed his lead, all bowing respectfully toward the powerhouse who had once stood at the forefront of the universe itself.
Kent, who had recovered most of Chaos’s memories during his sixteen years of slumber, immediately recognized the seven Beastkins before him.
"You guys are the Ancient Beasts..."
Kent stood stunned for a brief moment, but he was also genuinely happy.
The Ancient Beasts had existed since the Primordial Era itself.
Back then, there had been thousands of them, though many had fallen during the Great War.
Seeing seven still alive filled his heart with joy. Inaya had already told him about this unique situation, so he was aware of their existence.
Seeing that he recognized them, the Seven Ancient Primordial Beasts smiled. "It is good to finally meet the legend in person," Xarion, the strongest among them, said with a pleasant smile.
"Good to see you guys too. And thanks for protecting Inaya during her Ascension Ceremony."
They nodded. While they felt guilty for not being able to protect the likes of Vexthra and co well, they were happy to have at least protected Inaya until she returned to save them.
"Lord Chaos, I want to ask, would the Void Beasts return?" Nareth hesitated for a moment before asking the question she had wanted to ask when she learned the Chaos Dragon was still alive.

Kent smiled and nodded. "Yes, they would return several times stronger. However, this time, we will be prepared to eradicate them completely. I have already started forming a legion to face them, and since you guys are here, you are part of it.
"So whatever you need, ask Inaya. She would provide it for you."
They nodded, their gazes filled with determination.
"You are Ancient Beasts, beings blessed by the Universe with both talent and strength. I expect great things from all seven of you."
"We will not fail you, Lord Chaos," Lios said, placing his right fist on his chest.
"When the time comes, I, Zephyra, will fight them to the death."
Tharos and Black Fang, whose real name was actually Vorak, also pledged.
"I believe you guys, so don’t slack off. If you need training buddies, you can ask Inaya or the little girls running around. Any of them can help you."
After chatting with them for a few minutes, Kent left to go meet his mom before she exploded with worry.
The Seven Ancient Primordial Beasts took his words to heart, so after a few discussions, they returned to their homes to continue comprehending the mysteries of the Dao.
Only by comprehending it to the Absolute stage could they ascend to the rank of a Celestial.
Kent spent the entire day with his mother, catching up on things and making plans to get revenge for her when he ascended to the Immortal Realm.
After leaving there, he visited Queen Eirdis and her daughter, Xandira, who was happy to see Kent again. Although she wasn’t old enough to speak, the moment Kent arrived, she became very happy.
Kent was also happy to see her again.
For reasons he couldn’t yet explain, whenever he saw Xandira, he felt happy.
So he spent hours there, making sure he spent enough time with the little Dragon before visiting others like Elaine’s parents. Origin, and his parents.
The little human, whose speed surprised even Kent, was happy to introduce Kent as his big brother who bought him clothes and took him to a fancy restaurant and a very large hotel.
He was very happy with the treatment Kent had given him.
His parents, who were present in the slave mine when Kent attacked, were also grateful for saving them and even promised to pay him back.
Kent merely nodded, knowing that now that they were inside the tower, it would be he paying them back for providing precious soul essence.
After leaving that place, he returned to the Mountain Garden, where he was surprised to find not even a single person.
Feeling the quiet atmosphere, he decided to spend a few hours there to calm his nerves before triggering the tribulation for his ascension.

Three hours later, he was ready to ascend, so he issued a tower-wide announcement for everyone to remain indoors and be ready to make good use of the precious immortal Qi that would surge into the tower the moment he ascended.

chapters.title: Chapter 1650: Siege
paragraphs: The Immortal Realm has only five galaxies, unlike the High World, which has several. There are the Eastern, Western, Northern, Southern, and Central Galaxies.

Each galaxy, however, is so large that many galaxies from the High World could fit inside just one. This was why there are millions of planetary systems and thousands of star systems within a single galaxy.
Sekesua is a star system in the Eastern Region. It is one of many, and within the Sekesua Star System, there are dozens of planetary systems, including Bormase.
Bormase has only seven planets, with Krobo as the largest and Lumenore the wealthiest. Lumenore is home to the Sun Elves, Wood Elves, Moon Elves, Dawn Elves, and Wind Elves.

They said that throughout the Sekesua Star System, Planet Lumenore was home to the most beautiful race. Elves were naturally good-looking. However, a planet packed with five different Elven races truly had a variety of Elves that stood out.
Even in the entire Eastern Galaxy, despite there being millions of planets and races, the Princess of Lumenore was counted among the top ten beauties of the Eastern Galaxy.
Princess Euren, the most mysterious person in all of the Sekesua Star System and beyond.
She wasn’t someone popular like most princes and princesses. People hardly saw her; however, whenever she appeared, her beauty caught everyone’s attention.

Most of the time, she only made appearances when there was war. They said her role as a princess mostly involved going to war. Perhaps because of this unique trait about her, she was someone many never seemed to forget.
However, in reality, the princess was rarely seen, not because she was busy with royal duties. She wasn’t seen often simply because she liked to sleep.
It was said that as one cultivates and grows stronger, sleeping becomes something of the past to them. However, sleep was something Princess Euren never seemed to get enough of.
Over the years, her family thought she was just lazy. After all, while the rest of her siblings worked hard cultivating and learning royal duties, she was hard asleep.
They even named her the Sleeping Beauty.

However, as the years passed, they began to discover something alarming about her. While she spent most of her time sleeping, her cultivation continued to rise. It was as though the more she slept, the stronger she became.
Their greatest shock came when she, among all her sisters, was the first to awaken her bloodline and become a Demigod while asleep.
It was then that her parents and some trusted aides of the royal family realized that she wasn’t someone simple.
But by the time they discovered her true identity, their enemies had also discovered it as well.
From the Supreme Realm, messengers had been sent to take her away since the Judge of the Divine saw her as a threat, or so they were made to believe.
As the Sin of Sloth, one of the Seven Deadly Sins, they considered her someone who posed a threat to the universe.

Of course, what many didn’t know was that the one who truly wanted her was someone who intended to take her sin and bestow it upon themselves. While the sins are deadly, they also have great talent and unique paths.
The universe has many rules, but they apply only to gods, immortals, and mortals. Supremes and Celestials can bend those rules to do whatever they want.
So while a Deadly Sin was indeed a danger to the universe, unless they were provoked, they wouldn’t use their power recklessly. Princess Euren was a very peaceful person.
However, the sneaky Supreme who ordered her capture had no intention of backing down, so he ordered six kingdoms to use any means necessary to retrieve the princess.
Thirty days ago, they attacked; however, what they expected and what happened did not align. In fact, the moment they appeared on Planet Lumenore and surrounded it, something chilling happened.
Out of nowhere, portals started to open, and nightmare creatures began pouring out.
Many panicked, but it was already too late; the Sin of Sloth had made her move, and the six kingdoms lost more than they could afford to lose.
They received firsthand experience of what the Sin of Sloth was capable of. As someone who loved to sleep, she found her path as a cultivator tied to dreams and nightmares.
Just like how Beast Tamers tame beasts, she tamed nightmare creatures. Perhaps if they had noticed her nature earlier, they would have succeeded in capturing her.

But she had lived for thousands of years, taming hundreds of thousands of nightmare creatures. It took her just ten minutes to prove to the six kingdoms, including the biggest among them all, that Planet Lumenore was not a place they could come and go from without consequences.
The Sin of Sloth liked to sleep, but she was not as weak as one would expect.
However, by attacking the six kingdoms, she had inadvertently gone against a Supreme who held immense power and was highly motivated to obtain the Dao of the Sin of Sloth.
So she did not take kindly to her actions, and so she sent an army of Demigods and Immortals, handpicked from among his vassal gods, to bring Planet Lumenore to its knees.
Today, the entire planet was surrounded by hundreds of thousands of Demigods and Immortals whose mission was to use any means necessary to bring in the Sin of Sloth.
Today, Princess Euren woke up, sensing the danger surrounding her planet.
Up in the air, three demonic-looking Demigods sneered when they saw the beautiful princess appear on the front lines, followed by her two brothers, Prince Caelrion and Prince Letharion.
Some of the generals also followed her alongside thousands of Elven archers, mages, bladesmen, and others.
"Are you here to surrender?" one of the demon Demigods asked, a sneer plastered across his face. To many, he was bad news, especially because he had single-handedly brought down entire armies.
They called him the Lone General.
Since he had appeared here, it was clear their mission was not only to bring in the princess, but also to reduce Planet Lumenore to rubble.
Princess Euren scanned the Lone General for a few seconds before smirking.

"Whoever sent you clearly had no intention of leaving my people in peace, whether I surrendered or not. But even if they would let us go in peace, what makes you think I would surrender to a loser like that?

"Or do you people think I am someone who can be messed with? If I wanted to, I could destroy this entire star system within days. However, I like peace and quiet, so I held back my power. But since we are here now, allow me to open your eyes."
She pointed at the three demon generals.
"I warned you all."
A large portal opened, and from within, hundreds of thousands of nightmare creatures started pouring out.
The battle started, and at once, the three demon generals realized they had to be careful, or this would be their death.
Far away on a tall mountain on Planet Lumenore, a red beam descended from the clouds, and when it cleared, a handsome dragon man was revealed.

Kent stood there for a few seconds, feeling his body slowly adjust to the energy around him. While that was happening, inside the tower, many people who had been stagnating at the Peak of the Heavenly Ascension Stage began to break through and level up rapidly.
In no time, thousands of Immortals started to appear inside the tower.
Suddenly, Adina appeared beside Kent with a pale expression.
